job.title: Cosmetic R&D Manager
job.description:
Our client, a Cosmetic Manufacturer that specializes in personal care products happily located in Southern California, a hub for the beauty industry, is actively looking to add a Cosmetic R&D Manager to their team:

Type: Direct Hire
Shift: Monday-Friday: 8:00am-5:00pm

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 
  • Develop new formulas and reverse engineered formula based on customer’s briefs and price target.
  • Reformulate and improve existing formulas.
  • Follow new trends closely with new products launches, ingredients and new concept such as “free from” claims. Be familiar with the formulation restrictions using these claims.
  • Be familiar with cosmetic ingredient especially their function, delivery system, interaction depending of media/base.
  • Meet with suppliers and keep product files (clinical and regulatory).
  • Work on Innovation, create new textures, concepts, actives to keep our R&D with cutting edge formulation.
  • Help creating marketing sheet to present to our customers in innovation seminars.
  • Request raw material pricing and input in our pricing matrix.
  • Evaluation/Selection/Advice regarding testing; Claims, Safety, Microbiology.
  • Assist Regulatory department requesting all the necessary ingredient information.
  • Be flexible with project priorities as they vary from time to time and manage a large workload under tight timeline.
  • Be able to make decisions to troubleshoot production or compounding. Improve and/or revise manufacturing/filling process if needed.
  • Work closely with our chemists to help on challenging projects or when needed.
  • Work closely with our Quality department to improve knowledge about new formulas, establishing standards.
  • Maintain the laboratory clean and organized, respecting GLP’s.
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor of Science or higher degree in chemistry or related field.
  • Color formulation experience.
  • OTC experience.
  • Creative thinking, technical writing and organizational skills.
  • At least 6 years and more of industry experience on the bench formulating.
  • Knowledge of cosmetic/personal care raw materials, functionality, and interactions.
  • Understanding of emulsion and surfactant technology as well as general formulation techniques.
  • Must be familiar with regulation for US market and other countries for globally approved formulas, especially for the natural and organic market (NSF, USDA/NOP, NPA).
 #IND-SPG

Estimated Min Rate: $130000.00
Estimated Max Rate: $135000.00

job.title: Office Assistant- Onsite
job.description:
Yoh has an immediate, 6 month contract opportunity, as a Office Operations Specialist within the Utilities industry to join our client, Onsite, to report to their office in Short Hills, NJ
  • $25/hr.
  • 40 hours a week, Monday-Friday,8AM-430PM

Provides office administrative support and records maintenance for water utility construction.

  • Research and document customer concerns, taking appropriate action to resolve issues in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Serve as a liaison between customers, municipal officials, and internal teams to address escalated matters and support successful outcomes.

  • HS Diploma or GED required
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook for email correspondence, scheduling, and follow-ups
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to analyze, manipulate, and reconcile large datasets using formulas and lookup functions to create pivot tables, and maintain accurate operational reports.
  • Ability to manage inbox communications and respond to customer and internal inquiries in a timely manner
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with customers in a courteous, patient, and professional manner
  • Experience handling questions, concerns, or requests while maintaining a positive customer experience
  • Organized and strong attention to detail when researching, updating, and validating service records
*** Experience within Operations Support, Utilities, Public Works or related field will be looked at before all others***

job.title: Harness Fabrication Technician
job.description:
• Harness Fabrication TechnicianIn this role, you will:
    • Work as a R&D Technician building self-driving technology – this includes vehicle build, sub-assembly, PCBA solder/rework, and harness build/assembly
    • Candidates must possess excellent documentation practices
    • Work closely with Hardware Engineering and associated teams
    • Follow safety standards and meet internal deadlines
    • Work with limited oversight
    • Seek continuing education and development opportunities
    Required Qualifications
    • Minimum 5 years of direct experience in harness fabrication using 1:1 form boards and various tooling in R&D and prototype spaces
    • Strong electrical skills, ability to read wiring schematics and layouts, redline drawings, and communicate with EDS design engineers
    • Strong background in electrical wiring, harness building, and surface-mount circuit board assembly
    • Strong understanding of electrical tools and equipment; crimpers, dies, multimeter, presses, connectors, contacts, wire gauges/types, soldering, microscope, etc.
    • Exceptional craftsmanship with the ability to pin out and quality test harnesses/circuit boards
    • Experience with Jira, Confluence, PLM, CAD, and various other software tools
    • Must possess excellent communication skills and self awareness
    • Ability to problem-solve, diagnose, analyze and isolate problems rationally
    • Proficiency with Windows and Google productivity Suite – specifically Sheets
    • Able to work independently and in a team environment
    • Approach work with a proactive, capable, and willingness attitude to solve problems and support peers
    • Ability to multitask under pressure in an unstructured environment
    Desirable Qualifications
    • IPC training and certification in the following:
    • IPC J-STD-001
    • IPC-A-600
    • IPC-A-610
    • IPC/WHMA-A-620
    • IPC-7711/7721
    Certification and training in GD&T

job.title: Materials Coordinator - Houston/AM (Wed-Sat, 7AM-6PM Shift).
job.description:
Materials Coordinator - Houston/AM (Wed-Sat, 7AM-6PM Shift).

Scope:

• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.

• SW tools like SAP, Reynolds and Reynolds, Lightspeed, etc..

• Utilize handheld RF tools to receive merchandise/products into WMS.

• Conduct the following – Stock checks, part # verification, Cycle Count, support physical inventory.

• Consolidate loads as required – Pack, Re-Pack, wrap product for shipping.

• Label parts during put away, picking or shipping process.

• Pick parts for order fulfillment, shipments, scrap requests, etc.

• Ensure orders/shipping materials are accompanied with proper delivery docs: Revised BOL, Manual tag, Packing slip, etc.

• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures & safety guidelines.

• Perform organization tasks to maintain a clean/safe work environment.

• Cross train to learn other warehouse functions.

• Fill requisitions, work orders, or requests for materials, tools, or stock items & distribute items to production workers or assembly line.

• Always maintain accuracy, provide required reports, measurements and logs to KPI guidelines.

• Expertise utilizing a warehouse ERP inventory system, Excel, shipping, receiving, safety management, materials handling, data entry, reporting, etc.

 

Required:

• Experience in the automotive industry in some fashion. Examples are Associates in automotive tech, wholesale parts at dealerships, parts to service, body shop work, military, large automobile manufacturers, etc.

• Experience and comfortability working around technicians.

• Experience and ability working with pallet jacks - Forklifts are not required.

• Experience with basic supply chain skills.

• Experience putting together spreadsheets and tables.

• Willing to put in extra work during down times by organizing the shop, stacking tires, disposing of tires, picking up deliveries, etc.

• Must be comfortable working as a team.

job.title: Quality Automation Engineer
job.description:
Quality Automation Engineer (Python, SQL & API) is a Contract Opportunity for Fortune 500 Manufacturing Company

Hands-on Quality Assurance, Automation Engineer or SDET who enjoys testing complex backend systems, working with financial data, and building reliable automation solutions in a regulated enterprise environment.

Location: Plano, TX
Pay Rate: $58/hour W2
Work Arrangement: Hybrid – Wednesdays mandatory
Employment Type: 6-Month Contract with Potential Extension
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST

Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Quality Automation Engineer to support the development and testing of enterprise financial applications and backend services. This position requires a hands-on QA professional with expertise in Python automation, pytest, SQL, REST API testing, and financial data validation. The ideal candidate has experience testing complex transaction-processing systems, developing automated testing frameworks, and ensuring applications meet security, compliance, and internal control requirements. This role involves close collaboration with software engineers, business stakeholders, and compliance teams to deliver reliable, accurate, and audit-ready solutions.

    Required Qualifications
    • 3 years minimum hands-on software quality assurance, test automation, or software development engineering in test (SDET).
    • Solid in developing automated tests using Python and Pytest / Py test/ Py-test
    • Familiarity with FastAPI and Python-based backend services.
    • Advanced SQL, including complex joins, subqueries, aggregations, and backend data validation.
    • Experience testing financial applications, banking platforms, payment systems, fintech solutions, or other regulated transaction-processing environments.
    • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and backend integrations.
    • Experience with SOX compliance, internal controls, access controls, or audit-related testing.
    • Understanding of financial reconciliations, transaction processing, and data accuracy requirements.
    • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
    • Knowledge of functional, regression, integration, negative, and end-to-end testing methodologies.
    Key Responsibilities
    • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts using Python and pytest to validate backend applications, APIs, and financial workflows.
    • Develop comprehensive test plans and execute functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and nonfunctional testing.
    • Write complex SQL queries to validate financial calculations, transaction records, account balances, and reconciliation processes.
    • Perform REST API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or comparable automation tools.
    • Validate financial transaction lifecycles, including transaction processing, approvals, exceptions, and status changes.
    • Test internal controls, including segregation of duties, role-based access, approval workflows, and unauthorized transaction scenarios.
    • Support SOX compliance testing by maintaining detailed test documentation, traceability, and audit-ready evidence.
    • Validate event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, message sequencing, error handling, and transaction processing reliability.
    • Test integrations between financial platforms, microservices, databases, and third-party systems.
    • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and application releases.
    • Investigate application defects using SQL queries, API responses, system logs, and test execution results.
    • Collaborate with developers, business analysts, accounting teams, and compliance stakeholders to resolve defects and improve testing coverage.
    • Maintain test scripts, test data, execution reports, defect records, and supporting documentation.
    Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience testing Java-based microservices or distributed applications.
    • Familiarity with Playwright or other modern automation frameworks.
    • Experience with PostgreSQL, AWS, or cloud-based financial applications.
    • Knowledge of Kafka, asynchronous messaging, or event-driven architectures.
    • Experience validating financial valuations, pricing calculations, or accounting-related transactions.
    • Experience testing immutable audit logs, approval controls, and transaction traceability.
    • Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

    Estimated Max Rate: $58.00

job.title: Warehouse Associate – Pharmaceutical Distribution
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Warehouse Associate for a direct-hire opportunity with our pharmaceutical manufacturing client in Noblesville, Indiana.

This position is ideal for someone with warehouse, distribution, shipping/receiving, inventory, or manufacturing experience who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a highly regulated environment where accuracy and meeting strict shipping deadlines are critical.

The products handled in this facility are time-sensitive radiopharmaceutical products that are ultimately shipped for patient use. Extensive training is provided, including cGMP, safety, SOP, and radiation-safety training.

Location: Noblesville, IN
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Base Salary: $50,000 annually plus shift differential

Schedule

Initial Training – Approximately 2 Months:
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM

Permanent Schedule Following Training:
Saturday–Wednesday, 6:00 AM–2:30 PM
Thursday and Friday off

Candidates must be able to complete the Monday–Friday training period and permanently work the Saturday–Wednesday schedule.

Responsibilities
  • Perform warehouse and distribution activities including receiving, order fulfillment, inventory handling, and cycle counting.
  • Accurately process, fill, package, and prepare customer orders according to established procedures.
  • Prepare products and shipping documentation to meet strict, time-sensitive shipment deadlines.
  • Complete product consolidations based on established flight and shipping schedules.
  • Maintain accurate finished-goods inventory using electronic and paper-based systems.
  • Perform inventory transactions and maintain complete and accurate warehouse records.
  • Handle radiopharmaceutical products in accordance with established safety procedures and training.
  • Follow cGMP requirements, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), safety procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Complete required documentation and paperwork accurately and on time.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, organized, and compliant warehouse environment.
  • Support additional warehouse and distribution activities as assigned.


Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 1+ year of warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, shipping/receiving, inventory, fulfillment, or related experience required.
  • Experience with shipping/receiving, cycle counting, inventory control, order fulfillment, packaging, or finished-goods handling preferred.
  • Previous pharmaceutical, medical device, healthcare distribution, food manufacturing, chemical, or other regulated-industry experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience using computerized warehouse, inventory, or distribution-management systems preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow written procedures accurately.
  • Comfortable completing detailed documentation and working within a highly structured environment.
  • Strong reliability, punctuality, and ability to meet strict deadlines.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced distribution environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Must be comfortable working around radiopharmaceutical products after completing required safety and radiation-safety training.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role
The successful candidate will be highly dependable, flexible, safety-conscious, and comfortable following detailed procedures. Because these products have limited shelf lives and must ship according to strict schedules for patient use, punctuality, accuracy, and documentation are critical.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Cosmetic R&D Chemist
job.description:
Our client, a Cosmetic Manufacturer that specializes in personal care products located in Southern California, a hub for the beauty industry, is actively looking to add a Cosmetix R&D Chemist to their team:

Industry: Cosmetics
Location: Los Angeles, CA
Type: Direct Hire
Shift: Monday-Friday: 8:00am-5:00pm

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 
  • Develop new formulas and reverse engineered formula based on customer’s briefs and price target.
  • Reformulate and improve existing formulas.
  • Follow new trends closely with new products launches, ingredients and new concept such as “free from” claims. Be familiar with the formulation restrictions using these claims.
  • Be familiar with cosmetic ingredient especially their function, delivery system, interaction depending of media/base.
  • Meet with suppliers and keep product files (clinical and regulatory).
  • Work on Innovation, create new textures, concepts, actives to keep our R&D with cutting edge formulation.
  • Help creating marketing sheet to present to our customers in innovation seminars.
  • Request raw material pricing and input in our pricing matrix.
  • Evaluation/Selection/Advice regarding testing; Claims, Safety, Microbiology.
  • Assist Regulatory department requesting all the necessary ingredient information.
  • Be flexible with project priorities as they vary from time to time and manage a large workload under tight timeline.
  • Be able to make decisions to troubleshoot production or compounding.
  • Improve and/or revise manufacturing/filling process if needed.
  • Work closely with our chemists to help on challenging projects or when needed.
  • Work closely with our Quality department to improve knowledge about new formulas, establishing standards.
  • Maintain the laboratory clean and organized, respecting GLP’s.
 QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor of Science or higher degree in chemistry or related field.
  • Color formulation experience preferred.
  • Creative thinking, technical writing and organizational skills.
  • At least 6 years and more of industry experience on the bench formulating.
  • Knowledge of cosmetic/personal care raw materials, functionality, and interactions.
  • Understanding of emulsion and surfactant technology as well as general formulation techniques.
  • Must be familiar with regulation for US market and other countries for globally approved formulas, especially for the natural and organic market (NSF, USDA/NOP, NPA).
#IND-SPG

job.title: Director Salesforce CRM Product Strategy
job.description:
Director, Salesforce CRM Product Strategy

Work Arrangement: 4 days per week onsite, occasional travel less than 25%.
Location: McKinney, TX (Hybrid – 4 Days Onsite)
Compensation: $180,000 Base Salary + 20% Annual Target Bonus
Employment Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This position offers the opportunity to influence enterprise-wide Salesforce strategy while remaining actively involved in product decisions and delivery. You will work closely with senior leaders, shape technology investments, and introduce CRM improvements that produce measurable results.

The role is especially well suited for an accomplished Salesforce Product Owner or Product Manager seeking broader strategic responsibility, executive visibility, and ownership of business-critical technology products.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce product leader to guide the evolution of an enterprise CRM environment supporting sales operations, customer engagement, and business growth. This opportunity is ideal for a strategic, hands-on Product Owner who understands how to connect business objectives with technology investments and deliver solutions that improve operational efficiency and customer relationships.

The successful candidate will have extensive experience overseeing Salesforce products, establishing product direction, managing enhancement priorities, and working with technology teams to deliver impactful capabilities. This role combines product strategy, business process optimization, customer analytics, and emerging AI technologies.

This is a senior-level individual contributor position offering significant influence over enterprise technology decisions without direct people-management responsibilities.

What You'll Be Responsible For
  • Direct the strategy, ongoing development, and optimization of Salesforce CRM products supporting sales, customer service, and business operations.
  • Develop and maintain a long-term product roadmap, balancing business priorities, technical considerations, and opportunities for innovation.
  • Own product backlog management, including evaluating enhancement requests, establishing priorities, and coordinating release deliverables.
  • Translate business objectives into detailed functional requirements, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria for technical teams.
  • Partner with software engineers, solution architects, and Agile delivery teams to ensure successful development and deployment of CRM capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business leadership to identify opportunities for process improvements, workflow automation, and improved customer experiences.
  • Use CRM reporting, customer analytics, and data insights to influence product decisions and identify opportunities to increase revenue and sales productivity.
  • Evaluate AI-powered capabilities and customer intelligence solutions that improve sales effectiveness, customer segmentation, and business decision-making.
  • Establish processes for product intake, change management, platform standards, and enhancement prioritization.
  • Monitor system adoption, product performance, business value, and return on technology investments.
  • Coordinate with external technology partners and vendors regarding platform capabilities, licensing, and service delivery.
  • Present product initiatives, delivery progress, investment priorities, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in product management or product ownership, including significant Salesforce CRM experience.
  • Demonstrated ownership of Salesforce product strategy, roadmaps, backlog prioritization, and feature delivery.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud within enterprise business environments.
  • Proven ability to develop detailed user stories, define acceptance criteria, and work directly with software development teams.
  • Experience managing competing business requirements and aligning stakeholders around product priorities.
  • Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, or similar software development methodologies.
  • Experience using CRM analytics, reporting, dashboards, and customer data to evaluate business performance.
  • Understanding of customer intelligence, AI-enabled CRM capabilities, and data-driven product improvements.
  • Experience implementing product governance, managing platform enhancements, and evaluating business outcomes.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence executive stakeholders and collaborate across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently while managing complex enterprise product initiatives.
Additional Technical Experience Candidates need familiarity with several of the following:

  • Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
  • Salesforce CRM reporting, dashboards, and analytics
  • Customer Data Platforms (CDP) and customer intelligence solutions
  • Snowflake, SQL, and enterprise data integrations
  • AI-powered customer insights and predictive analytics
  • React-based web applications and integrated CRM experiences
  • Product backlog management, Agile delivery, and requirements documentation
Preferred or Nice to have Skills in Background:

  • Salesforce certifications or product management credentials such as CSPO, CSM, or PSM.
  • Experience supporting B2B sales, distribution, manufacturing, industrial, or other complex commercial organizations.
  • Advanced degree in Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting enterprise CRM transformations, product modernization, or customer intelligence initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success improving Salesforce adoption, business processes, revenue performance, or customer engagement through product enhancements.

job.title: Intermediate Semiconductor Manufacturing Techncian-Billerica,MA
job.description:
Intermediate Semiconductor Manufacturing Technician needed for an 6-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Billerica, Massachusetts.


Pay Rate: $27 to $32 per hour



The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:
 

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change


What You Will Be Doing:
  • As a Manufacturing Technician, you'll work hands-on in a cleanroom environment to build and test our multimillion-dollar display and wafer fabrication equipment 
  • You'll be responsible for building, repairing, and testing various types of equipment--including electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies, and components.
  • You will perform electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting, and repairs-- and perform audits to ensure necessary parts are available and inspected for defects.
  • Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps you'll test assemblies, complete documentation, perform repairs, or install software to continuously improve our processes
  • Has developed proficiency in a range of processes or procedures through job-related training and considerable on-the-job experience.
  • Completes a variety of atypical assignments, as needed. Works within defined processes and procedures or methodologies and may help determine the appropriate approach for new assignments.
  • Completes work with a limited degree of supervision. Likely to act as an informal resource for colleagues with less experience.
  • Use work orders (including schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and instructions) to build, repair and/or test equipment of various kinds (electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies and components)
  • Perform a wide variety of electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting and repairs
  • Receive parts and perform audits to ensure all necessary parts are available; inspect parts for defects; troubleshoot and improve processes
  • Use test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors and/or vacuum pumps to test assemblies, subassemblies and components
  • Complete required job documentation (data entry) about progress, work expense and labor details; perform computer programming, repair or software installs, as needed
  • Work independently with minimal supervision, and serve as an informal resource for junior colleagues

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • An Associate’s degree
  • 2–4 years of semiconductor or display experience, or comparable industry or military experience
  • Related technical trainings and certifications
  • Solid analytical skills, and an ability to problem-solve using established operating procedures or scientific methods
  • Demonstrated capability to operate as a peer leader and trainer
  • Demonstrated proficiency for required semiconductor manufacturing concepts and processes
  • ASSEET
  • BSEET (DeVry, TSTC)


Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
  • This is a physically demanding position that often requires standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, the use of hand and power tools, and driving or operating heavy machinery including forklifts.
  • Additionally, because this position may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

job.title: Material Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Materials Coordinator in Carlsbad, CA.  You will support our biopharmaceutical customer with receiving, storing, staging, and distributing raw materials, components, and finished goods in accordance with cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), and safety regulations. The role supports production schedules and ensures inventory accuracy while maintaining a safe, clean, and organized warehouse environment.

Location:  Carlsbad, CA 
Shift:   M-F 8-4:30pm 
Pay: $25-28/hr DOE 
Duration: Contract to perm 
Responsibilitie
  • Support and work within the Code of Federal Regulations Title 21, Quality Management System, Standard Operation Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions, comply with all documentation needs, and practices.  
  • Perform timely and accurate data entry in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for material transactions.
  • Perform receipt of incoming materials. Check materials received against specifications, vendor shipping documents and purchase orders for accuracy.
  • Accurately maintain all receiving documentation to comply with internal procedures and or SOPs.
  • Follow best practices related to the systems and process that support material inventory, purchasing, and material control. 
  • Provide recommendations and assist with implementation of improvements.
  • Work with Purchasing and  Accounts Payable to  resolve any supplier invoice issues or discrepancies.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance and Quality Control personnel, ensuring timely testing and release of materials.
  • Conduct cycle counts and wall-to-wall counts as needed.
  • Pick and stage materials for manufacturing and laboratory support.
  • Support accurate client billing and raw material traceability through timely processing of return to stock items.
  • Inspect stock for damage/product integrity. Maintain organization of work areas through 6S (sort, set, standardize, shine, sustain, safety).
  • Interact with Manufacturing and laboratory departments to reconcile inventory variances.
  • Perform packaging and shipping of materials and samples to customers and/or testing facilities. Monitor shipments and update of any potential delays.
  • Manage effective relationships with suppliers as well as internal and external clients.
  • Successfully adapt to changing priorities in a high operating tempo.
Qualification
  • Minimum high school diploma, or equivalent
  • Preferred minimum two (2) years’ experience in materials management. Preferred minimum one (1) year experience working in Pharmaceutical environment.
  • Ability to read, understand, and carry out Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions and other Quality Process Documentation in English.
  • Knowledge of standard concepts, practices and procedures within the manufacturing and biologic environment preferred.
  • Microsoft Office experience

job.title: Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Formulation & Process Development
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Formulation & Process Development for a direct-hire opportunity with a pharmaceutical manufacturing organization in Rosenberg, TX (Greater Houston).

This is a senior-level, hands-on individual contributor position focused on pharmaceutical formulation and process development, experimental execution, scale-up, troubleshooting, and technology transfer. The ideal candidate will bring significant pharmaceutical-industry experience and the ability to personally translate product-development objectives into scientifically sound experiments, robust manufacturing processes, and successful scale-up and technology-transfer activities.

Title: Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Formulation & Process Development
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Salary: $105,000–$120,000/year
Location: Rosenberg, TX – Greater Houston
Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
Work Arrangement: Fully onsite

Limited relocation assistance may be available in the form of a sign-on bonus for qualified candidates.

Position Summary
Working under the direction of the Director of Research and Development, the Senior Scientist will personally design and execute formulation and process-development studies from laboratory scale through pilot, engineering, technology-transfer, and manufacturing activities.

The position requires a strong and consistent presence in the laboratory and pilot-plant environment. This is not a people-management or primarily administrative role. The Senior Scientist is expected to remain technically hands-on while serving as a senior scientific resource to other members of the R&D organization.

The role may support pharmaceutical finished-dosage-form programs including oral products, liquids, semi-solids, and suppository/pessary products, as applicable, across cosmetic, 510(k), ANDA, NDA, and other development programs.

Responsibilities
  • Design and personally execute pharmaceutical formulation and process-development experiments.
  • Develop and optimize finished drug-product formulations and manufacturing processes.
  • Evaluate API and excipient properties, compatibility, formulation robustness, and product performance.
  • Design scientifically sound experimental plans based on product objectives and development risks.
  • Generate, analyze, and interpret experimental data and recommend scientifically justified next steps.
  • Apply Quality by Design (QbD) and Design of Experiments (DOE) principles to formulation and process development.
  • Identify and evaluate Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs), Critical Material Attributes (CMAs), and Critical Process Parameters (CPPs).
  • Perform process optimization, characterization, scale-up, and technology-transfer activities.
  • Translate laboratory processes into robust pilot-scale and commercial manufacturing processes.
  • Evaluate manufacturing variables including mixing, shear, homogenization, temperature, order of addition, processing time, hold time, transfer, and filling parameters.
  • Troubleshoot formulation, process, scale-up, and manufacturing issues through experimentation and root-cause analysis.
  • Provide hands-on technical support during pilot, engineering, scale-up, registration, validation, technology-transfer, and manufacturing activities.
  • Support investigations involving process deviations, product-performance issues, and manufacturing challenges.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Engineering, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Project Management.
  • Prepare and maintain laboratory notebooks, protocols, batch documentation, experimental records, technical reports, and development summaries.
  • Operate appropriate laboratory and pilot-scale pharmaceutical processing equipment.
  • Support technical-transfer documentation and manufacturing implementation.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource and mentor scientists and laboratory technicians without formal personnel-management responsibility.
  • Manage multiple technical assignments while maintaining ownership of quality, documentation, and timelines.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • PhD required in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related scientific or engineering discipline.
  • Minimum of seven years of relevant pharmaceutical-industry development experience required.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in pharmaceutical formulation development and process development required.
  • Demonstrated experience taking pharmaceutical products or processes from laboratory development through scale-up, pilot, engineering, GMP manufacturing, and/or commercialization.
  • Strong experience with pharmaceutical process optimization, process characterization, troubleshooting, and technology transfer.
  • Advanced knowledge of QbD, DOE, CQAs, CMAs, CPPs, process robustness, and pharmaceutical manufacturing principles.
  • Experience with oral dosage forms, oral liquids, liquid formulations, semi-solids, and/or suppository/pessary products preferred.
  • Experience supporting ANDA, NDA, 505(b)(2), 510(k), cosmetic, or other regulated product-development programs preferred.
  • Experience with engineering batches, registration batches, validation/PPQ activities, or commercial manufacturing support preferred.
  • CDMO or other fast-paced, multi-project pharmaceutical-development experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong experimental-design, data-analysis, troubleshooting, and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
  • Ability to independently execute complex technical assignments and translate laboratory findings into practical manufacturing recommendations.
  • Strong scientific judgment, technical writing, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple development programs and collaborate across technical and business functions.

#IND-SPG

job.title: SLA III
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Senior Laboratory Analyst III opportunity with a trusted client located in Waltham, MA.  This highly motivated individual will be part of the Analytical Development group within the Genomic Medicine Unit BioAnalytics, which develops, validates, and transfers analytical methods used for characterization and release of viral and non-viral therapeutics to support clinical development of new medicines. The successful candidate will participate in the development, qualification and validation of PCR based assays and other analytical techniques routinely used to support gene therapy development.  A strong background in qPCR and ddPCR is desired, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in an industry setting performing and developing molecular biology assays.  This role operates within a GDP environment and requires excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional departments.  Experience with an electronic notebook and document writing is preferred.

Main Responsibilities:
Responsible for performing qPCR and ddPCR methods for viral and non-viral therapeutics.
Development and/or qualification of analytical methods.
Take an active role in lab maintenance, organization, and safety compliance.
Ensure documentation in a Good Documentation Practices (GDP) environment.
Ensure compliant use of written records and electronic notebooks.
Work in a matrixed environment and interact productively with associates, scientists, and management at various levels.

About You:
Education:
BS or MS in Biological Sciences or related fields.
3-5 years of relevant industry experience, including gene therapy (preferred).

Experience & Technical Skills:
Molecular biology development experience.
Experience in performing qPCR and ddPCR experiments, including tracking and trending of data.

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience automating assays with liquid handlers.
Experience with material management, inventory, and logistics.
Knowledge of method robustness and Design of Experiment.

job.title: Low-Voltage Structured Cabling Technician - Project Consultant
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Low-Voltage Structured Cabling Technician to support a short-term, onsite network installation for a defense technology organization in San Diego. The ideal candidate has hands-on commercial cabling experience and takes pride in clean installations, accurate terminations, clear labeling, and thorough testing.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If, after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated résumé. Title: Low-Voltage Structured Cabling Technician
Compensation: $35–45+/hour, depending on experience
Job Type: Short-term consulting engagement
Project Duration: 1–2 weeks
Location: San Diego, CA – onsite
Industry: Defense Technology
Eligibility: Must be authorized to work in the United States

Key Responsibilities:

  • Install the structured cabling required to support one enterprise network switch and two wireless access points.
  • Pull and route Cat6/Cat6A cabling through approved pathways based on the installation plan and site conditions.
  • Terminate cables at the appropriate patch panels, jacks, or connectors and organize connections for a clean, serviceable installation.
  • Mount wireless access points and assist with switch mounting, patching, and backboard cable management.
  • Label cable runs, endpoints, and ports consistently and accurately.
  • Perform continuity, wire-map, and termination-quality testing; document results and correct installation defects.
  • Coordinate with the lead network engineer to validate physical connectivity and troubleshoot cabling or connection issues.
  • Identify material needs, pathway obstructions, and access limitations before proceeding with affected work.
  • Follow site safety requirements, protect existing infrastructure, and maintain a clean work area.
  • Support final inspection, punch-list completion, and installation handoff.
This role is focused on physical cabling and installation. Switch configuration, wireless administration, and production network activation are not required.

Qualifications:

  • Two or more years of hands-on commercial structured-cabling or low-voltage installation experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to pull, terminate, label, and test Cat6/Cat6A cabling.
  • Experience with patch panels, keystone jacks, appropriate RJ45 terminations, cable supports, and cable management.
  • Experience mounting wireless access points or comparable low-voltage devices.
  • Ability to read floor plans and follow approved installation routes and field direction.
  • Proficiency with cable testers, termination tools, fish tape, drills, and standard installation tools.
  • Familiarity with Ethernet connectivity and basic PoE troubleshooting.
  • Ability to perform essential field-installation duties, including ladder and ceiling-access work, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Strong attention to workmanship, safety, and documentation.
  • Availability to work onsite in San Diego for the initial 1–2 week engagement.
Preferred:

  • Experience in occupied enterprise offices, laboratories, or similar commercial facilities.
  • Experience using Fluke or comparable cable-certification equipment.
  • Familiarity with MDF/IDF installations, fiber patching, and network equipment mounting.
  • BICSI or other relevant structured-cabling training or certifications.
Juniper or Mist experience is helpful but not required.

job.title: Senior Azure and Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer

About the Opportunity:
A growing enterprise organization is looking for a Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer to help drive a major modernization initiative across its infrastructure environment. This person will play a key role in transitioning critical workloads from a traditional on-premises environment into Microsoft Azure, while helping establish the architecture, connectivity, automation, and operational standards needed to support a long-term cloud strategy.

This is a hands-on engineering position suited for someone who can operate independently, solve complex infrastructure problems, and take ownership of projects from initial design through implementation and production support. The ideal candidate brings strong Azure expertise along with a deep understanding of traditional infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and hybrid environments.

What You'll Do
  • Lead the planning and execution of on-premises to Azure migrations, including infrastructure assessment, dependency mapping, testing, cutover, and post-migration support.
  • Design and implement scalable Azure infrastructure and hybrid-cloud solutions across compute, storage, networking, security, and connectivity.
  • Develop and execute cloud migration strategies for virtualized workloads and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Lead initiatives involving Azure networking, ExpressRoute, connectivity, routing, DNS, firewalls, and hybrid environments.
  • Support cloud security and application connectivity initiatives, including technologies such as Zscaler.
  • Build and improve infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Terraform, Bicep, or similar technologies.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues spanning Azure, networking, virtualization, Windows infrastructure, storage, and interconnected enterprise systems.
  • Participate in infrastructure integration efforts associated with organizational growth, acquisitions, or consolidation of technology environments.
  • Work closely with data center, application, security, and other technology teams to identify dependencies and coordinate successful implementations.
  • Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to internal infrastructure teams.
  • Help establish best practices for the ongoing management and governance of the Azure environment.
  • Take ownership of assigned infrastructure projects and drive them through design, implementation, testing, and operational handoff.
Key Initiatives
The successful candidate will have the opportunity to contribute to several high-impact infrastructure initiatives, including:
  • Data center modernization and migration to Azure
  • Azure architecture and cloud migration strategy
  • Azure networking and ExpressRoute implementation
  • Cloud application publishing and connectivity initiatives
  • Infrastructure integration following an organizational acquisition
  • Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code adoption
  • Development of long-term cloud operating and support capabilities
Technical Environment
The environment includes technologies and areas such as:
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Nutanix / enterprise virtualization
  • Windows Server
  • Active Directory
  • Enterprise networking
  • Hybrid cloud connectivity
  • Azure networking / ExpressRoute
  • Zscaler
  • Backup and disaster recovery
  • PowerShell
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
What We're Looking For
  • 7+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering across enterprise environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering experience.
  • Proven experience successfully migrating production infrastructure or workloads from on-premises environments into Azure.
  • Strong understanding of Azure architecture, networking, compute, storage, security, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Solid infrastructure background spanning virtualization, Windows Server, networking, storage, and enterprise systems.
  • Experience with cloud migration planning, workload assessment, dependency analysis, testing, and production cutovers.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities across complex infrastructure environments.
  • Experience with PowerShell and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Terraform, Bicep, or comparable Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
  • Understanding of backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity.
  • Ability to independently own technical projects and make sound engineering decisions.
  • Comfortable working in a lean environment where engineers are expected to be hands-on and take significant ownership.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with infrastructure teams, application owners, architects, security teams, and external technology partners.
Nice to Have
  • Azure Administrator or Azure Solutions Architect certification.
  • Experience with Azure Migrate and Azure Site Recovery.
  • Experience designing or implementing Azure landing zones.
  • Experience with CI/CD and automated infrastructure deployment.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure integrations associated with mergers, acquisitions, or organizational consolidation.
  • Experience taking ownership of an Azure environment from initial migration through ongoing operations.

job.title: MANUFACTURING TECHNICIAN - AUSTIN, TEXAS
job.description:
PAY RANGE: $23.00 - $25.00 PER HOUR Why This Opportunity? Applied Materials is a global leader in semiconductor manufacturing technology. This is your opportunity to join an industry-leading company that helps build the equipment used to manufacture the world's most advanced semiconductor devices. If you enjoy working with your hands, troubleshooting equipment, and supporting cutting-edge technology, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

Why Applied Materials? • World-renowned semiconductor technology company.
• Strong history of converting successful contractors into permanent employees.
• Outstanding work environment focused on safety, quality, and teamwork.
• Career growth opportunities within manufacturing and engineering operations.
• Work alongside talented engineers, technicians, and manufacturing professionals.
• Gain valuable experience working on advanced semiconductor equipment used around the world.
• Opportunity to expand your skills in electrical, mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic systems.

Position Highlights Location: Austin, Texas

Contract Length: 18 Months

Pay: $23.00 - $25.00 per hour

First Shift

Second Shift: Additional 10% Shift Differential

Weekend Shift Days:  (Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and Monday): Additional 10% Shift Differential

Weekend Shift Swing:  (Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and Monday):  Additional 18% Shift Differential


What You Will Be Doing • Build, repair, test, and troubleshoot electrical, electro-mechanical, pneumatic, and vacuum assemblies.
• Utilize schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, work instructions, and verbal instructions to complete assemblies and repairs.
• Perform electro-mechanical assembly operations and equipment troubleshooting.
• Identify and correct assembly or testing errors.
• Utilize test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps to validate assemblies.
• Receive parts and perform audits to ensure all required materials are available for builds and repairs.
• Inspect parts and completed work for defects and quality compliance.
• Enter production progress, labor, and work order details into computer systems.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and troubleshoot manufacturing processes.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while following all safety procedures and protocols.
• Properly utilize personal protective equipment (PPE) and cleanroom protocols when required.

What You Need to Bring • Minimum 2+ years of Manufacturing Technician, Engineering Technician, Electronics Technician, Mechanical Technician, or related experience.
• High School Diploma or Associate Degree.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and mechanical assembly experience.
• Electrical and electronic troubleshooting experience.
• Experience working in manufacturing and assembly environments.
• Ability to interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
• Hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Physical & Environmental Requirements • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
• Frequent bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching.
• Ability to climb stairs and ladders.
• Comfortable working in tight spaces.
• Ability to lift materials and equipment as required.
• Ability to distinguish between colors.
• Ability to work in industrial environments with varying noise levels.
• Experience using hand tools, power tools, and material handling equipment.
• May operate forklifts and other manufacturing equipment.

This position may require work within a cleanroom environment utilizing:

• Coveralls
• Hoods
• Booties
• Safety Glasses
• Gloves
• Respirators
• Chemical Aprons
• Face Shields

Why Work Through Yoh? • Weekly Pay
• Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
• Life & Disability Insurance
• Weekly Direct Deposit & ePayroll
• Employee Discount Programs
• Access to Yoh opportunities throughout the U.S., UK, and Canada

Many employees have started in technician and manufacturing roles and advanced into leadership and engineering support positions. If you are dependable, mechanically inclined, and looking for a chance to join one of the world's leading technology companies, I would love to speak with you about this opportunity.

job.title: Senior Quality Control Inspector
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior Quality Control Technician for our medical device manufacturing client in St. Paul, MN. In this role, you will be responsible for performing quality control inspections, laboratory testing, and product acceptance activities for sterile and non-sterile medical devices. The Senior Quality Control Technician will ensure products meet approved specifications, procedures, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards while supporting manufacturing, laboratory, and quality operations.
Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: St. Paul, MN
Compensation: $28/hr
Type:Direct Hire 

Job Functions·
· Perform incoming, in-process, final, and finished product QC inspections to verify conformance to specifications, customer requirements, and quality system requirements.
· Perform accurate measurements and document inspection and testing results with a high level of attention to detail.
· Ensure inspections and testing activities are completed in accordance with production schedules and established priorities.
· Review manufacturing records, sterile processing documentation, test results, certifications, labeling, and related paperwork for compliance with specifications and quality system requirements.
· Support Warehouse associates to ensure materials are properly handled and stored according to specifications and quality system requirements.
· Collect, prepare, and submit samples to internal and external laboratories.
· Prepare sterilization documentation and analyze sterilization and biological indicator results.
· Perform UV-Vis, FTIR, and basic wet chemistry testing and analyze results against established specifications.
· Prepare and mix chemical formulations for Production and Manufacturing use.
· Perform environmental monitoring activities, including temperature and humidity monitoring and controlled environment testing.
· Identify, document, segregate, and quarantine nonconforming materials to prevent unintended use.
· Assist with investigations involving products or processes suspected of being nonconforming.
· Coordinate Material Review Board activities and support timely disposition of nonconforming materials.
· Communicate with applicable stakeholders regarding materials awaiting MRB review, action, or disposition.
· Maintain controlled access to QA Hold and Quarantine areas.
· Inspect returned goods and ensure nonconforming materials are appropriately segregated.
· Maintain the equipment calibration program to ensure production, test, and measurement equipment is calibrated by required due dates.
· Verify equipment is appropriately identified with calibration status and remove equipment from service when calibration is expired or out of specification.
· Verify preventive maintenance and equipment qualification activities are completed as required.
· Assist with maintaining Quality Assurance work instructions in accordance with current regulations, standards, and quality system requirements.

Education,
· Licensure and/or Experience· Associate degree or higher in a STEM-related discipline required.
· 3+ years of experience in quality control and inspection within a medical device manufacturing environment.
· Experience preparing technical reports, analyses, and documentation using Microsoft Office.
· Ability to interpret blueprints, technical documentation, specifications, and procedures.
· Working knowledge of analytical chemistry.
· Applied knowledge of quality control, inspection methodologies, and test and measurement instrumentation.
· Experience using measurement and inspection instruments including gauges, micrometers, calipers, indicators, comparators, and microscopes.
· Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce precise measurements, documentation, and quality records.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with auditors, suppliers, management, and cross-functional teams.
· Excellent hand-eye coordination and visual acuity, including color vision, close vision, and the ability to identify fine details under magnification.

Preferred Qualifications·
·  Two-year technical degree.
· Training or certification related to ISO 13485 and FDA quality systems.
· Experience with sterilization, microbiology, and chemistry.
· Knowledge of Good Laboratory Practices.
· Strong manual dexterity.

Physical Job Requirements·
· Regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to manipulate, handle, or operate objects, tools, controls, and office equipment.
· Frequently required to communicate verbally and hear.
· Occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
· Specific vision requirements include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
· Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

job.title: Senior Azure and Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Senior Azure Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer

*********NO 3RD PARTY/SUB-VENDOR CANDIDATES PLEASE*********

6+ month contract
Peachtree Corners, GA (Hybrid)

Role Summary
Looking for a senior-level infrastructure engineer to design, implement, and modernize enterprise infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and on-prem environments. This role focuses on leading complex infrastructure projects, migrating legacy workloads to the cloud, improving operational efficiency through automation, and ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and support cloud infrastructure (primarily Microsoft Azure), including compute, storage, networking, security, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Plan and execute migrations from on-prem to Azure (dependency analysis, migration planning, testing, cutover, and post-migration validation).
  • Lead infrastructure modernization efforts across server platforms, virtualization, storage, networking, backup/DR, and consolidation initiatives.
  • Build automation and Infrastructure as Code solutions to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and streamline operations.
  • Deliver end-to-end infrastructure projects independently (solution design through documentation and handoff to operations).
  • Troubleshoot complex issues spanning cloud services, networking, virtualization, operating systems, and integrated services.
  • Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, availability, performance, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Coordinate across infrastructure operations, application teams, enterprise technology teams, and external partners to manage dependencies and execution.
  • Produce technical documentation (architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, and runbooks) and provide knowledge transfer to support teams.
  • Identify and drive continuous improvements in reliability, scalability, cost optimization, and operational effectiveness.

Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years of progressive enterprise infrastructure engineering experience (cloud + on-prem).
  • 3+ years of hands-on Azure infrastructure engineering experience.
  • Proven experience migrating production workloads from on-prem to Azure, including planning and cutover.
  • Strong background with Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualization, storage, networking, and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Bicep).
  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking (VNets, routing, DNS, firewalls, VPN, hybrid connectivity).
  • Experience implementing backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity solutions.
  • Ability to lead projects independently from requirements/design through testing and operational handoff.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across interconnected infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience working within enterprise security standards, change management, and operational processes.
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
  • Experience with Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery, and landing zone architecture.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure deployment.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure environments during mergers and acquisitions.

job.title: Senior Azure IT Integration Project Manager
job.description:
Senior Azure IT Integration Project Manager
6+ month contract
Downtown Dallas (Hybrid)

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Azure IT Integration Project Manager to lead complex IT integration initiatives within a Microsoft Azure environment. This individual will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering projects that integrate applications, data, infrastructure, and business processes across the organization.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background managing enterprise IT projects, experience with cloud-based integrations, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, technical resources, vendors, and business stakeholders. This role requires strong leadership, communication, risk management, and organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead end-to-end IT integration projects from initiation through implementation and closeout.
  • Develop project charters, schedules, budgets, resource plans, communication plans, and risk registers.
  • Coordinate integration efforts across applications, data platforms, infrastructure, security, networking, and business teams.
  • Manage projects involving Microsoft Azure services, cloud migrations, APIs, middleware, data integration, and application connectivity.
  • Partner with solution architects, engineers, developers, business analysts, cybersecurity teams, and vendors to define and deliver project objectives.
  • Establish project governance, milestones, dependencies, reporting standards, and decision-making processes.
  • Monitor project progress, budget, scope, quality, and resource utilization.
  • Identify, evaluate, and mitigate project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
  • Facilitate project meetings, steering committee updates, status reviews, and executive communications.
  • Manage requirements, change requests, scope adjustments, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Coordinate testing, data validation, deployment planning, cutover activities, and post-implementation support.
  • Ensure projects follow established IT, security, architecture, change management, and compliance standards.
  • Drive issue resolution and escalate concerns appropriately to ensure timely delivery.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and provide regular status reporting to leadership.
 
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 8+ years of experience managing complex IT projects, including integration or technology modernization initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects involving multiple applications, systems, or business units.
  • Experience working in Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development life cycles, Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
  • Experience managing project budgets, timelines, risks, dependencies, vendors, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of application integration, APIs, data flows, cloud services, and enterprise technology environments.
  • Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Project Management Professional certification.
  • Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, or other Agile certification.
  • Experience with Azure integration technologies such as Azure Integration Services, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Data Factory, or Event Grid.

job.title: Software Engineer - ADAS Platform, Sensor Pipeline & AI Inference Optimization
job.description:
Software Engineer - ADAS Platform, Sensor Pipeline & AI
Inference Optimization

Lead the development and optimization of next-generation ADAS platform software across CPUs, GPUs, DSPs, AI accelerators, and safety-critical automotive hardware. Drive sensor processing pipelines, AI inference frameworks, and real-time embedded software that enable perception and autonomous driving capabilities.

Responsibilities
  • Design and optimize platform software supporting camera, radar, lidar, ultrasonic, and vehicle sensor pipelines.
  • Build scalable middleware, frameworks, and infrastructure for ADAS and autonomous driving systems.
  • Optimize AI inference workloads using TensorRT, CUDA, ONNX Runtime, NVIDIA DriveWorks, and OpenCL.
  • Improve latency, throughput, memory utilization, and power efficiency through profiling and performance tuning.
  • Optimize perception, tracking, image processing, and sensor fusion pipelines across CPU, GPU, and hardware accelerators.
  • Develop deterministic real-time software for Embedded Linux and QNX platforms.
  • Design low-latency IPC, shared-memory, DMA, and zero-copy data movement frameworks.
  • Support ISO 26262 compliance, safety reviews, and automotive reliability requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with Perception, ML, Systems, Hardware, and Functional Safety teams.
Experience
  • 10+ years of software development experience.
  • 5+ years in ADAS, autonomous driving, robotics, embedded AI, or high-performance embedded systems.
  • Proven track record delivering production automotive software.
Technical Skills
  • Expert C++14/17+, modern C++ design patterns, multithreading, and memory management.
  • Strong experience with QNX Neutrino RTOS, Embedded Linux, IPC, and real-time systems.
  • Deep expertise in CUDA, TensorRT, GPU memory management, profiling, and performance optimization.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML models on embedded automotive platforms.
Domain Knowledge
  • ADAS software architecture
  • Perception pipelines
  • Sensor fusion
  • Functional safety concepts (ISO 26262)
Preferred
Experience with NVIDIA DRIVE platforms, DriveWorks, perception systems, sensor fusion, and autonomous driving software architectures.

job.description:
Remote Investment Management Recruiter (RPO)
Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced RPO Investment Management Recruiter in the Philadelphia suburbs to support the recruitment of specialized financial services talent across Asset Management, Alternative Investments, Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, and Investment Operations. This role will partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to identify, attract, and hire top talent for professional through executive-level positions within investment management organizations.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of the investment management industry, including hedge funds, private equity, mutual funds, fund administration, and investment operations.   • Utilize LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools to identify passive candidates.

  • Provide hiring managers with market intelligence regarding talent availability and compensation trends.

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.

job.title: Polymer Characterization Engineer
job.description:
Polymer Characterization Engineer  

The Product Design Polymers Team is looking for an experienced polymer characterization engineer/scientist to join the Polymer Engineering group within Product Design department.
 
Responsibilities:
 
  • Perform polymer characterization techniques, such as rheology, DMA, FTIR, TGA, DSC, GPC, TMA, tensile testing, creep, fatigue, falling dart impact, chemical resistance testing, optical microscopy, laser interferometry and surface energy measurements.  Ability to execute testing beyond standardized protocols (e.g. ASTM, ISO)
  • Drive hands-on scientific studies of material performance, from DOE plan, to operating characterization instrumentation and analyzing final data
  • Collaborate with material engineers, finite element analysis specialists and product designers in order develop new characterization methods in order to better predict material performance in final products.
  • Work with material engineers to develop test plans for new material investigations, as well as failure analysis.
  • Analyze test results and create presentations to communicate results to an engineering audience with a range of polymer knowledge from novice to expert.
  • Manage, prioritize, and execute multiple test requests per week.
  • Develop collaborative relationships with instrument suppliers, material suppliers, external laboratories and universities to learn about new characterization methods and instrument capabilities.

Job Qualifications:
  • MS required, preferably in polymer chemistry or material science.
  • Advanced knowledge of the structure-property relationships in polymers that govern mechanical performance, material aesthetics, and overall function
  • Experience using analytical test equipment mentioned above.
  • Excellent housekeeping and lab management practices.
  • Experience handling chemicals such as adhesives, solvents, liquid nitrogen and mild acids.
  • Experience in organizing, performing statistical analysis and presentation of material characterization data.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills are necessary.

Estimated Max Rate: $75.00

job.title: Visual Marketing Designer - Print & Digital
job.description:
Visual Marketing Designer - Print & Digital 
  • 6 month contract (potential to extend and/or convert)
  • 100% remote (United States)
  • $55-65/hr on W2 (contingent on experience)

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. Client cannot accept OPT visa, No C2C!!


***Required Documents*** --A cover letter, resume, and digital portfolio showcasing high-quality cross-platform examples.

Summary 

Working under the supervision of the Associate Director, Design, the Visual Designer will be part of the team that includes other visual designers, senior visual designers, production designer, and a creative director, as well as small group of student design interns (CO-OPs). The visual designer partners with multiple teams within Enrollment Management (EM) and joins the multimedia team to round out the creative team within the EM marketing group  at Northeastern University.

In this role, the Visual Designer will ideate and create on behalf of the University, working with the Creative Director, Associate Director, Design, and act as a support to senior visual designer(s). Projects will range from highly art directed to ones with more creative leeway while keeping within the brand identity of the University.

The Creative Team is responsible for conceiving, producing, and presenting content across the enrollment lifecycle for both digital and offline marketing vehicles. The Visual Designer must bring demonstrable experience in design across print and offline collateral; employ professional, proactive, and collegial communication; and be responsive, collaborative, empathetic, and flexible while working within an often fast-paced environment.  

Qualifications 

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required
  • At least two to five years of prior visual design experience
  • Must have a strong design acumen and creative concepting
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent projects at varying stages of production
  • Keen time management and communications skills
  • Robust willingness to collaborate and strong interpersonal skills
  • Ability to develop and effectively pitch creative concepts that appeal to a broad range of prospective student groups: undergraduate, graduate, bachelor’s completion, doctoral, certificates, etc.
  • Editorial design, art direction, and social media design experience a plus
  • Additional creative software expertise (video, animation, audio, etc.) a plus
  • An understanding of usability and user-centric design a plus
  • Illustration, animation, and photography skills a plus

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities 

  • Produce top-tiered marketing materials for both print and digital formats that support student recruitment communication efforts, including admission recruitment materials for both graduate and undergraduate audiences, general awareness and program-/ audience-specific advertising, mixed media design
  • Create concepts and designs for print and digital projects, and other special projects, producing them to be print- or publish-ready, as coordinated by production manager and aligned to media specifications
  • Provide layouts and printed comps to marketing managers and partners for approval with clear and well-informed design rationale
  • Partner closely with the multimedia, marketing management, social, and content teams on a multitude of projects.
  • Utilize conventional design software Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, AfterEffects, etc.) to create concepts and designs for publications (print and digital) as assigned
  • Successfully handle up to 15+ projects simultaneously under deadline pressure and with an exceptional attention to detail and ability to communicate effectively with colleagues
  • Provide detailed printing and mailing specs to production manager to secure price estimates
  • Act as liaison to the College of Art, Media, and Design (CAMD) and other schools and programs as needed.
  • Mentor the student designers (CO-OPs), and make recommendations to Senior Designer for potential student intern candidates
  • Part of team that advocates and upholds the Northeastern University brand identity and is responsible for creating collateral that supports enrollment goals across a wide range of prospective students.
  • Other duties as assigned

job.title: Market Business Development Manager
job.description:
Market Business Development Manager
Direct Hire
Los Angeles, CA
Base+Bonus+Full Benefits

A person in this role is responsible for driving new customer acquisition and incremental profitable growth within an assigned geographic market, with particular emphasis on high-density metropolitan markets and areas with significant untapped commercial opportunities.

The Market Business Development Manager is a hunter-focused outside sales position primarily accountable for identifying, prospecting, developing, and closing new B2B customers. This person builds a qualified pipeline through a combination of company-provided leads, self-generated prospecting, referrals, market intelligence, field activity, and collaboration with Territory Sales Managers (TSMs), branch teams, and Regional Sales leadership.
The Business Development Manager owns new opportunities from initial prospect identification through qualification, solution development, pricing, close, customer setup, initial activation, and successful transition to the assigned Territory Sales Manager for ongoing account management.

Experience:
  • 5+ years of progressive B2B outside sales, business development, territory development, or new-account acquisition experience preferred.
  • Experience within automotive aftermarket, heavy duty, commercial fleet, industrial, battery, parts distribution, or related B2B channels.
  • Demonstrated success prospecting and acquiring new commercial customers in a competitive B2B environment.
  • Proven ability to develop business through self-generated leads in addition to company-provided opportunities.
  • Experience managing a sales process from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, close, and customer activation.
  • Experience selling products or services where pricing, margin, inventory availability, logistics, and service capabilities influence the customer buying decision.
  • Experience working collaboratively with territory sales, branch operations, customer service, pricing, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage prospecting activity, opportunities, pipeline, forecasting, and customer information.
