job.title: Sr. Network Engineer - Project Consultant
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Network Engineer to lead a short-term, onsite infrastructure deployment for a defense technology organization in San Diego. The ideal candidate combines enterprise networking and wireless experience with hands-on equipment installation, site assessment, and field coordination.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If, after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated résumé.

Title: Senior Network Engineer – Infrastructure Deployment
Compensation: $60–90+/hour, depending on experience
Job Type: Short-term consulting engagement
Project Duration: 1–2 weeks
Location: San Diego, CA – onsite
Industry: Defense Technology
Eligibility: Must be authorized to work in the United States Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the physical deployment of one Juniper EX4000-12P switch and two Juniper Mist AP47 wireless access points.
  • Review floor plans and conduct site validation to confirm equipment locations, AP placement, cable routes, mounting requirements, and installation prerequisites.
  • Develop a practical installation plan and sequence of work for client approval.
  • Coordinate with a structured-cabling technician to complete cable installation, equipment mounting, patching, labeling, and testing.
  • Mount the switch on an approved backboard or mounting surface using appropriate hardware and manufacturer guidance.
  • Validate physical connections, uplink readiness, and power/PoE delivery in coordination with the client’s network team.
  • Troubleshoot installation-related issues and distinguish physical-layer problems from configuration dependencies.
  • Maintain clear communication with client contacts and immediately escalate outages, safety concerns, blocked dependencies, or scope changes.
  • Document installed equipment, port assignments, cable-test results, outstanding items, and completion status.
  • Support the final walkthrough and handoff to the client’s network team.
Qualifications:

  • Five or more years of relevant experience in enterprise network deployment, network field engineering, or hands-on infrastructure installation.
  • Demonstrated experience physically installing switches, wireless access points, and associated network infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of structured cabling, patch panels, fiber patching, uplinks, PoE, and physical-layer troubleshooting.
  • Ability to interpret floor plans, assess installation conditions, and identify practical AP locations and cable pathways.
  • Experience coordinating field technicians or low-voltage contractors and validating installation quality.
  • Strong documentation, client communication, and independent problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to perform hands-on installation work rather than solely design or remote administration.

job.title: Data Reporting Analyst (Excel)
job.description:
Data Reporting Analyst (Excel)
12 month contract
Tempe, AZ (Hybrid) - MUST BE LOCAL TO ARIZONA!!!

The Analyst of Regulatory Reporting plays a key role in ensuring the team successfully performs its reporting responsibilities. It is vitally important that LPL Financial has effective reporting on operational and trading data to meet its obligations with the regulators. The Analysts within the team are the primary processors and reviewers of the reporting data. They are expected to perform data analysis, research exceptions, and promptly escalate any issues or concerns as needed. The Regulatory Reporting team works closely with various operational, trading, technology, and service units throughout LPL to ensure accurate and timely data reporting. The team works collectively to ensure reports meet the regulatory requirements and adhere to the audit principals of completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.

The team executes several firm-wide reporting functions that fulfill LPL’s regulatory responsibilities as a Broker-Dealer and Registered Investment Advisor, including, but not limited to:
• Consolidate Audit Trail (CAT) reporting to FINRA.
• Customer Account Information System (CAIS) reporting to FINRA.
• Large Option Position Reporting (LOPR) filings with the Options Clearing Corporation (OCC).
• Short Interest filings with the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA).
• Quarterly Form 13F filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
• Electronic Blue Sheets (EBS) submissions to FINRA.
• Monitoring of Trade Reporting Facility (TRF) and Over-the-Counter Reporting Facility (ORF) through NASDAQ and FINRA.

Responsibilities:
• Prepare, review, and monitor daily regulatory reporting processes maintaining compliance with internal and regulatory guidelines.
• Processing all Regulatory Reporting completely, accurately, and timely.
• Partnering with the Senior Analysts and Management in researching and providing explanations for reporting anomalies.
• Improving the team’s processing acumen by updating Policies & Procedures and cross-training new Analysts.
• Assisting with process improvements by standardizing workflows, developing templates, and partnering with the Technology business unit on more robust automated solutions.
• Maintain control documentation needed for the various internal, external and regulatory reviews.
• Investigate, resolve, and track exceptions that may arise.
• Assist with coordinating the remediation of reporting anomalies.

What are we looking for?
We want strong collaborators who can deliver a world-class client experience. We are looking for people who thrive in a fast-paced environment, are client-focused, team oriented, and are able to execute in a way that encourages creativity and continuous improvement.

Requirements:
Ability to work well under pressure, adapt to unexpected events, prioritize and multi-task in a deadline driven environment.
Intermediate level of proficiency in Excel (vlookup, countifs, pivot tables).
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and SQL Server Management Studio.
Detail oriented with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently and communicate effectively.
Have strong analytical skills and the ability to consult and resolve issues related to data extraction, validation, and report generation.
Strong data analytical experience with SQL knowledge preferred.
Securities Licenses preferred, but not required.

job.title: Bioconjugation Lab Assistant
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Lab Assistant contractor to help support the bioconjugation team in Bristol, PA.   The Lab Assistant provides support to analysts to ensure testing needs can be completed in a timely manner by maintaining lab supplies, equipment, and materials.

Position:  Lab Assistant 
Location: Bristol, PA 
Duration: 3 months 
Schedule:  M-F 7:30 - 4:30pm 
Pay:  $21-24/hr DOE 

Responsibilities
  • Performs daily checks and calibrations of equipment (e.g. balances, storage chambers).
  • Prepare cleaning solutions for laboratory use. Clean and maintain areas of the laboratory and equipment as needed.
  • Perform routine cleaning following proper procedures for equipment such as biosafety cabinets, incubators, water baths, etc.
  • Daily monitoring and restocking of laboratory supplies and chemicals; ensure proper cycling of supplies (first in first out) and monitor supply expiration dates.

  • Assists with maintenance of laboratory equipment list and perform periodic equipment inventory.
  • Assists with periodic lab-wide cleaning schedule for refrigerators and freezer defrosts; assist with disposal of materials and organization of refrigerator/freezer shelves.
  • Setup and transfer materials for shipping to external clients and across internal sites.
  • Maintains laboratory 5S organization, perform additional duties as needed.

Qualifications:
  • High School Diploma or equivalent, AA/AS or BA/BS in chemistry, biology, or related field preferred.
  • Familiarity with analytical, chemical, or biological laboratory environment.
  • Ability to utilize email, word processing, and spreadsheet software.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Candidates must take direction from management staff (Physicists and Engineers) and be able to independently provide expertise to accomplish assigned tasks.  The successful candidate(s) must have the ability to communicate effectively and interact with a diverse project team to collect, compile, maintain and interpret data and test results accurately.

Experience Required: Minimum of 2 years experience testing on electro-mechanical equipment

 
Pay Rate: $23 to $26 per hour



Bonus payout structure:

Semiconductor Engineering Technician $1000 sign-on bonus after 100 days 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Performs moderately complex electro-mechanical technical functions and activities such as design, test, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting and assembly of electronics and electro-mechanical systems, experimental design circuitry, prototype models, specialized test equipment, tools and test fixtures.
  • Tests and troubleshoots system level and component level problems in electrical and mechanical systems and sub-systems. May perform new system and NPI installations and field upgrades.
  • Works from schematics, diagrams, written and verbal descriptions, layouts or plans to perform moderate testing and troubleshooting.
  • Compiles logbooks and test procedures documentation utilizing good writing skills. Assists in revising, developing and implementing department procedures.

Follows operating instructions, uses protective equipment when required, and uses equipment and materials properly. Actively strives to prevent accidents and injuries.

  • Performs necessary rework and assists in determining remedies for malfunctions and generates Quality Notifications.
 

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

 

  • Positive Attitude
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Good Communication Skills
  • Problem-Solving Skills
  • Team Player
  • Ability to Accept and Learn from Criticism
  • Flexibility/Adaptability
  • Works Well Under Pressure

Opportunity is Calling, Apply Now!

Various shifts

Overtime required

Open to working weekend hours

job.title: Identity & Access Engineer
job.description:
Identity & Access Engineer
6-12 month contract/contract to hire (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Peachtree Corners, GA (Hybrid)

Must have experience migrating Duo to Okta experience!

Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced Identity & Access Engineer to support enterprise identity and access management initiatives, including platform modernization, application integrations, authentication migrations, and identity lifecycle automation.
This hands-on role focuses on enterprise identity platforms, directory services, single sign-on (SSO), multifactor authentication (MFA), application federation, and hybrid identity environments. The engineer will help strengthen security, streamline authentication, improve identity administration, and deliver reliable identity services across complex enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with the ability to independently execute identity engineering projects, troubleshoot complex authentication issues, automate identity processes, and coordinate integrations across multiple technical teams.

Responsibilities
  • Identity Platform Engineering: Configure, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise identity platforms, including Okta, Duo, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • SSO & MFA Migration: Support migrations from legacy authentication and MFA solutions to modern identity platforms. Configure authentication policies, validate application functionality, and coordinate production cutovers.
  • Application Federation: Implement and troubleshoot authentication and federation integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and related protocols.
  • Directory Services Integration: Configure virtual directory services and LDAP integrations to support authentication for legacy applications and enterprise resources.
  • Identity Lifecycle Automation: Integrate identity platforms with HR systems and other enterprise applications to automate user provisioning, profile updates, and deprovisioning.
  • Hybrid Identity Management: Configure and troubleshoot directory synchronization, identity mapping, authentication, and access across multiple Active Directory domains and identity platforms.
  • Identity Integration & Migration: Execute identity integration and migration initiatives associated with organizational changes, acquisitions, and consolidation of identity environments.
  • Automation & Scripting: Develop PowerShell scripts, REST API integrations, and automated workflows to improve identity administration, reduce manual effort, and increase provisioning accuracy.
  • Technical Project Delivery: Independently manage engineering activities from requirements gathering and dependency analysis through implementation, testing, cutover, validation, documentation, and operational handoff.
  • Security & Troubleshooting: Diagnose complex authentication and authorization issues, implement secure configurations, and support least-privilege access practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with identity, security, infrastructure, and application teams to resolve technical dependencies and deliver successful integrations.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Create technical documentation, integration diagrams, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks while transferring knowledge to support teams.

Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in identity and access management engineering within enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and troubleshooting Okta and Duo.
  • Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, and hybrid identity architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing SSO and MFA integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC).
  • Experience migrating applications between identity providers or authentication platforms, including testing, validation, and cutover planning.
  • Experience with virtual directory services, LDAP proxying, identity mapping, and authentication across multiple directory environments.
  • Experience implementing automated identity provisioning and deprovisioning, including HR-driven lifecycle processes.
  • Knowledge of SCIM, directory synchronization, and identity provisioning technologies.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting skills and experience using REST APIs to automate identity administration and integrations.
  • Ability to independently deliver complex identity engineering projects from requirements through implementation and operational handoff.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across authentication flows, federation, directory services, and application access.
  • Experience collaborating with security teams, application owners, infrastructure engineers, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical documentation, communication, and knowledge transfer skills.
  • Okta certifications, such as Okta Certified Administrator or Okta Certified Consultant.
  • Experience integrating identity platforms with HR systems, such as Workday.
  • Experience with Radiant Logic or comparable virtual directory technologies.
  • Experience supporting identity integration initiatives following mergers and acquisitions.
  • Familiarity with privileged access management and enterprise identity security best practices.

job.title: Senior Research Associate
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a for Senior Research Associate, Neuroscience / Cell-Based Screening in San Diego, CA.  We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Research Associate with strong expertise in cell-based screening and assay development to support drug discovery programs focused on neuronal targets. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with high-throughput and high-content screening, preferably in an industry setting, and will play a key role in assay development, screening execution, and hit-to-lead activities.

Title: Sr. Research Associate 
Location: San Diego proper 
Pay: $40 - 50/hr. DOE 
Schedule: M-F 9-5pm 


Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and execute primary high-throughput screening (HTS) assays 
  • Optimize and run counter-screens and SAR assays to triage and characterize hits from primary screening campaigns
  • Develop and optimize in vitro assays using human iPSC-derived neurons
    to support mechanism-of-action (MOA) studies
  • Analyze, interpret, and clearly present experimental data to project teams
  • Collaborate closely with medicinal chemistry, biology, and pharmacology teams to advance programs
  • Maintain detailed experimental documentation and ensure high scientific rigor and reproducibility
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biology, Neuroscience, Pharmacology, or a related discipline
  • Cell-based screening experience, including high-throughput and/or high-content screening, ideally in an industry setting
  • Experience with neuronal cell culture, with preference for human stem cell–derived NPCs and neurons
  • Proficient in immunofluorescence
  • Hands-on experience with assay development and optimization
  • Familiarity with automated liquid handling and screening platforms
  • Strong data analysis, troubleshooting, and experimental design skills
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within cross-functional teams
Preferred Skills
  • Experience with flow cytometry
  • Exposure to drug discovery workflows, including HTS, SAR, and lead optimization
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, collaborative research environment


#IND-SPG

job.title: BSA/Product Owner
job.description:
Job Title: Business Systems Analyst/Product Owner
Location: Plano, TX (Hybrid – Onsite 3 Days/Week)
Duration: 6-Month Contract
Work Authorization: W2 Only (No C2C)

Responsibilities:
  • Define, document, and prioritize business, system, and product requirements aligned with organizational goals and customer needs.
  • Lead requirement-gathering efforts, including JAD sessions, with stakeholders to ensure shared understanding and alignment across business and technology teams.
  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of business processes and system capabilities to ensure requests align with operational constraints and best practices.
  • Serve as the liaison between internal/external stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring clear, timely, and positive communication.
  • Create and manage a structured product backlog with well-crafted user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature prioritization.
  • Own and refine the product vision and roadmap, adjusting strategy based on market trends, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.
  • Conduct gap analyses between current system functionality and new business requirements, collaborating closely with architects and developers.
  • Partner with Project Managers to support end-to-end project delivery, from planning through release.
  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Daily Stand-ups, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate that deliverables meet business and functional expectations.
  • Effectively manage competing priorities using strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and emerging technologies to help guide product and process improvements.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in business systems analysis or related roles, including 3+ years in Agile environments.
  • Proven experience in business requirements gathering, process documentation, and gap analysis.
  • Skilled in writing clear and actionable user stories, business requirements, and managing product backlogs.
  • Ability to translate complex business needs into technical specifications and product features.
  • Proficient in tools such as Azure DevOps, SharePoint, and Confluence.
  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving capabilities.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across levels.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adept at multitasking in fast-paced settings.
  • Capable of thriving in both team-driven and independent work environments.

job.title: Mid-Level Auto Tech - PM Shift/LA
job.description:
Mid Level Automotive Technician – PM Shift/Los Angeles. 

Looking for an auto technician to support a self-driving car initiative. This will be focused on general documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general maintenance. The individual should have a general understanding of drivetrains to identify and investigate problems.
 
Scope:
• Solid experience tinkering with vehicles.
• Navigate databases to find repair modules and follow processes/procedures while keeping documentation on results.
• Work with OEM tooling/base car tooling, and understand how to work with it, read diagnostics, etc.
• Running Linux command line tests, not writing them but running and being able to understand results.
• Vehicle OEM scan tool usage.
 
Required:
• Running Linux command line tests, not writing them but running and being able to understand results.
• Vehicle OEM scan tool usage.
• MUST BE COMFORTABLE WITH COMPUTERS, OEM SCAN TOOLS, AND RUNNING LINUX COMMAND LINE TESTS.
• Auto technician experience – Automotive, robotics, aerospace, etc.
• Experience working in a shop and maintaining cleanliness, managing inventory, etc.
• Comfortable working in a team environment and leading others. This is NOT a solo position.
• Solid experience with tools – Saws, screw drivers, drill, spanners, etc.
• Experience reading and following schematics, manuals, repair guides, etc.
• Strong documentation abilities - Creating repair orders stating the diagnosis, the procedures performed, the parts required, etc.
 
Pluses:

  • Desire to work in a fast-paced environment

job.title: Director of Genetics
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Director, Genetics for our clinical diagnostics laboratory client. In this leadership role, you will oversee the overall operations, strategic direction, and scientific integrity of the Genetics Department, ensuring compliance with all applicable clinical laboratory regulations and quality standards. The Director, Genetics will provide scientific and operational leadership for cytogenetics and molecular cytogenetics testing, including oncology genetics, FISH, and advanced genetic testing technologies. This position will be responsible for laboratory performance, regulatory compliance, quality assurance, staff development, and the implementation of new technologies and services. The ideal candidate will bring extensive clinical laboratory leadership experience, strong expertise in cancer cytogenetics, and the ability to drive operational excellence while supporting organizational growth.

Industry: Clinical Diagnostics / Genetics / Molecular Cytogenetics
Location: Alpharetta, GA
Compensation: 160k - 180k annual
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Provide strategic, scientific, and operational leadership for the Genetics Department, ensuring compliance with applicable clinical laboratory regulations, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.

  • Direct and oversee daily laboratory operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and reliable genetic testing and reporting.

  • Develop and maintain an effective departmental structure to support uninterrupted laboratory operations, regulatory compliance, and scientific integrity.

  • Oversee patient report sign-out activities in collaboration with the Pathology team, ensuring accuracy and validity of test results.

  • Direct the development, implementation, and maintenance of laboratory procedures, testing methods, and Quality Control processes.

  • Assume responsibility for the review and approval of laboratory activities, including internal and external Quality Control and validation of new equipment, methods, and testing procedures.

  • Support strategic planning, business development, and implementation of new genetic testing technologies, laboratory services, and diagnostic assays.

  • Lead initiatives involving microarray testing strategies and technical-only Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) services.

  • Provide scientific and technical expertise in cytogenetics, molecular cytogenetics, oncology genetics, and related diagnostic testing.

  • Collaborate with internal departments and external customers to address scientific, medical, laboratory, and patient-reporting inquiries.

  • Review and approve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the Genetics Department.

  • Maintain laboratory accreditation and Quality Assurance programs in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Serve as the primary departmental representative during laboratory inspections, regulatory audits, and accreditation assessments.

  • Ensure timely investigation and implementation of corrective actions related to audit findings, laboratory deficiencies, and Quality System issues.

  • Develop and deliver scientific presentations and technical training for employees, customers, and professional meetings.

  • Provide scientific guidance and consultation on complex laboratory testing and technical issues.

  • Oversee departmental training programs and ensure personnel competency, procedural compliance, and adherence to laboratory policies.

  • Mentor, train, and develop Associate Genetics Directors and other laboratory personnel.

  • Monitor developments in clinical laboratory medicine, oncology genetics, cytogenetics, and emerging diagnostic technologies.

  • Maintain required professional licensure, certifications, and continuing education to ensure compliance with applicable standards.

  • Foster a collaborative departmental culture that promotes teamwork, knowledge sharing, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

  • Support long-term laboratory planning, growth strategies, and organizational performance initiatives.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • MD or PhD in Genetics or a closely related scientific discipline required.

  • Completion of a two-year American Board of Medical Genetics (ABMG)-approved training program required.

  • Minimum of five (5) to seven (7) years of relevant clinical laboratory experience.

  • Extensive knowledge and demonstrated expertise in cytogenetics, molecular cytogenetics, and Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH).

  • Strong experience in cancer cytogenetics, including complex cancer karyotyping using microscopy and molecular approaches.

  • Experience with constitutional and prenatal cytogenetics, including Products of Conception (POC) testing.

  • Familiarity with advanced genetic and diagnostic testing technologies, including microarray testing.

  • Demonstrated experience overseeing clinical laboratory operations, Quality Control, method validation, and regulatory compliance.

  • Experience developing, reviewing, and approving laboratory SOPs, testing procedures, and Quality Assurance documentation.

  • Strong understanding of clinical laboratory accreditation requirements and applicable regulatory standards.

  • Experience supporting laboratory inspections, audits, and corrective action initiatives.

  • Demonstrated ability to provide scientific and technical leadership in a clinical diagnostics environment.

  • Experience mentoring, training, and developing scientific and laboratory personnel.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex scientific and technical information to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Pathology, laboratory operations, executive leadership, and external customers.

  • Strong strategic planning and operational leadership skills with the ability to support laboratory growth and new testing initiatives.

Required Certifications

  • Certification by the American Board of Medical Genetics (ABMG) or equivalent qualifications and certifications acceptable for a CLIA laboratory director.

Preferred Certifications

  • New York State Certificate of Qualification (COQ) in Cytogenetics and Molecular Cytogenetics preferred.

  • Valid California Clinical Cytogenetics license preferred.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Clinical diagnostics laboratory and professional office environment.

  • Regular use of computers and laboratory information systems for reviewing patient reports, laboratory documentation, and scientific data.

  • May require standing, walking, or sitting for extended periods while overseeing laboratory operations and administrative responsibilities.

  • Ability to review detailed microscopic images, cytogenetic results, laboratory reports, and technical documentation.

  • May require working within clinical laboratory environments while following established safety, infection control, and regulatory procedures.

  • Must maintain compliance with laboratory safety requirements and applicable policies.

job.title: Nurse Practitioner or PA-C – Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant needed for a temp contract opportunity with Yoh’s manufacturing client located in Rothschild, WI. Flexible scheduling for 1 to 5 days a week!
The clinic offers occupational and preventative care for employees. You will be the only provider onsite, working alongside an Athletic Trainer. The position is focused on the protection of individuals from occupational and environmental hazards, illness and injury prevention, and health promotion. Job is anticipating to be temporary for about three months, with possibility for extension.
--> SHIFTS: Open availability for one to five days a week, between Monday and Friday. Preferred hours are 8:00am to 4:30pm, but can be flexible.

Top Skills You Should Possess:

job.title: Quality Assurance Manager
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Assurance Manager for our medical device manufacturing client in the Los Angeles Metropolitan Area. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's Quality Management System (QMS).

The Quality Assurance Manager will ensure compliance with ISO 13485, FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), EU MDR, MDSAP, and applicable regulatory requirements while leading quality initiatives, supplier quality programs, audits, CAPA investigations, and continuous improvement efforts. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on medical device quality experience, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to collaborate across Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and executive leadership.

Industry: Medical Device / Healthcare Products
Location: Los Angeles Metropolitan Area – Onsite
Compensation: $129,000–$145,000 annually (based upon experience)
Type: Direct Hire / Full-Time
Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Vacation

Job Functions:
  • Manage, maintain, and continuously improve the company's Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with ISO 13485, FDA QMSR, EU MDR, MDSAP, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee document control, change control, training records, nonconformances, deviations, and other core Quality System processes.
  • Develop, review, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, quality procedures, and controlled documentation to ensure regulatory compliance.
  • Lead internal, supplier, customer, Notified Body, MDSAP, and regulatory audits while maintaining continuous inspection readiness.
  • Develop and execute risk-based internal audit schedules and coordinate audit preparation, execution, responses, and corrective actions.
  • Serve as a key Quality representative during external audits and regulatory inspections, including FDA and Notified Body inspections.
  • Lead the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) program, including investigations, root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness verification.
  • Monitor CAPA, nonconformance, and audit trends to identify systemic quality issues and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to support EU MDR compliance, technical documentation, post-market surveillance, risk management, and regulatory change assessments.
  • Manage supplier quality activities, including supplier qualification, audits, monitoring, quality agreements, corrective actions, and performance evaluations.
  • Evaluate supplier changes and quality events to determine potential impacts on product quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with Operations and Supply Chain to ensure appropriate controls are maintained for incoming products, materials, and components.
  • Oversee or support receiving inspections, product testing, sampling, and material disposition activities.
  • Support manufacturing, packaging, sterilization, and inspection process validation and qualification activities.
  • Oversee product complaint handling and quality investigations, ensuring appropriate documentation, escalation, and resolution.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to support regulatory reporting and post-market surveillance requirements.
  • Develop, monitor, and report Quality KPIs, including CAPA performance, complaints, supplier quality, audit findings, nonconformances, and training compliance.
  • Analyze Quality System performance data and identify opportunities for corrective action and continuous improvement.
  • Prepare Quality Management Review reports and presentations for executive leadership.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop Quality team members while establishing performance expectations and departmental priorities.
  • Provide training and guidance on QMS requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), documentation practices, and quality procedures.
  • Support the implementation and optimization of electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).
  • Promote a culture of quality, regulatory compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.

Education and/or Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, Biomedical Sciences, or a related technical discipline required.
  • Minimum of five (5) to seven (7) years of progressive Quality Assurance experience within the medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Previous experience working within a medical device Quality Management System required.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485 and FDA medical device quality system requirements, including FDA QMSR.
  • Demonstrated experience with CAPA, nonconformance management, root cause investigations, document control, change control, complaint handling, and internal auditing.
  • Experience participating in and/or leading FDA, Notified Body, MDSAP, customer, supplier, and certification audits.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage audit findings, regulatory observations, and corrective actions through successful closure.
  • Strong understanding of risk-based decision-making and quality risk management principles.
  • Experience developing and analyzing quality metrics and presenting Quality System performance to management.
  • Strong technical writing skills with experience developing SOPs, work instructions, investigation reports, CAPAs, audit responses, and controlled documentation.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to train, mentor, and develop Quality team members.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple departments and organizational levels.
  • Ability to independently identify Quality System gaps, develop corrective solutions, and drive improvements through implementation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with EU MDR 2017/745, including Quality System requirements and Notified Body audits.
  • Experience supporting MDSAP audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Experience with disposable or sterile medical devices, including syringes, needles, drug-delivery devices, blood collection products, or similar single-use medical products.
  • Experience managing supplier quality programs, global suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
  • Knowledge of ISO 14971 risk management, post-market surveillance, validation, sterilization, packaging, and medical device manufacturing controls.
  • Experience implementing or managing electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).
  • Familiarity with international regulatory requirements and global supply chain quality management.
  • Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) are highly desirable.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Full-time, onsite work environment within a medical device manufacturing and distribution organization.
  • Position involves both office-based Quality Management activities and hands-on support of manufacturing, warehouse, and quality operations.
  • Regular use of computers and standard office equipment for documentation, data analysis, reporting, and communication.
  • May require standing, walking, or moving throughout manufacturing and warehouse areas during audits, inspections, and Quality System assessments.
  • Must be able to review detailed technical documentation, quality records, inspection reports, and regulatory information.
  • Must follow applicable safety procedures and facility requirements when working in manufacturing or controlled environments.

job.title: Senior Azure Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Senior Azure Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer
6-12 month contract/contract to hire (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Peachtree Corners, GA (Hybrid)

Must have experience migrating from Nutanix to Azure cloud!

Role Summary
Looking for a senior-level infrastructure engineer to design, implement, and modernize enterprise infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and on-prem environments. This role focuses on leading complex infrastructure projects, migrating legacy workloads to the cloud, improving operational efficiency through automation, and ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and support cloud infrastructure (primarily Microsoft Azure), including compute, storage, networking, security, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Plan and execute migrations from on-prem to Azure (dependency analysis, migration planning, testing, cutover, and post-migration validation).
  • Lead infrastructure modernization efforts across server platforms, virtualization, storage, networking, backup/DR, and consolidation initiatives.
  • Build automation and Infrastructure as Code solutions to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and streamline operations.
  • Deliver end-to-end infrastructure projects independently (solution design through documentation and handoff to operations).
  • Troubleshoot complex issues spanning cloud services, networking, virtualization, operating systems, and integrated services.
  • Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, availability, performance, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Coordinate across infrastructure operations, application teams, enterprise technology teams, and external partners to manage dependencies and execution.
  • Produce technical documentation (architecture diagrams, deployment procedures, and runbooks) and provide knowledge transfer to support teams.
  • Identify and drive continuous improvements in reliability, scalability, cost optimization, and operational effectiveness.

Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years of progressive enterprise infrastructure engineering experience (cloud + on-prem).
  • 3+ years of hands-on Azure infrastructure engineering experience.
  • Proven experience migrating production workloads from on-prem to Azure, including planning and cutover.
  • Strong background with Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualization, storage, networking, and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Bicep).
  • Strong knowledge of cloud networking (VNets, routing, DNS, firewalls, VPN, hybrid connectivity).
  • Experience implementing backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity solutions.
  • Ability to lead projects independently from requirements/design through testing and operational handoff.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across interconnected infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience working within enterprise security standards, change management, and operational processes.
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).
  • Experience with Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery, and landing zone architecture.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure deployment.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure environments during mergers and acquisitions.

job.title: Identity Governance & Administration Lead
job.description:
Job Title: Identity Governance & Administration Lead
Location: New York, NY OR Holmdel,NJ- 3 days onsite
Type: Full Time
Salary- $170000-185000/yr


Our client which is one of the largest and oldest mutual insurance companies is a Identity Governance & Administration Lead
Position Overview

Identity Governance & Administration Lead will bring hands-on experience in access governance, identity lifecycle management, and provisioning across a complex, highly regulated environment by managing advanced tasks, enterprise control oversight, and coordinate with Identity & Access Management teams on automation, AI initiatives and projects. You’ll partner closely with HR, legal, digital and technology, cybersecurity, compliance, vendors and application teams to deliver identity solutions that are secure, scalable, and aligned with business needs by gathering requirements, performing advance analytics, and


Here’s What You’ll Do

  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of identity governance capabilities, including:

  • IGA/IAM Enterprise control monitoring
  • Reporting, advanced analytics, documentation, and presentations
  • Partnering with AI Business and Digital and Technology teams to build requirements that meet client company non-human identity capabilities
  • Design and implement scalable provisioning and deprovisioning solutions across enterprise systems and applications
  • Partner with business stakeholders and application owners to gather requirements and translate them into technical designs and governance models
  • Integrate IAM/IGA solutions with enterprise systems, such as SailPoint, CyberArk, OKTA etc
  • Evaluate the current identity governance landscape, identify gaps, and drive improvements in security, scalability, and user experience
  • Establish and support governance processes aligned with regulatory and audit requirements (e.g., NYDFS, MAR etc), including access reviews and policy enforcement
  • Develop documentation, standards, and runbooks to support consistency, scalability, and audit readiness
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, and compliance teams to align identity governance controls with enterprise security strategy
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in IAM and identity governance
     
Here’s What You’ll Need (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of experience in IT, cybersecurity
  • 5+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with strong exposure to Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
  • Hands-on experience implementing or supporting IGA capabilities such as lifecycle management, provisioning, and access certifications
  • Experience in integrating IAM solutions with enterprise systems and applications (e.g., SailPoint, CyberArk etc)
  • Experience with identity lifecycle processes, including provisioning, deprovisioning, and role-based access control
  • Strong understanding of identity security principles, including least privilege, Zero Trust, and access governance
  • Experience working in complex, fast-paced environments with the ability to manage multiple priorities
     
Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience implementing one or more IAM platforms (e.g., SailPoint, CyberArk, OKTA etc)
  • Experience supporting including participation in RFP/RFI processes, vendor evaluations, and proof-of-concept (POC) and project activities
  • Familiarity with identity architecture in hybrid environments (on-prem and cloud)
  • Familiarity with AI Control Plane, MCP, and AI Identity Governance
  • Experience working in regulated environments (SOC2, SOX, NYDFS, Model Audit Rule (MAR) or similar)
  • Strong understanding of identity governance best practices and industry frameworks
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or IAM/IGA-related certifications
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A desire to make an impact as part of a high-growth, transformational company that is Bold, Relentless, Curious, and Collaborative

job.title: Sr. Technical Security Lead, North America
job.description:
*** THIS IS A DIRECT HIRE ROLE - NO 3RD PARTY/SUB-VENDOR CANDIDATES PLEASE ***

Sr. Technical Security Lead, North America

*** THIS IS A DIRECT HIRE ROLE - NO 3RD PARTY/SUB-VENDOR CANDIDATES PLEASE ***

Job Description

As a Senior Technical Security Lead on our North America Application Security team, you will help shape secure technology solutions from the earliest stages of design through production delivery. You will bring deep application security expertise, secure coding knowledge, and a business enabling mindset to help teams build security in from the start rather than address it after the fact. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor across the North America technology footprint, applying broader cybersecurity knowledge across penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, network security, identity and access management, and related domains to identify risk, strengthen controls, and influence sound design decisions. You will also help advance awareness of how AI is emerging in software development and security engineering, and apply that perspective to application security analysis, review, and SDLC decision making. Working closely with application development teams, technology leaders, and line of business CIOs, you will help ensure security is part of the conversation early and often throughout the solutioning and development lifecycle. This partnership will support secure change control, enable stable delivery, and help protect and strengthen the security of  application ecosystem as it evolves alongside the business.

In this role, you will
  • Lead application security reviews and SDLC engagement with a consultative, business enabling approach
  • Apply deep knowledge of secure coding and application security best practices to influence secure design
  • Evaluate AI related risks and opportunities as part of application security analysis and review
  • Use broader cybersecurity knowledge across penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, network security, identity and access management, and related areas
  • Partner with technology teams and line of business CIOs to support secure change control and delivery
  • Identify security risks and recommend practical remediation options that balance protection and business needs
  • Build trusted relationships with application development teams, business leaders, and executives
  • Help ensure security is embedded in decisions affecting design, delivery, and production readiness
Qualifications
  • A minimum of 8–10 years of experience in information security roles spanning Application Security, Vulnerability Management, Identity and Access Management, Network Security, Data Security, and/or related disciplines
  • Bachelor’s degree required in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Apply deep security architecture expertise to review complex architectures, changes, and risk scenarios and make sound recommendations
  • Demonstrate hands-on technical experience across network security, firewalls, DNS, Windows and Linux administration, cloud security, Active Directory, vulnerability management, secure ports and protocols, encryption, 3-tier architecture, database security, zero trust, third-party reviews, and data loss prevention
  • Interpret and apply information security standards and frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001/27002, PCI-DSS, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including business leaders, project teams, and technical partners
  • Manage project lifecycles across Agile, Waterfall, and CI/CD environments while staying self-directed, accountable, and able to escalate risks appropriately
  • Collaborate effectively across priorities and leverage AI to improve security governance, automation, and review efficiency

job.title: Senior Azure Data Engineer
job.description:
Senior Azure Data Engineer (Azure Databricks)
Direct Hire
Plano, TX (Hybrid)
 
Overview
We’re partnering with a confidential, enterprise-scale organization to hire a Senior Azure Data Engineer with deep expertise in Azure Databricks to help design, build, and optimize a modern lakehouse data platform. You’ll develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, implement Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) patterns, and enable advanced analytics in a high-volume environment. This role collaborates closely with data architects, data scientists, business stakeholders, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance data solutions.
What You’ll Do
  • Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL).
  • Develop ingestion workflows from multiple source systems (e.g., Event Hub, APIs, Azure SQL, Blob Storage) into Bronze/Silver/Gold layers.
  • Implement best practices for Delta Lake and Unity Catalog (schema evolution, versioning, governance).
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost through partitioning, caching, clustering, and Spark tuning.
  • Integrate Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse, Event Hub, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.
  • Implement secure access controls using managed identities, RBAC, and data protection practices (e.g., masking).
  • Partner with analytics and business teams to deliver trusted datasets, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, and architectural guidance.
  • Work with enterprise architecture and security teams to align with data privacy/security policies.
  • Implement data quality checks, alerting, and lineage tracking using tools such as Great Expectations, Unity Catalog, and data observability platforms.
  • Build monitoring dashboards, alerts, and recovery mechanisms for critical pipelines.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, including 3+ years with Azure Databricks / Apache Spark (PySpark).
  • Strong experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks notebooks, and SQL-based warehousing patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with ADLS Gen2, Event Hub, ADF, Key Vault, Synapse.

job.title: AI Infrastructure Support Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: AI Infrastructure Support Engineer
Location: Lake Mary, FL
Type - Hybrid 3 days Onsite
Terms; Full Time
Salary- $140000/yr


Our client provides a range of financial products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through Securities Services, Market and Wealth Services, Investment and Wealth Management, and Other segments. The Securities Services segment offers custody, trust and depositary, accounting, exchange-traded funds, middle-office solutions, transfer agency, services for private equity and real estate funds, foreign exchange, securities lending, liquidity/lending services, and data analytics.

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways: 

  • Deliver operational support and drive issue resolution for AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, and associated production services.
  • Support the deployment, orchestration, and monitoring of AI/ML workloads across distributed environments using Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Apply hands-on expertise with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, including A100, H100, and B200 nodes, to support provisioning, utilization, performance tuning, and ongoing platform operations.
  • Build, maintain, and optimize automation scripts and tooling using Ansible, Python and Shell scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and change activity through enterprise workflow and ticketing platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across engineering, platform, and operations to implement DevOps best practices, including CI/CD using GitLab, containerized deployment models, and secure access management through Azure AD.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including runbooks, standard operating procedures, support guides, and infrastructure architecture artifacts.
  • Diagnose and resolve networking, storage, and system performance issues affecting AI infrastructure and high-performance compute workloads.
  • Participate in a rotating on-call support model, including occasional weekend coverage, to help maintain high availability and operational excellence.
 

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong experience supporting AI infrastructure, GPU platforms, or high-performance compute environments in enterprise or production settings.
  • Hands-on experience working with NVIDIA GPU nodes, including A100, H100, and B200 systems.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes and Docker for deploying, managing, and troubleshooting distributed workloads.
  • Proficiency in Ansible,  Python and Shell scripting for automation, tooling, and operational support tasks.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools, including GitLab CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and container-based delivery models.
  • Familiarity with enterprise ticketing and service management platforms such as JIRA and ServiceNow.
  • Good knowledge of networking, storage, Linux systems administration, and infrastructure troubleshooting in complex technical environments.
  • Understanding of identity and access management, including secure access controls such as Azure AD.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and provide occasional weekend support as needed.

job.title: Analytical Scientist (HPLC/UPLC)
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for an  Analytical Scientist to join a combined Analytical Development and Quality Control organization supporting a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in GMP analytical testing and hands-on HPLC/UPLC experience and be able to execute established analytical methods with minimal ramp-up time. The role will initially focus heavily on routine analytical, stability, and release testing, with opportunities to expand into analytical development and method generation as the individual gains experience within the organization.

Location: Bristol, PA
Pay: $30-40/hr DOE 
Shift: Wed. - Sat or Sun - Wed.  8am -6pm

What We're Looking For:
  • The strongest candidates will have a GMP QC/analytical testing foundation with strong HPLC/UPLC skills and the ability to begin executing established methods quickly.
  • HPLC/UPLC is a a must have!
  • Experience with every analytical technique is not required, as training will be provided.
  • Candidates who demonstrate curiosity and the ability to learn new techniques will have the opportunity to expand beyond routine testing and eventually contribute to analytical development and method generation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform routine analytical testing using HPLC and UPLC in a GMP-regulated laboratory environment.
  • Execute established analytical methods supporting release testing, stability studies, and manufacturing operations.
  • Perform analytical testing utilizing techniques such as AEX, SEC, and purity-based assays.
  • Accurately prepare samples, standards, buffers, and reagents in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Review and interpret analytical data while identifying and escalating atypical or unexpected results.
  • Maintain accurate and compliant laboratory documentation in accordance with GMP requirements.
  • Follow established SOPs, analytical methods, laboratory procedures, and data-integrity requirements.
  • Support laboratory investigations, troubleshooting, and resolution of analytical issues as appropriate.
  • Train on additional analytical techniques and instrumentation as required by the organization.
  • Collaborate with QC, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing teams to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
  • Over time, contribute to analytical method development, optimization, and method generation as experience and training progress.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and compliant laboratory environment.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant analytical laboratory experience.
  • GMP experience is required.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HPLC and/or UPLC.
  • Experience executing established analytical methods in a regulated laboratory environment.
  • Understanding of fundamental analytical chemistry principles and chromatography.
  • Ability to accurately document laboratory activities and analytical results.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team.
  • Willingness to work a flexible/rotational schedule, including potential weekend coverage, to support a seven-day manufacturing operation.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with ADC/AOC analytical testing or characterization.
  • Experience with SEC, AEX, and purity assays.
  • Experience supporting stability and release testing.
  • Experience with paper-based GMP laboratory documentation/notebooks.
  • Exposure to GC, LC-MS, or capillary electrophoresis (CE).
  • Experience with analytical method development, optimization, qualification, or validation.
  • Experience working within a combined QC and Analytical Development environment.
  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical manufacturing.

#IND-SPG

Estimated Max Rate: $40.00

Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for an Ex-Vivo Research Associate in San Diego.   Our startup biotech customer is seeking an experienced and motivated individual to contribute to exciting drug discovery programs advancing therapies for neurodegenerative diseases.  The ideal individual will have significant hands-on experience of standard biochemical, cell and molecular biology techniques including preparation of ex- vivo tissue samples.

Duration: 12 months
Shift: Onsite M-F day shift

  • Assist with cell-based assays
  • Maintain meticulous records of samples and reagents inventory

  • Ability to execute experiments accurately, on time, and according to established protocols

job.title: Azure Systems Engineer
job.description:
Azure Systems Engineer (IaC/Terraform) — Azure Infrastructure + Automation
Location: McKinney, TX (Hybrid)
Type: 6-month Contract-to-Hire (W2 only; no C2C)

Overview
This role blends hands-on operational support and project delivery to keep core cloud platforms stable, secure, and scalable. You’ll focus heavily on Azure infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Azure networking, and PowerShell automation, while partnering with DevOps to improve release readiness and production supportability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide operational support for production Azure environments, acting as an escalation point for complex infrastructure issues and driving root-cause analysis through resolution.
  • Build, enhance, and standardize Azure infrastructure using Terraform (IaC) to support repeatable deployments and environment consistency.
  • Support and troubleshoot Azure networking (e.g., VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, DNS, connectivity) and resolve network-related incidents impacting services.
  • Identify repeatable tasks and reduce operational toil using PowerShell automation (scripts, tooling, runbook-style workflows).
  • Partner with DevOps/engineering to support CI/CD and release workflows (Azure DevOps/Jenkins or similar), ensuring deployments are tested, documented, and operationally ready.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring/observability using tools such as Azure Monitor, Splunk, Dynatrace (or similar) to improve reliability and reduce time-to-detect/time-to-resolve.
  • Ensure runbooks/SOPs, validation steps, and support documentation are in place prior to production releases.
  • Assist with internal/external audits, evidence collection, remediation efforts, and adherence to security/regulatory standards.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or related) or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years in Systems Engineering / Infrastructure / IT Operations
  • Strong hands-on experience supporting Azure in production
  • Strong Terraform experience building/managing cloud infrastructure as code
  • Strong PowerShell scripting/automation experience
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Experience with monitoring/observability tools (Splunk, Azure Monitor, Dynatrace, etc.)
  • Solid networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, IP addressing) and strong troubleshooting skills
  • Proven ability to document, create runbooks, and support production operations

job.title: VP, Enterprise Applications & Digital Platforms
job.description:
Job Title:VP, Enterprise Applications & Digital Platforms
Location: NYC - Hybrid- 3 days
Terms- Full Time
Salary: $175000-$250000 + 25% bonus


Our client is  is the oldest banking association and payment infrastructure company in the United States

Position summary:

The VP, Enterprise & Digital Platforms is accountable for the strategy, governance, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of the company’s core enterprise and digital technology platforms within a regulated financial payments environment. The portfolio includes ServiceNow, Workday, Salesforce, SAP Ariba, the corporate website powered by Storyblok, Shopify, and enterprise observability capabilities including Dynatrace.

 This role combines enterprise platform leadership, process engineering, workflow automation, observability, IT asset lifecycle management, digital experience, operational resilience, and technology risk management. The VP will ensure platforms are secure, resilient, cost-effective, well-controlled, integrated, and aligned with business growth.

Operating within a lean technology organization, this leader will balance strategic leadership with hands-on engagement and partner closely with Technology, Operations, Finance, HR, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, Risk, Compliance, Security, Legal, and Audit.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities: 

Enterprise & Digital Platform Strategy

  • Define and execute the enterprise platform strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities aligned with company growth, business objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.
  • Provide executive technology ownership and governance for ServiceNow, Workday, Salesforce, SAP Ariba, Storyblok, Shopify, Dynatrace, and associated capabilities.
  • Establish clear standards for platform ownership, architecture, integration, security, data, configuration, customization, lifecycle management, and controls.
  • Drive simplification of the technology landscape by reducing unnecessary applications, integrations, customization, and technical debt.
  • Establish an out-of-the-box-first, configuration-over-customization approach across strategic SaaS platforms.
  • Maintain a pragmatic multi-year roadmap balancing business demand, innovation, risk, technical debt, cost, and available resources.

Platform Ownership & Business Enablement

  • ServiceNow: Lead strategy across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, CMDB, service mapping, workflow automation, event management, and related enterprise capabilities.
  • Workday: Partner with HR to optimize employee lifecycle processes, workflow, reporting, data quality, controls, and employee experience.
  • Salesforce: Partner with commercial teams to improve CRM, customer lifecycle management, sales effectiveness, service, workflow automation, and customer insights.
  • SAP Ariba: Partner with Finance and Procurement to improve sourcing, purchasing, supplier management, spend visibility, controls, and source-to-pay processes.
  • Storyblok / Corporate Website: Partner with Marketing and Communications to deliver secure, high-performing, accessible, and flexible corporate digital experiences.
  • Shopify: Provide technology leadership for digital commerce capabilities, ensuring appropriate security, scalability, payment integration, and operational controls.

Process Engineering, Automation & AI

  • Lead process engineering and optimization initiatives across the platform portfolio, identifying manual processes, control gaps, service failure points, and opportunities for standardization.
  • Design scalable and auditable workflows integrating business, service, asset, customer, employee, and operational data.
  • Leverage native platform automation capabilities before introducing additional applications or custom development.
  • Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, generative AI, and intelligent automation across employee, customer, procurement, sales, and technology workflows.
  • Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Data teams to ensure appropriate governance of AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Measure automation and AI investments through productivity, service, customer experience, risk-reduction, and financial outcomes.

IT Asset Management, Observability & Operational Resilience

  • Provide governance over hardware, software, cloud, virtual, and other technology asset lifecycle processes within ServiceNow.
  • Ensure asset information supports CMDB integrity, service mapping, security, financial management, license compliance, and operational decision-making.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, Security, and Vendor Management to improve asset utilization, cost transparency, and software license optimization.
  • Establish the enterprise approach to observability, monitoring, event management, and service health.
  • Own ServiceNow ITOM Event Management capabilities, including event ingestion, correlation, prioritization, noise reduction, and automated response.
  • Integrate Dynatrace and other monitoring technologies with ServiceNow to provide application, infrastructure, service, and digital-experience visibility.
  • Ensure monitoring and observability support incident management, root-cause analysis, business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.

Architecture, Integration & Data

  • Establish practical architecture and engineering standards across the enterprise platform portfolio.
  • Promote secure, reusable, API-first integration patterns and reduce fragile point-to-point integrations.
  • Establish standards for identity and access, data exchange, integrations, APIs, environments, and platform configuration.
  • Ensure platform data is accurate, governed, and available for operations, reporting, analytics, automation, and AI.
  • Partner with Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering teams to maintain a scalable target-state architecture and manage technical debt.

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Embed security, regulatory, privacy, risk, and audit requirements into platform architecture, workflows, integrations, and lifecycle processes.
  • Partner closely with Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Privacy, Internal Audit, and external auditors.
  • Ensure effective identity and access management, privileged access, segregation of duties, data protection, change controls, and audit trails.
  • Support audits, risk assessments, regulatory examinations, and remediation activities with appropriate documentation and system evidence.
  • Support applicable requirements including PCI DSS, SOX, SOC, data privacy, and internal technology-control standards.
  • Ensure critical platforms meet established business continuity, disaster recovery, and operational resilience requirements.

Delivery & Operational Excellence

  • Accountable for platform availability, performance, reliability, security, and supportability.
  • Establish appropriate SLAs, SLOs, KPIs, operational dashboards, and escalation procedures.
  • Oversee demand intake, prioritization, solution design, development, testing, release, and post-implementation validation using pragmatic Agile/SDLC practices.
  • Ensure upgrades, patches, and releases receive appropriate testing, validation, security review, and business sign-off.
  • Drive effective incident, problem, change, release, and root-cause management.
  • Balance delivery speed with appropriate security, risk, regulatory, and operational controls.

Team, Vendor & Financial Leadership

  • Build and lead a lean, high-performing enterprise and digital platforms organization with clear accountability and strong business alignment.
  • Develop platform owners, administrators, developers, analysts, and process engineers while determining the appropriate balance of internal capabilities and external partners.
  • Manage strategic SaaS providers, systems integrators, managed service providers, consultants, and technology partners.
  • Hold vendors accountable for service quality, security, delivery, contractual obligations, cost, and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Finance and Procurement on licensing, renewals, negotiations, and investment decisions.
  • Optimize license utilization and total cost of ownership while avoiding excessive vendor dependency.
  • Develop talent, succession plans, and a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and accountability.

Stakeholder Engagement & Performance Management

  • Serve as a trusted technology advisor to senior business and technology leaders.
  • Translate business, operational, financial, security, and regulatory requirements into scalable technology capabilities.
  • Communicate platform health, resilience, risk, delivery, investment priorities, and cost optimization to executive leadership.

job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title: Senior Accounting Specialist
Location: Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey

POSITION INFORMATION
Job Summary: Assist in the company’s financial closing process related to the general ledger accounts including balance sheet and profit & loss accounts in a timely manner. Maintain accuracy of company financial information while ensuring internal controls and procedures are followed.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Conduct general ledger activity related to client's business
o Journal entries
o Account reconciliations
o Account analysis
o Assist with financial statement preparation and submission to Parent company
• Maintain/update portfolio asset database system and use results to create robust reporting structure
• Comply with monthly, quarterly and annual public company reporting requirements
• Manage third party providers regarding accounting, account reconciliations and lease/loan administration system inquiries
• Coordinate daily dealer funding, including review of contracts and required supporting documentation
• Review and approve manual journal entries.
• Regular interaction with colleagues at factory/prompt response to inquiries required
• Calculate and review payoffs as requested by the business

• Handle tax request and annual audit requests.
• Ad hoc request and improvements as needed.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting and/ or Finance
Experience:
• 5-7 years of relevant accounting experience required

• Finance company experience is a plus
• Public Accounting experience is a plus
Licenses/Certifications: CPA is highly desirable
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Knowledge of Flexi financial software is a plus
• Thorough knowledge cost center and balance sheet analysis
• Knowledge of Financial statement flux analysis
• Ability to multi-task in a dynamic, ever-changing environment
• Highly proficient in Microsoft Office

job.title: Marketing Ops and Automation Specialist
job.description:
Marketing Operations & Automation Specialist
6+ month contract (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
South San Francisco, CA  (Hybrid)
 
Position Summary
Our client (confidential) is seeking a Marketing Operations & Automation Specialist to support both marketing operations and digital campaign execution. This is a hands-on, tactical role focused on building, maintaining, and improving scalable marketing workflows—while ensuring campaigns are executed on time, accurately, and with high quality.
You’ll serve as the operational backbone of the marketing team by helping improve process efficiency, data flow across systems, reporting visibility, and adoption of automation and emerging technologies (including AI).
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Own day-to-day marketing operations execution and optimization, including building and improving automated workflows across platforms such as Eloqua, HubSpot, ZoomInfo, and CRM integrations.
  • Manage marketing data operations: upload/process lists, routing, segmentation support, and data quality using tools such as RingLead (or similar).
  • Apply and experiment with AI-driven tools to improve efficiency and scalability, including:
    • Workflow automation
    • Content generation support
    • AI-assisted video/content creation
  • Build and maintain dashboards and performance reporting by integrating data across marketing and analytics platforms.
  • Ensure reporting is actionable and aligned to campaign goals and business objectives.
  • Partner with marketing leadership to evaluate, implement, and optimize marketing technology tools and operational processes.
  • Build and update landing pages using no-code/low-code tools (e.g., Ion or similar).
  • Support email marketing campaigns end-to-end (build, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, QA).
  • Assist with digital advertising campaign support, including asset coordination, tracking setup, monitoring, and performance measurement.
  • Maintain documentation, best practices, and process guidelines to enable repeatable, scalable execution.
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 3–5 years of experience in marketing operations, digital marketing, or campaign execution.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms such as:
    • Eloqua, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, or similar
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Marketing analytics & measurement
    • Data integration and multi-platform reporting
  • Experience using AI tools in marketing or demonstrated ability to quickly learn/apply new AI and automation tools.
  • Understanding of integrations between marketing automation + CRM + web + analytics tools.
  • Experience configuring and optimizing automation workflows, segmentation, and campaign setup.
  • Experience with email campaigns, landing pages, and paid digital campaigns (support/execution).
  • Comfort working with marketing data operations tools (e.g., RingLead or similar).
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge and ability to troubleshoot digital assets.
  • Ability to design, document, and improve repeatable operational processes and QA/testing practices.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive
  • Strong cross-functional communicator and collaborator
  • Comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Independent problem-solver with a process-improvement mindset
  • Curious and adaptable—especially with AI and emerging marketing technologies
