job.title: Senior Refrigeration Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Refrigeration Engineer for our Research and Development Client in Marietta, Ohio. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team!

Job Functions:
  • Design and develop cascade vapor-compression systems used in ULT freezers and cold storage platforms.
  • Develop specifications for system-level, subsystem and component performance.
  • Execute test plans to validate the performance of newly developed refrigeration systems by utilizing design for reliability tools and performance sensitivity analysis.
  • Design refrigeration systems that meet customer requirements, time to market commitments and that are within the target cost of the projects.
  • Analyze the thermal behavior of the refrigeration system with thermo-physical tools for component selection and overall refrigeration system design.
  • Ensure refrigeration designs are Designed for Compliance to meet regulatory and certification requirements (e.g., UL, IEC, FDA, CE, CSA, Energy Star).
Education and Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, systems engineering, chemical engineering, physics, or related discipline
  • Coursework in thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics strongly preferred
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience developing vapor-compression systems for cold storage or HVAC/R products, cascade systems preferred.
  • Experience using natural refrigerants and other low GWP refrigerants in system designs.
  •  Thermal system modeling, simulation, and performance testing
  •  Analyzing empirical test data to guide design decisions
  • Familiarity with data acquisition systems, automated testing, and technical documentation
  • Familiarity with Lean / PPI methodologies and continuous improvement systems.
  • Knowledge of refrigeration system testing methods and equipment

job.title: Sr. Associate Engineer - Process Development
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Sr. Associate Engineer – Process Development opportunity with a trusted, long-term client located in Waltham, MA.
 
This position is part of a major pharmaceutical company, and requires a Bachelors and/or Masters of Science and 1-2+ years of relevant experience. Schedule is full-time M-F (7am-8am start time, 8 hour shift) and may require flexibility to work some evenings and overtime due to projects.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Provide technical support for scale-up and manufacturing issues and develop solutions to improve process efficiency and product quality.
    • Scale-up
      • Perform process scale-up and Pilot batches
      • Generate and execute scale down models for GMP manufacturing
      • Generate scale-down models to assist with process scale-up
    • Solution Development
      • Generate process changes to address process issues
    • Lead and assist implementation of Digital Tools
      • Assist with the implementation and use of digital tools for inventory management, genealogy, and sample submission
      • Assist with the implementation and use of digital tools for process data acquisition (Electronic lab notebooks and Electronic Batch Records.)
    • Assist with project activities for the design and technology transfer of mRNA manufacturing processes by contributing and reviewing of Batch Records/Master Production Records (MBR) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
      • Tech Transfer
        • Assist with Tech Transfer batches
        • Support knowledge packages for Tech Transfer
      • Document Generation
        • Assist with the review MBRs
        • Assist with the review SOPs
      • Troubleshoot process/analytical issues that occur during scale-ups and/or in production of drug substance and drug product.
        • Contact vendors for equipment support
        • Conduct investigations using techniques such as 5 why’s, Fishbone diagrams, etc.
        • Determine the root cause of process/analytical issues
        • Develop solutions to process/analytical issues
      • Effectively communicate with cross functional teams like Analytical Development, R&D, Process Development, Quality Assurance (QA), Project Management, Regulatory Affairs and Legal teams.
        • Provide Samples to AD
        • Obtain data from AD and compile into reports
        • Obtain processes from R&D and PD and implement at-scale
        • Generate procedures (SOPs, MBRs, Protocols) and work with QA on review and approval
        • Review and follow QA procedures
      • Assist in the preparation of technical reports and presentations that support scale-up activities and process improvements.
        • Technical reports
          • Generate/review Technical reports such as batch summaries, process descriptions, Tech transfer, etc.
        • Presentations
          • Present on batch performance, technical issues, etc.
 
Qualifications:
  • 1+ (Masters) or 2+ (Bachelors) years of relevant experience is required
  • A Bachelor’s degree and/or Master’s degree in Chemical engineering, Biomedical engineering or related field.
  • Demonstrated experience in process development, manufacturing, tech transfer, and/or scale-up to support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals (1+ year) is required
  • Experience with mRNA Drug Substance is strongly preferred

job.title: Signal Technician / Trainer
job.description:
Join a dynamic team committed to transforming traffic management with innovative solutions! As a Traffic Signal Technician / Trainer, you’ll play a vital role in empowering our partners—distributors, agencies, and contractors—to independently install and maintain cutting-edge traffic technology across California, Arizona, and Nevada. This is your chance to make a tangible impact on public safety and traffic flow while advancing your technical expertise and leadership skills.

Overview
In this hands-on, field-centered role, you'll be the go-to expert for everything Signals —leading training sessions, troubleshooting installations, and supporting project success. Balancing on-site activities with remote collaboration, you’ll ensure our hardware and software solutions are expertly deployed and maintained, championing quality and efficiency at every step.

Key Responsibilities

  • Train and empower partners on hardware installation, system integration, and software management using tools like Download Manager and Installation Assistant.
  • Lead physical installation efforts, working directly in the field to troubleshoot, validate, and optimize deployments.
  • Support project through remote QA, ensuring installations meet standards and providing technical guidance to partners.
  • Collaborate with sales and project teams by reviewing documentation, preparing equipment, and planning installation workflows.
  • Act as the subject matter expert on traffic signal hardware, intersection cabinet architecture, and system integration.
  • Travel approximately 40% to install sites, conduct training, and troubleshoot onsite.
Must-Have Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of traffic signal/ITS field experience.
  • IMSA Level II certification (Level III a plus, or ability to obtain within a few months).
  • Deep knowledge of intersection cabinet architecture and hardware.
  • Field girt with the ability to work calmly under pressure and handle physical installations and troubleshooting.
  • Comfortable with travel and working in diverse environments.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence to lead groups and technical discussions.
This opportunity offers a competitive salary of $100k, with flexibility for the right candidate. If you’re a hands-on traffic tech who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys educating others, we want to hear from you. Apply now and be part of shaping smarter, safer roads!

job.title: Senior Solution Architect, Cloud, DevSecOps & Platform Engineering
job.description:
Solution Architect (AWS & Azure)
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Technical Strategy
  • Define and own the target-state architecture for cloud, infrastructure, and platform engineering environments across AWS and Azure.
  • Design scalable, resilient, and secure reference architectures for networking, storage, identity, and container/orchestration platforms.
  • Establish architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for infrastructure-as-code, cloud landing zones, and platform services.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud, infrastructure, and platform technologies and provide recommendations to modernize the technology stack.
  • Lead architecture reviews and governance forums to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and long-term strategy.
  • Architect and guide the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices across the organization, leveraging tools such as Azure DevOps, Harness, and GitLab.
  • Define the architecture for embedding security into the software development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, and vulnerability management tooling.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to design self-service infrastructure, automation, and developer enablement capabilities.
  • Champion policy-as-code, secure configuration management, and compliance automation across cloud and platform environments.
  • Define architecture and standards for observability and monitoring using tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and Datadog.
  • Guide the design of monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks to improve reliability and reduce time to detect and resolve issues.
  • Champion site reliability engineering (SRE) principles, including SLIs/SLOs and proactive capacity and performance planning, across architecture decisions.
  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a team of architects and engineers, fostering technical growth and career development.
  • Set team goals, manage performance, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, application development, and business stakeholders to align architecture decisions with business priorities.
  • Communicate architecture strategy, trade-offs, and risk clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate third-party tools and platforms that support the architecture roadmap.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field required.
  • AWS and/or Azure architecture certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+) and/or Kubernetes certifications a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure, or platform engineering, including 3+ years in a people leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on expertise designing and implementing solutions on AWS and Azure, including compute, networking, storage, and identity services.
  • Proven experience architecting DevSecOps pipelines using Azure DevOps, Harness, and/or GitLab, including embedded SAST and DAST security scanning.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and/or Datadog.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation) and container/orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Proven track record influencing enterprise architecture decisions and driving alignment across cross-functional and executive stakeholders.  
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure SDLC, and cloud security best practices.
  • Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical depth.
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
  • Business acumen in technology transformation and cloud cost management

job.title: Consultant Reporting and Analytics, Global Safety Systems - Hybrid, Cambridge, MA
job.description:
Consultant Reporting and Analytics, Global Safety Systems - Hybrid, Cambridge, MA
  Overview
In this hybrid role based in Cambridge, MA, you will partner with Safety and Risk Management teams to develop, test, and validate cutting-edge reporting solutions. Your work will support critical safety activities, including medical monitoring, signal detection, and regulatory reporting, ensuring compliance and enhancing safety processes across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with safety stakeholders to create and refine safety data reports, visualizations, and listings using pharmacovigilance tools like PV Reports, Oracle Analytics Server, OBIEE, BI Publisher, or Cognos. Experience with PV Reports is preferred.
  • Generate and deliver formal safety reports, summaries, and listings to support regulatory and monitoring needs, including PBRERs and DSURs.
  • Document reporting requirements, complete data request forms, and coordinate with external database service providers to ensure timely and accurate outputs.
  • Perform quality checks on outputs from service providers, identify discrepancies, and work with teams to resolve issues promptly.
  • Support system monitoring activities, including overseeing ETL processes and scheduled report execution, to maintain reliable reporting workflows.
  • Assist in the qualification and validation of safety systems and reporting solutions, including report validation activities, to meet compliance standards.
  • Contribute to ongoing departmental responsibilities related to regulatory adherence and ICH guidelines for adverse event and product complaint reporting.
Must-Have Requirements

  • Experience with pharmacovigilance reporting tools such as PV Reports, Oracle Analytics Server, OBIEE, BI Publisher, or Cognos (PV Reports experience preferred).
  • Strong ability to generate reports, analyze safety data, and support safety monitoring activities.
  • Ability to document requirements, complete data requests, and coordinate with external partners.
  • Knowledge of validation, quality checks, and system monitoring activities related to safety reporting.
Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with PV Reports.
  • Knowledge of regulatory standards related to safety reporting and compliance.

job.title: Transmission Engineer
job.description:
Transmission Engineer - Transmission & Distribution

Join a dynamic team at the forefront of energy infrastructure development as a Transmission Engineer specializing in Transmission & Distribution. This vital role offers the opportunity to design and deliver cutting-edge projects across high voltage transmission lines—both underground and overhead—in regions like Minneapolis and Duluth. Be part of a collaborative environment that shapes the future of power delivery, working through all project phases from conception to construction, ensuring reliable, efficient, and innovative transmission solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited program (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in transmission engineering, with 5+ years preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of civil/structural engineering techniques, codes (NESC, NERC, FERC), and standards.
  • Proficiency with design software such as CAD and PLS-CADD.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to analyze, problem-solve, and apply critical thinking in complex environments.
  • Experience in preparing specifications, technical bid summaries, and reports.
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior consulting experience in transmission or civil engineering projects.
  • Successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam or EIT certification.
  • Experience performing economic conductor selection, grounding calculations, and lightning performance studies.
  • Knowledge of project management and client communication.
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil or related Engineering Technology; a Master’s in Civil Engineering is a plus.
  • At least 3 years of relevant transmission engineering experience, with a preference for 5+ years.
  • Hands-on experience with project design, field inspections, and technical report compilation.
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel up to 10% for project site visits.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to work in both office and field environments.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and timely project delivery.
Step into a transformative role where your expertise guides the development of essential energy infrastructure. Bring your skills to a team that values innovation and dedication—apply now and help shape the future of transmission systems!

job.title: Endpoint Support Engineer - Onsite in NYC
job.description:
ENDPOINT SUPPORT ENGINEER OPPORTUNITY - ONSITE IN NYC
  • 6 month contract
  • onsite 5 days/week
  • $60-70/hr on W2 
*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. No C2C!!

Job Summary

The Endpoint Support Engineer provides dedicated, on-site technical support and endpoint engineering for faculty/staff endpoints as well as specialty arts, media, and performance spaces on the Northeastern University New York City campus. The role combines hands-on lab and studio support with endpoint administration in Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune.

A primary focus of this engagement is migrating lab, studio, and teaching devices onto Northeastern standard management, security, and software delivery, then stabilizing those environments so they run reliably for instruction, production, and performance. The engineer serves as the on-the-ground technical lead for these spaces, working closely with faculty, lab managers, the central Endpoint Engineering team, network and security teams, college technology teams, and on-site ITS staff.

The ideal candidate is a self-directed technologist who is equally comfortable building a Jamf or Intune policy, activating a license on a studio workstation, and explaining a fix to a faculty member minutes before class. The role requires sound judgment about what to fix immediately on site and what to route through standard ITS processes.

Schedule and business continuity

Standard hours are Monday through Friday 8am-5pm, on site in New York City. The role requires occasional early morning, evening, or weekend availability to support term start, scheduled productions and performances, maintenance windows, and urgent issues that block instruction.

2. Minimum Qualifications

•    3+ years of experience in endpoint administration, desktop engineering, or advanced technical support in a mixed macOS and Windows environment.

•    Hands-on experience administering Jamf Pro, including configuration profiles, policies, smart groups, PreStage enrollment, Self Service, and package deployment.

•    Working experience with Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot, compliance and configuration policies, and Win32 app deployment.

•    Strong macOS troubleshooting skills, including permissions, privacy and security settings (TCC/PPPC), screen sharing and remote management, and OS upgrades.

•    Experience supporting creative, media, or engineering software in a lab or studio environment, including network or per-device license activation.

•    Experience with Apple School/Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment.

•    Scripting ability in zsh/bash and PowerShell to automate common endpoint tasks.

•    Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewall ports) sufficient to diagnose license server and remote management connectivity.

•    Experience documenting work in an ITSM platform such as ServiceNow.

•    Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work directly with faculty, students, and non-technical stakeholders.

•    Ability to work on site in New York City 5 days per week and travel between campus buildings.

•    Ability to lift up to 40 lbs, work under desks and in tight spaces, and stand for extended periods.

Preferred Qualifications

•    Jamf Certified Admin (JCA) or Jamf Certified Expert (JCE); Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102); Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP).

•    Experience administering Avid Pro Tools, Adobe Admin Console and Creative Cloud packaging, Vectorworks, or Sassafras KeyServer licensing.

•    Familiarity with audio interfaces, MIDI devices, NDI, video capture, and theater or live production technology.

•    Experience with device management migrations, tenant consolidations, or mergers.

•    Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Entra ID groups and Conditional Access.

•    Experience in a higher education IT environment.


3. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Faculty, Staff, Specialty Lab, and Studio Endpoint Support

•    Provide on-site support for faculty/staff, arts, media, audio, design, and performance labs, studios, and teaching spaces, including computer labs, cart rooms, theater and production spaces, and student loaner devices.

•    Install, configure, license, and troubleshoot specialty creative and production software, including Adobe Creative Cloud, Avid Pro Tools, Vectorworks, Final Draft, Isadora, NDI Tools, and subscription audio plugins that require per-device activation.

•    Verify lab and teaching space readiness before each term and before scheduled productions, performances, and events.

•    Respond to in-class and production-critical blockers on site, and coordinate with classroom AV support when issues cross into room technology.

•    Gather software, version, and seat requirements from faculty and lab managers and route new requests through standard ITS intake channels.

Endpoint Management and Migration

•    Administer macOS and Windows devices in Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune, including configuration profiles, policies, smart and dynamic groups, compliance policies, and Self Service catalogs.

•    Migrate devices from legacy management platforms into Northeastern Jamf and Intune tenants, including Apple School/Business Manager reassignment, Automated Device Enrollment, device wipe and re-enrollment, and Windows Autopilot hash collection and group tagging.

•    Package, deploy, and patch applications (macOS PKG/DMG, App Store/VPP, Win32, Microsoft 365) and keep operating systems at consistent, supported versions across lab fleets.

•    Apply Northeastern security baselines, including Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, FileVault, BitLocker, recovery locks, and local admin controls.

•    Diagnose and resolve enrollment, profile, policy, and app delivery failures, and escalate platform-level issues to the central Endpoint Engineering team.

Lab Infrastructure and Licensing

•    Support network license and distribution servers for specialty software (for example Avid, Vectorworks, and Sassafras KeyServer), and validate client connectivity to centrally hosted license services.

•    Partner with network, firewall, and identity teams to submit and test port, VLAN, wireless, and access requests that lab software and remote management depend on.

•    Identify, document, and help retire unsupported or insecure legacy servers and equipment in lab spaces and network closets.

•    Maintain accurate hardware and software inventory by room, including seat counts, license terms, and renewal dates.

General On-Site Client Support

•    Provide in-person technical support to faculty, staff, and students on the New York City campus, and serve as backup to the on-site Tech Bar during peak periods.

•    Troubleshoot hardware, account access, Microsoft 365, printing, and connectivity issues, and perform device setup, imaging, and hardware swaps.

•    Document all work in ServiceNow, meet incident and request response targets, and escalate to the appropriate ITS teams.

Documentation and Knowledge Transfer

•    Create and maintain runbooks, lab build standards, software inventories, and knowledge base articles for each supported space.

•    Transition ongoing lab operations and documentation to permanent ITS staff and the Endpoint Engineering team before the contract ends.

Contract Details

•    Term: Full-time 6-month engagement. Northeastern may extend the engagement based on project needs, funding, and performance.

•    Location: On site at the Northeastern University New York City campus. Remote work is limited to approved exceptions.

•    Equipment and access: Northeastern provides required systems access, administrative tooling, and a university-issued device.

•    Management: The contractor takes day-to-day direction from Northeastern leadership and follows ITS change, security, and service management processes.

•    Background check: Candidates must complete a background check before starting.

Join a dynamic engineering team leading innovative structural design projects that make a real impact across diverse sectors including power, healthcare, industrial, military, and more. job.title: Program Manager (Cybersecurity AI)
job.description:
Program Manager (Cybersecurity AI)
6+ month contact
Fort Mill, SC, Austin, TX, or Boston, MA (Hybrid)

The Program Manager will support the Cybersecurity organization’s AI Security initiatives, coordinating multiple teams and projects to ensure alignment, track progress, manage dependencies, and provide consolidated status reporting to executive leadership. This role will combine program management responsibilities with hands-on Scrum Master support to help teams meet established delivery enablement standards.

Key Responsibilities
  • Program Management: Coordinate multiple projects and teams across AI Security initiatives, consolidating progress, milestones, risks, and dependencies into an overall program view.
  • Executive Reporting: Provide clear, consolidated program status updates and reporting to leadership and partner organizations that own the broader AI initiatives.
  • Agile/Scrum Support: Provide hands-on Scrum Master support, facilitate stand-ups and other Agile ceremonies, and help teams improve their Scrum practices.
  • Dependency and Impediment Management: Proactively identify and manage cross-team dependencies, remove blockers, and support timely delivery.
  • Delivery Standards Compliance: Ensure teams adhere to LPL’s established delivery enablement standards and SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) practices.
  • Jira and Confluence Management: Maintain strong Jira usage for work tracking, backlog management, and status reporting, with Confluence supporting documentation and collaboration.
  • AI Security Initiatives: Support projects across areas such as secure browser protection, AI firewall, endpoint control, red teaming, API security, and AI vaulting.
  • AI Tool Adoption: Leverage AI tools to improve productivity and automate deliverables, including presentations, dashboards, and reporting.
Required Qualifications
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant program/project management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and Agile delivery environments.
  • Hands-on Scrum Master experience, including facilitating ceremonies and coaching teams on Scrum practices.
  • Strong Jira proficiency; experience with Confluence is also important.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams, dependencies, impediments, and program-level reporting.
  • Ability to consolidate project-level details into executive-level updates and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
  • Experience working within structured delivery frameworks and enforcing established standards
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity, AI security, or technology initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, and Claude.
  • Experience using AI to automate reporting, build dashboards, and create presentations.
  • Relevant Agile/SAFe certifications are beneficial, but practical experience is the priority.

job.title: Head of Portfolio Architecture, Corporate Functions
job.description:
Head of Portfolio Architecture, Corporate Functions
Direct Hire (Base + Bonus)
Work Location (Hybrid): 3 days/week onsite — New York, NY, Holmdel, NJ, or Bethlehem, PA
 
We’re prioritizing candidates with:
  • Insurance industry architecture leadership experience
  • Architecture & technology alignment at portfolio scale (not just solution design)
  • Strong governance mindset that enables speed, not blocks it
  • Executive presence and proven ability to influence investment/roadmaps
 
Key Responsibilities
Portfolio Architecture Leadership
  • Drive cohesive architecture across multiple value streams, ensuring end-to-end design consistency across platforms, products, and capabilities.
  • Own the Corporate Functions target-state architecture, portfolio roadmap, architecture priorities, and investment influence.
  • Advance modern platform architecture across cloud, data, integration, and AI capabilities.
  • Improve engineering productivity and delivery speed by defining architecture patterns, guardrails, and operating models that scale.
  • Partner with Solution Architects to establish scalable patterns and with enterprise architecture leadership for cross-portfolio alignment and trade-offs.
  • Serve as the primary architecture advisor to the Corporate Functions digital/technology leadership team, shaping strategy, priorities, and transformation sequencing.
  • Manage and develop a team of Solution Architects; raise architecture maturity across the portfolio.
  • Be available for high-impact production incidents affecting business operations.
 
Investment & Roadmap Influence
  • Shape and influence strategic investments across Corporate Functions (HR, Legal, Finance, Risk, Investments).
  • Guide architecture across core enterprise platforms such as Workday, Oracle, and ServiceNow, plus integration/API ecosystem enablement.
  • Balance near-term delivery commitments with long-term sustainability.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, increase reuse, and accelerate time-to-market—driving simplification across business units, not just within the portfolio.
 
End-to-End Enterprise / Insurance Architecture Ownership
  • Drive holistic architecture across:
    • Business processes and operating value streams
    • Core and surrounding application ecosystems
    • Integration and event-driven architectures
    • AI/ML use cases (e.g., underwriting/claims automation, fraud, personalization)
    • Digital experiences for customers, distribution partners (agents/brokers), and internal users
  • Ensure solutions meet regulatory, risk, security, privacy, and resiliency requirements (e.g., SOX/SOC expectations, data privacy).
  • Promote cloud-native, API-first, data-centric, and AI-enabled patterns where appropriate.
 
Governance, Risk & Compliance
  • Define/enforce architecture principles and guardrails aligned to enterprise standards and insurance regulatory expectations.
  • Lead or participate in architecture review and governance forums; ensure decisions are auditable and practical.
  • Partner with security, risk, compliance, and legal stakeholders to support operational resilience and auditability.
 
Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Corporate Functions leaders and senior technology leadership.
  • Represent architecture trade-offs in enterprise forums and influence outcomes across business units.
  • Communicate architectural direction, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor and develop architects across the portfolio.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 7+ years in technology/architecture roles, with significant experience in the insurance industry (or similarly regulated financial services with deep insurance exposure).
  • Proven experience as a Portfolio / Domain / Product / Enterprise Architect in a large, regulated environment.
  • Deep understanding of insurance operations and systems (policy, underwriting, claims, billing, distribution) and how they connect to enterprise platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of Corporate Functions ecosystems: HR, Legal, Finance, Risk, Investments.
  • Expertise across enterprise architecture domains: business, application, data, integration, AI, and digital.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders on technology strategy and investment decisions.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, modern integration patterns, data platforms, and applied AI capabilities.
  • Solid grasp of regulatory, risk, compliance, and resiliency expectations in regulated environments.

job.description:
Solutions Architect – Corporate Functions (Finance, Risk, Investments)
Direct Hire
Hybrid (NY/NJ/CT/PA)
 
Overview
We’re seeking a Solutions Architect to drive solution design and delivery architecture across a portfolio supporting corporate functions including Finance, Risk, and Investments. This role requires a strong blend of enterprise architecture + hands-on engineering mindset, with the ability to partner directly with business stakeholders and present technical direction to senior leaders.
This is a highly visible role where you will influence solution strategy, guide delivery teams, and ensure designs align to architecture standards, security requirements, and modern engineering practices.
 
Work Location / Schedule
Hybrid (3 days onsite per week) — candidates must be able to work onsite in one of the following locations:
  • New Jersey (Holmdel area)
  • New York, NY
  • Stamford, CT
  • Bethlehem, PA
 
What You’ll Do
  • Own product/team-level solution architecture and delivery design within a value stream.
  • Design and document end-to-end architectures across application, integration, data, and infrastructure.
  • Partner with product owners and technical leads to align roadmaps, MVP scope, and trade-offs.
  • Ensure solutions align to architecture standards, security requirements, and established patterns/guardrails.
  • Collaborate with enterprise/platform teams to reuse shared capabilities and reduce duplication.
  • Identify and help remove technical dependencies and delivery impediments.

  • Continuously seek opportunities to reduce technical debt, simplify designs, and improve delivery efficiency.

  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale technology solutions.
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, data integration, and modern application architectures.
  • Experience designing hybrid architectures (mix of on-prem + public cloud).
  • Experience working in Agile / product-based delivery models.
  • Strong communication skills—able to translate technical concepts for business partners and delivery stakeholders.
  • Experience producing technical design documentation at product/team level.
  • Background supporting business-critical systems in regulated environments; insurance domain experience is highly desirable.

Seeking a Software Test Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Kotlin, Python, and CI/CD automation for Android and iOS applications. job.title: Senior Vehicle Software Integration Engineer
job.description:
Senior Vehicle Software Integration Engineer

We are building the next generation of electric vehicles from first principles. As a Senior Vehicle Software Integration Engineer, you will play a critical role in bringing together in-house developed software, supplier ECUs, and multi-domain systems into a cohesive vehicle-level experience. You will lead the technical execution of software integration activities across domains (chassis, powertrain, body, ADAS, thermal, infotainment) and ensure that each software drop is tested, validated, and debugged in both virtual environments and prototype vehicles.

This is a hands-on, senior technical role where you will define integration strategies, drive vehicle bring-up, and mentor engineers on best practices for software/hardware integration.

Responsibilities
 
  • Lead vehicle-level software integration across all domains, ensuring compatibility of in-house and supplier ECUs.
  • Define and manage integration strategies, test plans, and regression loops for pre-merge and post-merge software releases.
  • Own and operate prototype vehicle bring-up, including flashing, network validation (CAN/LIN/FlexRay/Ethernet), and feature smoke testing.
  • Drive root-cause analysis of cross-domain software/hardware issues, coordinating with domain software teams and suppliers.
  • Establish and maintain vehicle-level SIL/HIL “virtual car” environments for automated regression testing.
  • Collaborate with Release Engineering to develop efficient software flashing, build, and logging pipelines.
  • Define and maintain interface specifications (signals, diagnostics, timing budgets, communication protocols) across domains.
  • Partner with calibration and attribute teams to ensure vehicle-level attributes (driveability, responsiveness, safety, NVH) are met.
  • Provide technical mentorship to junior integration engineers and operators.
  • Support vehicle testing at proving grounds, winter test sites, and internal fleet usage.


Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in automotive software or systems integration, with at least 3 years at vehicle-level scope.
  • Strong knowledge of embedded automotive ECUs (chassis, powertrain, body, ADAS, thermal).
  • Proficient in vehicle communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet).
  • Experience with diagnostics (UDS, OBD-II, DoIP) and flashing tools.
  • Hands-on experience with HIL/SIL environments and prototype vehicle bring-up.
  • Familiarity with tools: CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, Vector tools, dSPACE, ETAS, Python/C++ scripting.
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills across hardware/software boundaries.
  • Understanding of functional safety (ISO 26262) and ASPICE processes is a plus.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, prototype-heavy environment with limited documentation.
  • Willingness to travel to proving grounds and remote test sites.

Prototype Vehicle Technician

• Build/assemble state of the art automotive prototype vehicle and test benches
• Diagnose, maintain, and repair vehicles and test bench systems
• Work efficiently within a multidisciplinary cooperative environment on prototype, pre-production, show, and production vehicles.

job.title: Senior Speech and Language Specialist
job.description:
Yoh Heathcare has a direct hire opportunity for a Senior Speech and Language Specialist to joint our client in New Brunswick, NJ

Overview
As a Senior Speech and Language Specialist, you'll play a vital role in assessing and supporting students with diverse communication, feeding, and social needs. Working directly with children, adolescents, and young adults, you'll develop and implement tailored interventions that promote independence and social engagement. This position offers an enriching environment where your expertise can inspire growth and transform lives, all within a supportive academic community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive evaluations of students' speech, language, feeding, and social skills.
  • Analyze diagnostic tests, observations, and input from families and educators to inform personalized treatment plans.
  • Develop, implement, and adjust therapeutic interventions, providing both direct and indirect therapy in individual and small group settings.
  • Monitor student progress meticulously, ensuring interventions are effective and aligned with their educational goals.
  • Participate proactively in IEP meetings and parent conferences, fostering strong collaboration among families, teachers, and Child Study Teams.
  • Train and consult with staff and families to ensure consistency and integration of goals across settings.
  • Support behavioral programs and engage in physically active activities, including crisis management when necessary.
Must-Have Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Speech-Language Pathology or an equivalent field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, especially with students with autism.
  • Current New Jersey Speech-Language Specialist certification or eligibility.
  • NJ Department of Education Speech Language Specialist Standard Certificate.
  • Valid NJ State Licensure in Speech Pathology.
  • Comfort working fully on-site in a busy, active educational environment.
Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC).
  • Strong school-based clinical background.
  • ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) or Clinical Fellow (CF).
What's In it for you?
  • Medical, prescription drug, and dental coverage
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and various leave programs
  • Competitive retirement benefits, including defined contribution plans and voluntary tax-deferred savings options
  • Employee and dependent educational benefits (when applicable)
  • Life insurance coverage
  • Employee discount programs

job.title: Process Engineer I
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring Process Engineer I for our diagnostics customer in Longmont, CO.  The ideal candidate will have 1-5 years of experience in a similar industry, and exposure to ISO 9001 facilities. The primary areas this person will be supporting will be around general assembly (laserwelding, pouching, overcoating), with some secondary support for our automated equipment and Solidworks drawings.  We are looking for someone with experience in troubleshooting, root cause analysis, continuous improvement, within a manufacturing environment. 

Location: Longmont, CO
Shift: M- F day shift

Responsibilities
  • Provides technical & sustaining support to operations utilizing root cause analysis and continuous improvement principles.
  • Perform equipment maintenance.
  • Recommends and implements equipment and process modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products.
  • Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting physical cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality.
  • Active database and data management allowing for process performance assessment via GR&R, Yield Tracking and Cpk analysis.
  • Accurately documents all work products to ensure equipment qualifications and in line with and follow IQ, OQ, PQ requirements.
  • Interacts with design staff to ensure that processes and designs are compatible with existing equipment.
  • Translate design requirements into production by defining, designing and/or communicating efficient and capable process tooling.
  • Author documents including but not limited to manufacturing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and detailed work instructions(WIs).
  • Trains manufacturing staff on proper processes to follow when operating equipment, including wave-guide instrument(s).
  • Follow all safety rules and protocols.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required; master’s degree preferred.
  • Zero to five (0-5) years prior experience in an R&D or production  environment with proven success of process improvement and scale-up projects.
  • Experience in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO, etc.) preferred.
  • Experience in invitro diagnostics

job.title: Semiconductor Engineering Process Technician
job.description:
Gaveyard Semiconductor Engineering Process Technician needed for an 18-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Santa Clara, California.


Pay Rate $28-$32 per hour


Shift available- Weekday Night Shift, Mon-Thurs 9am-7pm


The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change


What You Will Be Doing:
  • FIB Technician Key Responsibilities:
  • Prepares samples for experiments include cleaning samples, mount / un-mount samples, loading FOUPs, prepare jobs for experimentation, to help evaluates performance of process system 
  • Prepare transmission electron microscope (TEM) lamella samples by focused ion beam (FIB) and help to optimize sample prep procedure and conditions, identify cutting location based on pattern instructions. 
  • Operate metrology tools in FIB & TEM lab to help understand cross section or top view critical dimension (CD), energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) analysis, take high-quality imaging pending on job assignment, identify all of patterns of interest, understand image quality requirement and sample/beam interaction to determine optimized condition, finish requested jobs under limited supervision after training.
  • Understand basic scanning electron microscopy (SEM)/Focused Ion Beam (FIB)/Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) principle.
  • Perform SEM/FIB/TEM system, perform routine maintenance procedures, flash, plasma clean, image calibrations etc. 
  • Perform routine shut down procedure. Identify problem put tool down and call for service. Coordinates instrument repair and maintenance. 
  • Order equipment and supplies, and coordinates with vendors and purchasing. Interface with requestors, understand their detail requirement, and communicate on results, Coordinates with engineering on job request status.
  • Help lab on monitoring job in the queue and maintaining lab throughput.
  • Document redo and lesson learn to lower redo rate
  • Pick up and drop off customer coupons from other labs if needed · Adhere to lab protocol and SOP's
  • Operate semiconductor process and metrology equipment in a lab environment
  • Supporting Clean Room Metrology Lab operations
  • Coordinates with engineering on samples priorities
  • Mounting, dismounting, cleaning and handling customer samples – coupons and wafers
  • Tracking and maintaining order of the incoming jobs and their execution
  • Knowledgeably operates laboratory process equipment and instrumentation
  • Execution of metrology jobs by using developed BKMs and available recipes on SEM metrology tools
  • Performing analysis of metrology images with company proprietary algorithms and SW, with predefined (available) recipes
  • Report preparation according to predefined template
  • Interface with requestors, understand their detail requirement, and communicate on results; help lab on monitoring wafer in process (WIP) and maintaining throughpu
  • Interface with HW team, HW troubleshooting, execute tool maintenance

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • Have a college degree in Material, electrical, chemistry engineering, or a related field.
  • Basic data analytics skill
  • Able to be hands-on for lab operations, including sample handing and equipment operations.
  • Team player
  • Semiconductor experience is nice to have, but not a must.
  • Have 0-2 years of experience



Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Ability to work in team and individually
  • Knowledge / experience with Semiconductor and SEM metrology tools is a plus

job.title: Sr. Engineer - Process Development
job.description:
Sr. Engineer - Process Development
Primary Duties: The Sr. Engineer reports to Principal Engineer and is an integral part of mRNA Drug Substance Process Development team. This position offers opportunities to focus on mRNA drug substance process development, manufacturing, regulatory and analytical support, validation, and data review for drug substances and drug products. The Engineer is responsible for leading and assisting the development and execution of scalable and robust processes for drug substance. This position will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for process knowledge transfer for drug substance to support current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) manufacturing.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
40%
    • Provide technical support for scale-up and manufacturing issues, and develop solutions to improve process efficiency and product quality
    • Scale-up:
      • Lead/Perform process scale-up and Pilot batches
      • Generate and execute scale down models for GMP manufacturing
      • Generate scale-down models to assist with process scale-up
40%
    • Lead and assist implementation of Digital Tools
      • Lead implementation of digital tools for process data acquisition (Electronic lab notebooks and Electronic Batch Records.)
10%
    • Lead project activities for the design of mRNA manufacturing processes by contributing and reviewing of Batch Records/Master Production Records (MBR) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
    • Document Generation
      • Author and review MBRs
      • Author and review SOPs
      • Effectively communicate with cross functional teams like Manufacturing Analytical
5%
    • Development, R&D, Process Development, Quality Assuance (QA), Project Management, Regulatory Affairs and Legal teams.
    • Work with internal and external manufacturing on harmonization of electronic batch records.
    • Work with Digital team withing PD and CMC on the implementation of eBRs and data capture strategy.
    • Obtain processes from R&D and PD and implement at-scale.
    • Generate procedures (SOPs, MBRs, Protocols) and work with QA on review and approval
    • Review and follow QA procedures.
5%
    • Assist in the preparation of technical reports and presentations that support scale-up activities and process improvements
    • Technical reports (2.5%)
      • Generate/review Technical reports such as batch summaries, process descriptions, Tech transfer, etc.
    • Presentations (2.5%)
    • Present on batch performance, technical issues, etc.

Education and Experience Requirements:
    • 6+ (Masters) or 8+ (Bachelors) years of relevant experience is required.
    • A Bachelor’s degree and/or Master’s degree in Chemical engineering, Biomedical engineering or related field.

Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:
    • Demonstrated experience in process development, tech transfer, and/or scale-up to support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals is required.
    • Experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, MSAT, and/or Process Development (PD) is required (4+ years).
    • Experience with mRNA Drug Substance is strongly preferred. 
    • Experience implementing and maintaining electronic batch records (eBRs) is required (1+ years).  Experience using Tempo Apprentice strongly preferred.

job.title: Production & Assembly Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Production & Assembly Technician in Austin, TX.

This is a hands-on technical manufacturing role supporting the assembly, testing, and quality of analytical instrumentation and equipment used in industrial and energy applications. The technician will work with electrical control panels, wiring and cabling, flow cells, fiber-optic components, and other electromechanical assemblies.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience assembling and testing electrical or electromechanical equipment, can read electrical schematics and technical drawings, is comfortable using a multimeter, and has experience troubleshooting and testing completed assemblies.

Title: Production & Assembly Technician
Location: Austin, TX 78758
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM (schedule may vary)
Pay: $24–$26/hr
Employment Type: Temp-to-Hire

Key Responsibilities:
  • Assemble NIR analyzer control panels, flow cells, fiber-optic cables, and other electromechanical products according to production procedures, technical drawings, and customer specifications.
  • Perform electrical assembly, wiring, cabling, component installation, and mechanical assembly using hand and power tools.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings, and work instructions.
  • Perform electrical acceptance testing and functional testing of components and completed assemblies.
  • Perform optical testing of fiber-optic cables and related assemblies and approve completed products for shipment.
  • Use a multimeter to perform electrical measurements and troubleshooting.
  • Work safely with 120VAC electrical systems.
  • Troubleshoot assembly and testing issues and identify the source of electrical, mechanical, or component-related problems.
  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot production equipment and tools.
  • Perform quality inspections and document test results, non-conformances, and other required QC information.
  • Create, maintain, and archive production and quality documentation.
  • Follow all applicable safety, quality, and production procedures while maintaining a clean and organized work environment.

Required Qualifications:
  • Associate degree in Electrical or Mechanical Technology, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant hands-on experience assembling and testing electrical, electromechanical, mechanical, or fluid-handling systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to read and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, technical drawings, and work instructions.
  • Hands-on experience using a multimeter for electrical testing and troubleshooting.
  • Comfortable working with 120VAC electrical systems.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot problems rather than simply identify them.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to follow written, verbal, and diagrammed instructions accurately.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to document production and QC results.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, technical manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience building electrical control panels or industrial equipment.
  • Experience with wire harnesses, cable assemblies, connectors, crimping, or electrical terminations.
  • Experience with fiber-optic cables, optical testing, or instrumentation.
  • Experience assembling or testing analytical instrumentation, industrial equipment, or fluid-handling systems.
  • Experience troubleshooting electrical and mechanical equipment in a production environment.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Nurse Practitioner/Physicians Assistant -Occupational Health
job.description:
Part-time Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant-Occupational Health (1st shift) needed for an opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Moraine, OH.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant
  • Occupational Health/Employee Health/Urgent Care/Emergency Medicine

Hours: 24 hours/week-flexible-6am-2:30 pm

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Performs emergency care for occupational and non-occupational injuries and illnesses for employees.
  • Renders on site medical care for non-emergency occupational injuries and illnesses, including assessment, diagnosis, and appropriate treatment
  • Performs assessments and dispositions for employee Surveillance Physicals, taking into consideration the pre-physical test results.
  • Recommends patient specific over the counter and prescription medications and treatments for administration and distribution by nurses.
  • Prepares concise and timely documentation of all patient medical assessment and treatments in the corporate electronic medical recordkeeping system.
  • Provides accurate and consistent OSHA Recordkeeping (OSHA 300 Log & 301’s).
  • Job-site evaluations for ergonomic assessments.
  • Perform Fitness for Duty evaluations.
  • Evaluates, validates, and tracks restrictions.
  • Serves as a resource for ADAPT job placement in the absence of plant physician.
  • Works with the Emergency Response Team.
  • Supports wellness initiatives – Health Education and counseling, disease prevention, health promotion.
  • Assigned medical services will be under the supervision and within the scope of practice of the plant Medical Director.
  • Completes other assignments as requested and assigned.
  • May have access to personal health information (“PHI”) necessary to fulfill the above duties and responsibilities.
  • Access to use and ability to disclose PHI is further defined by each organization/department.
 
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Advanced Degree from an Accredited Physician Assistant Program of Study. Active and unrestricted Physician Assistant license in the appropriate state.
  • Valid DEA certification.
  • Current CPR certification.
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience as a Physician Assistant in an occupational health environment or related field.
  • Knowledgeable of State and Federal OSHA rules and regulations.
  • Demonstrates effective oral and communication skills.
  • Adept with basic computer systems and documentation.
  • Able to work flexible hours, if necessary, to meet the customers’ requirements.
 
Physical Effort:
  • Work is performed in various health care settings and not limited to clinics, schools, hospitals, nursing homes, doctor’s offices or occupational settings.
  • Work environment involves occasional exposure to communicable diseases, blood borne pathogens and/or potentially infectious or hazardous materials and situations that require following extensive safety precautions and may include the use of protective equipment (e.g. face masks, goggles, latex or non latex gloves).

  • Able to spend varying amounts of time sitting, standing, and walking. Able to frequently bend, stoop, squat, kneel and reach freely.
  • Sufficient endurance to perform the required physical and mental tasks over extended periods of time.
  • Requires normal, correctable vision and hearing and the ability to identify and distinguish colors. Requires excellent hand-eye coordination and fine motor function necessary to operate equipment safely and calculate/prepare medications and other procedures.
  • Able to successfully work in areas that are confined and/or crowded. Medium physical activity may require frequent lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling up to 50 lbs.

job.title: MANUFACTURING TECHNICIAN - GLOUCESTER, MA
job.description:
ELECTRO MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER OR Manufacturing Technician
Gloucester, MA

Schedule: 
  • Competitive pay ranging from $23.00 to $28.00 per hour, plus shift differentials
  • First Shift:  from 5 am to 3:30 pm Monday through Thursday
  • Second Shift:  from 3 on to 11:30 pm Monday through Thursday has an additional 10% differential 
  • Mid Shift:  from 11 am to 7 pm 
  • Third Shift:  from 7:30 pm to  6 am Monday through Thursday has an additional 13% differential 
  • Fourth Shift:  from 6 am to 6:30 pm Friday, Saturday, and Sunday with an additional 11% differential 
Are you a hands-on Manufacturing Technician who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and working with cutting-edge technology? Join a team where your skills directly support advanced semiconductor manufacturing—an industry driving innovation in everything from AI to electric vehicles.
This is an excellent opportunity for technicians who thrive in electro-mechanical environments, enjoy problem-solving, and want long-term career growth in a high-tech manufacturing setting.

What You’ll Be Doing
In this role, you will support the production, testing, and repair of complex semiconductor equipment by:
Building, repairing, and testing electrical, electro-mechanical, pneumatic, and vacuum assemblies and subassemblies
Working from work orders, schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal or written instructions
Performing electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, and repair, while identifying and correcting errors
Using test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and vacuum pumps to validate assemblies
Entering production data, labor details, and work progress into computer systems
Receiving and auditing parts to ensure build readiness; inspecting components for defects
Troubleshooting issues and contributing to process improvements
Documenting completed work clearly and accurately
Safety & Work Environment
Properly use PPE, tools, equipment, and materials
Proactively report hazards, incidents, or injuries
This position may involve working in a cleanroom environment, requiring PPE such as coveralls, hoods, booties, gloves, safety glasses, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields.

Physical & Environmental Requirements
This is an active, hands-on role that may include:
Standing for extended periods, walking, bending, squatting, kneeling, twisting, climbing stairs or ladders, and working in tight spaces
Lifting and handling components and tools
Operating hand and power tools
Working in environments with moderate to high noise levels
Driving or operating heavy machinery, including forklifts
Ability to distinguish between colors

What We’re Looking For
Experience in manufacturing, assembly, or production environments
Strong ability to follow technical instructions and schematics
Hands-on skills with electro-mechanical assemblies and tools
Comfort working in structured, process-driven environments
Interest in or experience within semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing (highly valued)

Why Join Us
4 day workweek with Fridays off
Day shift schedule for better work-life balance
Entry point or growth opportunity into the semiconductor industry
Work with advanced manufacturing technology
A role where your technical skills truly matter

Working With Yoh
Benefits
Medical, dental, vision insurance
401(k), life & disability coverage
Weekly pay, employee discounts
Ready to Build the Future

If you’re a driven Manufacturing Technician who enjoys hands-on work and wants to be part of a high-impact industry, we want to hear from you.
Apply today and take your next step in semiconductor manufacturing!

Patty Vogel]

job.title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
job.description:
Job Title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
Type: Full Time
Location: Holmdel, NJ
Salary: $180000 + bonus



Position Summary The Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise observability strategy, operating model, and platform roadmap that enable proactive, predictive, and resilient technology operations.

This leader owns the enterprise capabilities for monitoring, telemetry, event intelligence, operational analytics, and observability engineering, ensuring technology services are observable, measurable, actionable, and continuously improving.
The role serves as the operational intelligence leader across Enterprise Technology, providing the platforms, standards, insights, and governance required to improve service reliability, accelerate issue detection and resolution, and support modern operational practices.
This leader partners closely with infrastructure, cloud, middleware, application, security, resiliency, and service management teams to build a unified enterprise-wide observability capability.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Observability Strategy
  • Define and execute the enterprise observability vision, strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap.
  • Establish standards and governance for monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, alerting, and service observability.
  • Lead the evolution of observability capabilities from reactive monitoring toward proactive, predictive, and automated operations.
  • Drive enterprise adoption of modern observability practices, frameworks, and engineering standards.

Observability Platform Ownership
  • Own the strategy, architecture, lifecycle, and operation of enterprise monitoring and observability platforms.
  • Lead platform modernization, tool rationalization, capability expansion, and service offering improvements.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, platform investments, and cost optimization efforts.
  • Ensure scalability, availability, resilience, and ongoing enhancement of observability tooling and services.

Monitoring and Telemetry Services
  • Establish enterprise monitoring and instrumentation standards across infrastructure, cloud, middleware, applications, databases, and digital services.
  • Improve monitoring coverage, telemetry quality, alert effectiveness, signal quality, and operational visibility.
  • Drive adoption of distributed tracing, service dependency mapping, and end-to-end transaction monitoring.
  • Ensure service health and operational data are consistently available across the technology landscape.

Operational Intelligence and AIOps
  • Lead implementation of operational analytics, event intelligence, anomaly detection, predictive insights, and AIOps capabilities.
  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide actionable operational intelligence to technology leadership.
  • Enable intelligent event correlation, noise reduction, automated diagnostics, and automated operational workflows.
  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to use observability data for continuous improvement and outage prevention.

Reliability and Incident Enablement
  • Partner with technology teams to improve detection, response, recovery, and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Establish observability practices that improve service reliability, operational resilience, and customer experience.
  • Drive post-incident learning and identification of automation opportunities.
  • Provide enterprise visibility into technology health, performance trends, capacity risks, and reliability risks.

Leadership and Talent Development
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of observability engineers, platform engineers, and operational intelligence specialists.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnership.
  • Lead organizational adoption of observability best practices through enablement, coaching, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Establish strong partnerships across technology, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, operations, resiliency, and service management functions.

Qualifications
  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure operations, platform engineering, observability, reliability engineering, or related technology disciplines.
  • 5+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale engineering or operational teams.
  • Deep expertise in observability platforms, monitoring technologies, telemetry pipelines, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and operational analytics.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise monitoring strategies and improving operational reliability at scale.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructure, automation, DevOps practices, and modern operational architectures.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation and driving adoption of new operational capabilities.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills.

Success Measures
  • Increased enterprise monitoring and observability coverage.
  • Reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
  • Improved signal quality and reduced alert fatigue.
  • Increased adoption of observability standards and platform capabilities.
  • Improved service reliability, operational resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Expansion of predictive analytics, automation, and AIOps capabilities across Enterprise Technology.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an experienced Manufacturing Engineer to join a pharmaceutical manufacturing organization in Rosenberg, TX. This is a hands-on, floor-oriented engineering position supporting day-to-day pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.

The Manufacturing Engineer will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Packaging, Validation, and R&D to troubleshoot equipment and process issues, improve manufacturing performance, support new product and equipment initiatives, and ensure compliance with FDA and cGMP requirements.

The ideal candidate will have direct pharmaceutical manufacturing engineering experience, particularly with liquid and/or semi-solid products, and be comfortable spending significant time on the manufacturing floor.


Title: Manufacturing Engineer 
Location: Rosenberg, TX
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Salary: $80,000 - 100,000 annually
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Provide hands-on engineering support to pharmaceutical manufacturing operations.
  • Troubleshoot manufacturing and packaging equipment issues to minimize downtime and improve equipment reliability.
  • Support equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and validation activities.
  • Develop and execute engineering and validation documentation, including IQ/OQ/PQ.
  • Support process validation and cleaning validation activities.
  • Investigate manufacturing deviations and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Develop and implement CAPA and change controls.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve throughput, productivity, labor efficiency, equipment reliability, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
  • Support manufacturing process improvements and cost-reduction initiatives.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Packaging, Validation, and R&D teams.
  • Develop and revise SOPs, manufacturing procedures, and work instructions.
  • Support regulatory, customer, and internal audits.
  • Ensure engineering and manufacturing activities comply with applicable FDA, cGMP, safety, and quality requirements.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Industrial, Manufacturing, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 3–5+ years of pharmaceutical manufacturing engineering experience, with preference for candidates with 5+ years.
  • Strong knowledge of FDA requirements, cGMP, and regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing practices.
  • Direct experience manufacturing semi-solid products, such as creams, ointments, and suppositories, and/or liquid products, including solutions and suspensions.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting manufacturing and packaging equipment.
  • Experience with equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and validation.
  • Working knowledge of IQ/OQ/PQ, process validation, and cleaning validation.
  • Experience with deviations, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA, and change control.
  • Ability and willingness to spend significant time on the manufacturing floor supporting daily operations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with New Product Introduction (NPI), process scale-up, and technology transfer.
  • Experience developing User Requirement Specifications (URS).
  • Experience with Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
  • Proven success improving throughput, productivity, labor efficiency, equipment reliability, and OEE.
  • Demonstrated ability to reduce downtime and optimize manufacturing costs.
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and 5S methodologies.
  • Experience developing and revising SOPs and manufacturing work instructions.
  • Experience supporting regulatory, customer, and internal audits.
  • Experience using SAP or a comparable ERP system.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Software QA & Test Data Coordinator- Biomedical- EST Remote
job.description:
Yoh has an immediate, 10 month contract opportunity, as a Software QA & Test Data Coordinator- Biomedical/Life Sciences within the non-profit, humanitarian industry to join our client, EST Remote, to report from their office based in Tallahassee, FL
  • $65hr. max hourly rate
  • Seeking a QA professional with expertise in software validation, test data management (JSON/XML), and FDA-regulated environments to support testing and deployment of a mission-critical blood management system
***Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Due to the client-site nature of this role, we are unable to support OPT or STEM OPT employment, including completion of Form I-983***

** To be considered, your current city and state must be clearly listed on your resume. Applications with incomplete location information may not be considered **

What You Will Be Doing
  • Create and manage test data (seed data) to support software testing, user validation, and system readiness activities.
  • Analyze seed data requests, determine the appropriate creation method, and build accurate test records using JSON, XML, and other data structures.
  • Investigate testing issues, perform root cause analysis, and resolve data-related problems before escalating to software vendors or project teams.
  • Support software validation, regression testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) activities within a complex, FDA-regulated environment.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to understand business processes, maintain test environments, and ensure timely delivery of critical testing support.
*This is NOT a complete list of responsibilities or requirements. Full client job description will be provided upon submittal to end client*

Who You Are
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience considered.
  • 5+ years of software QA and testing experience supporting complex enterprise applications and end-to-end testing efforts.
  • Strong experience working with JSON and XML data structures, including the ability to understand objects, variables, relationships, and data syntax.
  • Proven troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to identify whether issues stem from application functionality, configuration, or data quality.
  • Experience in an FDA-regulated, GMP, or other highly regulated environment, with an understanding of validation, compliance, and documentation requirements.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced project environment, managing multiple priorities and meeting aggressive deadlines with minimal supervision.

job.title: Thin Film Process Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Thin Film Process Engineer in Longmont, CO for a leading diagnostic company. The Process Engineer will support transfer and development of new products and processes.  You will support manufacturing, while maintaining and improving upon existing equipment as well as ensuring product quality and yield. 

Position:  Process Engineer II
Pay: $84,000-105,000 DOE 
Location: Longmont, CO 
Duration: FTE

Ideally like to have 1 in each of the following backgrounds –
  • Automation process engineer
  • Surface chemistry that will introduce new equipment and focus on developing new standards and processes
  • 5-7 years of experience, no more than 8 years.
Automation Process Engineer
  • Must have experience with relevant equipment for automation assembly,
  • Experience with auto assembly, laser welding, pouching, Thin Film, microarray printing.
Surface Chemistry
  • The individual needs to have experience with thin films and etching.
  • Must have strong GDP experience and produce quality documents.
  • 5-7 years in manufacturing as a process engineer, does not need to be from med device or diagnostics just relevant to the automation equipment and auto line machines, IQ/OQ/PQ.
  • Experience with new equipment introduction, qualifying, process improvement and cost savings
  • Would like to know what type of cost saving methods you've introduced

Responsibilities

  • Lead efforts to provide sustaining support to operations utilizing continuous improvement principles and technical support to operations utilizing root cause analysis to implement corrective actions.

  • Enables company growth by ensuring on-time equipment milestone deliveries.

  • Recommends and implements equipment and process modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products.

  • Assists in developing high level capital equipment integration protocols and procedures for manufacturing. 

  • Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting physical cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality. Active database and data management allowing for process performance assessment via GR&R, Yield Tracking and Cpk analysis.

  • Accurately documents all work products to ensure equipment qualifications and in line with and follow IQ, OQ, PQ requirements.

  • Interacts with design staff to ensure that processes and designs are compatible with existing equipment.

  • Translate design requirements into production by defining, designing and/or communicating efficient and capable process tooling.

  • Utilizing GDP, author documents including but not limited to manufacturing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and detailed work instructions.

  • Trains manufacturing staff on proper processes to follow when operating equipment, including wave-guide instrument(s).

  • Ensures that team and staff members follow safety rules and protocol.
Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field required; master’s degree preferred.

  • Five to seven (5-7) years prior experience in an R&D or production environment with proven success of process improvement and scale-up projects.

  • Experience in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO, etc.), preferred.

  • Experience in project management preferred.

  • Experience in the medical device field, specifically invitro diagnostics, preferred.

  • Licenses or certifications such as ISO, PMP, LEAN, IFMA, MPS, Six Sigma, cGMP, preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical staff to ensure understanding.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate in problem solving.

  • Excellent data gathering and analysis skills.

  • Excellent electro-mechanical equipment development and troubleshooting skills.

  • Knowledge of QMS, including experience with deviation, CAPA, and other quality related objectives and requirements.

  • Software use and knowledge: Windows, MS Office products, SolidWorks (or similar).
