job.title: NE Administrative Operations & Support Manager
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Administrative Operations & Support Manager opportunity with a trusted client located in Waltham, MA. 

If you don't wish to receive these mails, just turn off "Job expiry email alerts" inside the user profile or system settings.

Position Overview
This individual will be responsible for supporting Yoh and Client project initiatives. It is expected that this individual will have a 90% onsite presence.
The Admin Operations & Support Assoc. will function in the capacity of an onsite Yoh representative, to include assistance with resources, employees, and to ensure daily continuity of business and operation. Initial training and instruction will be provided by existing Yoh management and Yoh Sr. Management.
It is expected that the Admin Operation & Support Assoc. will support the current Yoh Manager, and while gaining, fostering the client relationship become familiar with the Yoh onboarding process, site training requirements, and the daily operations of the Yoh staff.

Administrative & Operational ResponsibilitiesThis individual will be responsible for:
  • Maintaining Yoh email distribution list(s).
  • Updating and enhancing the Yoh open positions spreadsheet.
  • Updating the monthly changes spreadsheet.
  • Maintaining the Yoh Recognition Awards program at our client site.
  • The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for maintaining the absence (Discretionary Leave, FMLA, and absence Spreadsheet).
Client & Organizational Communications
The AO & S Mgr. will be responsible for communications within the organizational structure of our client, and have some limited responsibility to other sites and departments which contain Yoh employees.
This individual will have the responsibility to liaison between Yoh D&Z and our employees as it relates to creating BetterNet Tickets, & Yoh Portal Issues, and working out employee concerns with Yoh PA office management.
This individual will be responsible for informing Yoh Management of any escalatory situations within the Yoh organization and our it’s employees.

Candidates & Open Positions
The Yoh AO & S Mgr. will function as liaison to all departments in respect to Yoh candidates and open positions. This requires keeping spreadsheets up to date and potentially in a state of presentation ready as requested by the client.
The goal of this presentation is to provide a weekly (as necessary & dependent upon openings) but on a proactive basis.
In theory, we should keep the client up to date so that they don’t need to ask for information because we proactively provide it to them.

Work Ethic & Communication
This individual will have a strong and collaborative work ethic, be results oriented and demonstrate a focus on achieving (business) results.
The AO & S Mgr. will have strong written and oral communication skills, with demonstrated experience managing multiple communications. Progressively onsite and presenting / representing the Yoh business function.

Financial & Confidential Information
Financial responsibility will be minimal within this position; however, they may have exposure to sensitive information and understand that the information is to remain confidential.

Meeting Coordination
Facilitate meetings through issuance of meeting agendas. Track and follow up on action items and determine what action items need to be addressed.

Microsoft Office Skills
The AO & S Mgr. will have excellent knowledge in all aspects of MS Office including MS Project, Excel, Sharepoint and MS Teams.

New Yoh Employee Program & Onboarding
This individual supports and within time take over the new Yoh employee program:
  • Setting up and scheduling new candidates for Meet and Greet sessions.
  • Providing feedback to the Yoh recruiters.
  • Liaison information between our team and the client.
This individual will be the come to person for onboarding new employees, from ensuring they are enrolled in NHO and are met upon release from NHO.

Benefits, Timekeeping & HR
This individual will be required to learn about the Yoh benefits, programs, and functionality of the Yoh time keeping system.
They will be required to assist in making sure that Yoh employees enter their time as required.
Have knowledge of HR process and procedures and work with Yoh HR and Employee Relations.

job.title: DoD Sr. Project Manager (HYBRID)
job.description:
DoD Manufacturing Project Manager (ONSITE) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Austin, TX.
  • Pay Rate: $70-79/hr
  • HYBRID
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • DIBI is seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead execution of a high-priority Additive Manufacturing Sprint supporting the U.S. Navy.
  • This is a hands-on project leadership role responsible for coordinating a complex, fast-moving, cross-functional team and keeping the project on track across scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
  • The primary responsibilities will include owning day-to-day project execution, coordinating the cross-functional team, translating the technical scope into an executable project plan, managing milestones and deliverables, tracking risks and issues, coordinating with the Navy and other stakeholders, and providing clear status reporting and escalation to DIBI leadership.

Required:
  • We are looking for a senior, hands-on project manager with 5+ years of experience managing complex technical programs, ideally in a defense, federal, aerospace, engineering, advanced manufacturing, or similarly complex environment.
  • Exceptional project scheduling and organization skills, including developing and maintaining detailed project plans, tracking milestones and dependencies, coordinating deliverables, and keeping work on schedule.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including coordinating with and keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Responsive to direction with strong initiative and follow-through, able to take direction and priorities from the project lead while independently anticipating needs, identifying gaps, solving problems, and taking action to keep the project moving.
  • Experience managing large, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Experience working directly with federal/government customers, preferably DoD or Navy
  • The ability to take an ambiguous or evolving objective and turn it into a clear execution plan with owners, milestones, and accountability
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work with senior leaders, technical experts, government stakeholders, and external partners
  • Strong project controls experience, including schedules, deliverables, risks/issues, dependencies, resources, and budget
  • Experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Salesforce, MS Project, Jira, Monday.com, or similar platforms
  • PMP certification strongly preferred; Agile/Scrum experience is a plus
  • The ability to operate independently, identify and resolve issues, facilitate decisions, and keep a fast-moving project on track
  • Ability to travel up to approximately 30% as needed
  • Additive manufacturing experience would be a plus, but it is not required. We are more focused on finding a strong project leader who has experience managing technically complex work in a federal/defense or similar environment.
What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the area’s largest universities supporting the Department of Defense. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: Business Intelligence (BI) / Data Analytics- OnSite
job.description:
Yoh has an immediate, 12 month contract opportunity, as a Business/Intelligence (BI)/Data Analyst within the consumer electronics and entertainment industry to join our client, Onsite, to report from their office based in San Diego, CA

***Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Due to the client-site nature of this role, we are unable to support OPT or STEM OPT employment, including completion of Form I-983***
  • $45.63/hr. max hourly rate
  • 1-3 years of experience using SQL to analyze data, build business logic, define KPIs, and develop Power BI reporting solutions for business stakeholders.
  • Must be able to independently translate complex business questions into SQL-driven insights, KPI frameworks, and executive-ready Power BI dashboards.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Business Logic & Data Modeling: Write advanced SQL within Databricks to apply complex business rules, transform raw data, and build structured datasets optimized for reporting
  • Visualization & Reporting: Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI to track KPIs and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Insight Generation: Analyze large datasets to uncover trends, define and maintain KPI calculations and reporting standards, summarize key findings concisely, and present actionable insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional business teams to gather and document requirements, define business metrics, and translate business questions into analytical and reporting solutions.
  • Issue Resolution & Engineering Liaison: Proactively monitor data quality, perform validation and reconciliation of reporting outputs, clearly document anomalies or discrepancies, and collaborate with the Data Engineering team to troubleshoot pipeline or data issues.
Who You Are
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience using SQL to analyze data, build business logic, define KPIs, and develop Power BI reporting solutions for business stakeholders.
  • Foundational experience with data analysis and programming (e.g., Python or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools, particularly Power BI.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to validate results, communicate findings clearly, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical engineering teams.
Preferred Skills
  • Direct experience working within Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery).
  • Understanding of data warehouse concepts, data models, and ETL/ELT processes, with the ability to trace data lineage and communicate effectively with data engineers.
  • Experience supporting marketing, CRM, ecommerce, customer analytics, or digital analytics initiatives is a plus. Familiarity with customer data platforms, audience segmentation, campaign measurement, and tools such as GA4, ActionIQ, Qualtrics, or similar platforms is preferred.

job.title: Semiconductor Engineering Technician-Gloucester, MA
job.description:
Engineering Technician Role needed for an 18 month contract to hire opportunity in Gloucester, MA. In this role you will assist engineers and scientists as they create, modify, and test products and processes.

Various shifts available


Pay Rate: $30 to $35 per hour



What You Will Be Doing:

  • Tasks will include HV electrical, High Vacuum and mechanical troubleshooting.
  • Ability to modify/rebuild modules, as well as calibrations, measure particulates, metals testing and demonstrations
  • Has developed proficiency in a range of analytical/scientific processes or procedures to carry out assigned tasks and complex work
  • Will perform mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, vacuum and process testing on equipment per Engineering and Manufacturing documentation and specifications.
  • Experience in assembly, integration and calibrations of semiconductor capital equipment, plasma etch platforms, Implanters (high current, Medium Current, PLAD) or equivalent equipment in a clean room environment.
  • Works autonomously within established procedures and practices. Exchanges ideas and information effectively; uses tact and diplomacy when dealing with others.
  • Observes all safety standards
  •  Maintains a secure, safe, clean and healthy work environment.
  • Attends required health and safety training and follows safety and security policies, procedures and practices. Follows operating instructions, uses protective equipment (PPE) when required, and uses equipment and materials properly. Actively strives to prevent accidents and injuries.

QUALIFICATIONS: Associates degree preferred. Minimum high school diploma and 4-7 year’s technician training/experience in a high technology area. Minimum of 2?3 year’s semiconductor experience, VCS training on other VIISta tools a plus. Understanding of electrical circuitry is required. Some travel may be required.
What You Need To Bring To The Table:

  • Positive Attitude
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Good Communication Skills
  • Problem-Solving Skills
  • Team Player
  • Ability to Accept and Learn from Criticism

job.title: Procurement Program Manager (Hybrid to Secaucus, NJ OR Georgetown, TX)
job.description:
Send updated resumes to Tymir Black
Tymir.Black@yoh.com
https://www.linkedin.com/in/tymir-black-035914111/

This role is eligible for a flexible hybrid work arrangement following the successful completion of the initial 90-day onboarding period. Following the onboarding period, employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of three (3) days per week, with the specific in office schedule determined by the manager based on business and team needs. Must be from cloud, hardware solutions,automotive,electrical, manufacturing type of industry. We are currently seeking a Platform Procurement Program Manager to be based out of our Secaucus, NJ office or Georgetown, TX. The Platform Procurement Program Manager is an individual contributor who will be responsible for end-to-end supply-demand optimization.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage procurement of server PCBAs, electronic components, and related materials from qualified suppliers.
  • Issue and manage purchase orders, including pricing, quantities, delivery dates, and commercial terms.
  • Monitor supplier commitments and proactively address shortages, delays, and supply constraints.
  • Work closely with Material Planning, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to align purchasing with production requirements.
  • Review MRP/ERP requirements and convert demand into timely purchase orders.
  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels while minimizing excess and obsolete materials.
  • Support supplier selection, qualification, cost negotiations, and performance management.
  • Negotiate lead times, MOQ, payment terms, and other commercial conditions.
  • Track PCBA component availability and identify potential long-lead-time and allocation risks.
  • Coordinate engineering changes, BOM updates, and part substitutions with suppliers and internal teams.
  • Ensure purchased materials meet specifications, quality requirements, and approved vendor lists.
  • Support resolution of supplier quality issues, material discrepancies, and delivery problems.
  • Develop and maintain supplier relationships and participate in supplier performance reviews.
  • Analyze purchasing data, including cost, lead time, supplier performance, and delivery metrics.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing records and ensure compliance with company procurement policies.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of purchasing/procurement experience in electronics, PCBA, servers, networking equipment, or a related manufacturing environment.
  • Understanding of PCBAs, electronic components, BOMs, and electronics manufacturing processes.
  • Experience working with ERP/MRP systems and purchasing workflows.
  • Ability to manage multiple suppliers, priorities, and production requirements simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

job.description:
Monday through Friday
8 am to 5 pm
$27/hr

Contract role through Yoh Services at a client site
This job requires strong REVIT skills.

Job Description: Entry-Level Drafter / Engineering Support General Overview The Entry-Level Drafter performs drafting and basic engineering support activities under close supervision. This position develops foundational competencies through structured work assignments and receives instruction, guidance, and direction from supervisors, managers, and experienced colleagues.
The role may focus on drafting, engineering support, or a combination of both.
Primary Responsibilities
  • Perform field observations as assigned.
  • Prepare and update as‑built drawings based on field edits.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, construction drawings, and other technical documentation.
  • Use computer‑aided design (CAD) software to prepare detailed engineering drawings, maps, and graphs from provided materials, including previous drawings, sketches, layouts, and standard references.
  • Clearly document revisions and file drawings according to standard procedures.
  • Assist in drafting solicitation documents using established procedures, formats, and templates to support procurement and contract activities.
  • Support field and office research related to:
    • Field measurements
    • Historical engineering drawings
    • Equipment databases
    • Microfilm
    • Inventory records
    • Electronic document management system (EDMS) records
    • Other technical documentation
  • Contribute to the design of equipment and layouts and support development of equipment ratings and facility statistics.
  • Prepare basic specifications, materials lists, and fixed capital unit (FCU) lists.
  • Assist with creating work orders and requisition entries.
  • Perform data entry in the departmental engineering database.
  • Prepare basic reports related to projects, work plans, equipment, assets, and budgets; assist with more complex reporting as needed.
  • Operate office and drafting equipment such as plotters, printers, copiers, and scanners.
  • Collect engineering information by traveling independently to various company locations (such as substations, facilities, or plants).
The responsibilities above represent essential job functions but are not an exhaustive list. Employees may be required to perform additional job‑related duties as assigned.
Minimum Qualifications
  • One or more years of experience interpreting technical drawings/documents and performing technical analysis or CAD drafting.
  • A degree in computer‑aided design or a related field may substitute for equivalent experience, per company guidelines.
  • A valid driver’s license is required for travel to various company locations.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Knowledge of general engineering principles.
  • Knowledge of CAD principles, standards, and techniques.
  • Knowledge of electronic document management systems (EDMS).
  • Knowledge of work management systems.
  • Basic proficiency in CAD software.
  • Ability to read and interpret diagrams, prints, and technical information.
  • Basic proficiency in office productivity software (email, word processing, spreadsheets).
  • Skill in analyzing and solving technical problems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to operate plotters, printers, copiers, and scanners.
  • Ability to perform accurate data entry.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Work Environment
  • Work may be performed in an office, industrial setting, electrical substation, or plant environment.
  • Exposure to noise may occur.
  • Outdoor work may involve exposure to various or extreme weather conditions.
Physical Demands
  • Frequent finger/hand manipulation when using a keyboard and mouse.
  • Occasional climbing, crawling, crouching, or other non‑sitting positions for field duties (less than 20% of the time).
  • Occasional standing or walking during field work (less than 20% of the time).

job.title: Software Technical Program Manager – Powertrain
job.description:
Software Technical Program Manager – Powertrain
 
As Technical Program Manager, you will use your technical expertise to holistically drive complex problems to completion. You will work with the team to scope work, plan requirements, identify risks, estimate budgets, and clearly communicate ongoing progress.
Seeking an experienced Software Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Powertrain and Motion Controls. The TPM will be responsible for driving the team to meet their committed deliverables as well as working with the engineers, technical leads, and managers across the broader organization to assess risk, communicate status, and drive closure to key issues. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in automotive powertrain systems and motion controls, excellent project management skills, and experience working with highly cross-functional teams. This environment is not for everyone but will enrich the best talent with the opportunity to perform some of the best work of their careers. 

Responsibilities:
As a technical program manager, you will be a force multiplier and enable a world-class team of engineers to execute with quality and under aggressive development timelines.
You will be responsible for the following domains: powertrain and motion controls.
Your responsibilities include the following:
  • Coordinate with various controls, systems, and integration engineers to establish feature delivery roadmaps, define key deliverable delivery dates, and tie deliverables to engineering milestones.
  • Work Right-to-Left to ensure that the vehicle and motor torque controls development plans meet end-user needs, support hardware and system DV test plans, and meet engineering program milestones.
  • Coordinate with vehicle program management on prototype vehicle and test asset allocation. Ensure engineers have the resources that they need, at the time that they need it, to complete their testing and validation.
  • Run sprint planning sessions and help organize the engineering task workflow.
  • Track sprint action items and progress towards engineering deliverables. Report status to engineering management and escalate concerns when necessary.
  • Work with engineering management to assess team workload management and vocalize resource gaps.
  • Assist engineering to prioritize work tasks and ensure team progress.
  • Set the overall sprint timeline, identify and resolve roadblocks.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • Minimum of 5 years program management experience, with focus on automotive powertrain systems software development, verification and validation, or quality assurance
  • Product launch experience with a vehicle OEM in systems, software, or testing
  • Experience with automotive powertrain systems is required
  • Experience working with vehicle motion controls
  • Experience working with vehicle diagnostics
  • Experience with Agile Methodology, CI/CD is required

Corporate Paralegal (Energy Industry Experience) needed for a HYBRID contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Audubon, PA.

  • HYBRID-onsite occasionally/as-needed

Additionally, the Paralegal will conduct legal and factual research; execute filings; facilitate legal and compliance matters; and act as a liaison among various internal departments as well as outside agencies.
  • Provide legal support for counsel in the stakeholder process, and in litigation and regulatory proceedings both at the state and federal levels.

job.title: Sr. Research Associate- ESI Flow Cytometry
job.description:
Research Associate - ESI Flow Cytometry
Primary Duties: The Yoh resource is expected to apply expertise across several practical skills including flow cytometry and cell sorting in support of the Client’s Vaccines R&D Global Immunology function. The role is a lab-based research scientist who will be participating in various teams to support preclinical and early clinical evaluation of vaccine candidates against various respiratory viruses. Knowledge of immunoassay instruments, including flow cytometer analyzers, high-speed sorter, centrifuges, multi-mode plate readers and plate washers will be required. Individual will be performing laboratory work including flow cytometry and immunoassays, recording data in specified formats and/or recording detailed day-to-day work in electronic laboratory notebook. Responsibilities will include reagent preparation, lab housekeeping and flow cytometry analyzers and cell sorters maintenance. Applicant must be capable of working both independently and as part of a structured team.

 Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Support experimental assay design, optimization, and execute multi-parameter flow cytometry panels (beyond 20 colors) for comprehensive T cell and B cell subset identification
  • Execute multi-cytokine  Intracellular Cytokine Staining (ICS) assays (IFN-?, TNF-?, IL-2, IL-4, IL-17, etc.) following antigen-specific stimulationOperate and maintain flow cytometers (conventional and spectral platforms) with adherence to quality control protocols
  • Execute high-speed, high-purity cell sorting using Sony or similar instrumentation for isolation of antigen-specific T cell and B cell populations or other cell subsets of interest.
  • Optimize sort gates and collection strategies to maximize cell recovery and purity
  • Troubleshoot sort performance issues including clogging, deflection plate alignment, and collection efficiency
  • Analyze flow cytometry data using industry-standard software (OMIQ)
  • Apply appropriate gating strategies following established SOPs and scientific best practices
  • Analyze and summarize experimental outcomes, record experimental procedures and raw and analyzed data in electronic laboratory notebook.
  • Conduct experiments and prepare powerpoint slides for internal presentations as required.
  • Write standard operating procedures (SOPs), and documents for methods, instruments, or work processes as required.
  • Collaborate as needed with internal partners in other functional areas, external vendors, and external scientific partners.
  • Comply with the company safety policies and minimize risk to self, others, and the environment, consistent with the community and industry standards.

Education and Experience Requirements:
  • BS with 4+ years or MS with 2+ years relevant experience. Degree should be in Immunology, Biotechnology, Virology, Biochemistry or related field.
  • Hands-on expertise with multi-parameter flow cytometry (minimum 10-color panels) and/or cell sorting .
  • Demonstrated experience with intracellular cytokine staining in preclinical and/ or human PBMC samples and/or ability to execute sterile sorts, optimize sort gates, and troubleshoot sorter performance.

Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:
  • Proficiency in flow cytometry data analysis software (OMIQ preferred)
  • Working knowledge with Good Research Practice (GRP).
  • Ability to expresses one’s self clearly and concisely within team.
  • Good time management and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work in agile team environment.
  • Attention to details.
  • Data review
  • Training
  • Scheduling
  • GDP
  • GRP, compliance requirements for clinical trial samples.


Estimated Min Rate: $28.00
Estimated Max Rate: $40.00

job.title: QC Lab Supervisor
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a hands-on Laboratory Supervisor to oversee daily quality-control laboratory activities within a polymer compounding manufacturing environment. The Laboratory Supervisor will perform and coordinate testing of raw materials, in-process materials, and finished products to ensure compliance with established specifications and quality standards. This position works closely with Quality, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to investigate product-quality issues, support corrective actions, maintain laboratory equipment and documentation, and ensure testing is performed accurately, safely, and in accordance with established procedures and ISO quality requirements.

Location: Elkton, MD 
Schedule: M-F 7-3:30 
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform quality-control laboratory testing on raw materials, in-process materials, and finished polymer products.
  • Perform testing including:
    • Tensile testing
    • Compression testing
    • Rheology
    • Viscosity
    • Thermal analysis
    • Chemical extractions
    • Titrations
  • Operate laboratory instruments and equipment in accordance with established procedures and test methods.
  • Perform routine instrument calibrations and verify equipment performance.
  • Follow established laboratory procedures, specifications, work instructions, and quality-system requirements.
  • Review test results for accuracy and identify abnormal or out-of-specification results.
  • Maintain accurate laboratory records, test results, calibration records, and quality documentation.
  • Train laboratory associates on QC procedures, testing methods, equipment operation, documentation, and safety requirements.
  • Work with Quality Associates and Engineers to investigate product-quality issues and support corrective actions.
  • Assist with root-cause investigations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Provide laboratory testing and analysis to support Manufacturing and Quality teams.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment.
  • Follow all company safety policies, laboratory procedures, and applicable ISO quality-system requirements.
  • Assist with maintaining and improving laboratory procedures and testing processes.
Required Qualifications
  • Minimum 2 years of quality-control laboratory or related manufacturing laboratory experience.
  • Experience working in an ISO-regulated quality environment and familiarity with ISO quality-system requirements.
  • Some college coursework required; degree in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Experience performing laboratory testing and working with laboratory instruments.
  • Ability to follow established testing procedures and accurately document results.
  • Basic math skills, including the ability to perform calculations, measurements, percentages, unit conversions, and interpret numerical test results.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate recordkeeping.
  • Ability to recognize abnormal or out-of-specification test results.
  • Ability to train and provide guidance to laboratory associates.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

job.title: Python CPE Network Automation Engineer
job.description:
Python CPE Network Automation Engineer
Seeking a Junior to Entry/Mid-Level Python Network Automation Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to support automated testing of routers, access points, extenders, gateways, and other CPE devices.

Scope:
• Develop Python and Pytest automation for CPE validation.
• Automate device interactions using SSH, REST APIs, cURL, and CLI tools.
• Generate and analyze traffic using iPerf3, Scapy, Wireshark, and Tshark.
• Test throughput, packet loss, latency, roaming, and connectivity.
• Configure Linux test hosts, switches, VLANs, and testbed infrastructure.
• Automate provisioning, firmware flashing, reboots, and configuration changes.
• Integrate tests into Git-based CI/CD pipelines.
• Analyze results, troubleshoot failures, capture packet traces, and document defects.

Required:
• 3–5 years of experience in Python, test automation, network automation, or a related field.
• Proficiency with Python 3, Pytest or unittest, and Bash scripting.
• Working knowledge of Linux administration.
• Familiarity with Paramiko, Netmiko, Requests, Pexpect, or similar libraries.
• Understanding of IP addressing, subnetting, DHCP, DNS, NAT, VLANs, and routing.
• Basic knowledge of WiFi standards, SSIDs, authentication, and performance metrics.
• Experience with Wireshark or tcpdump.
• Experience using Git.
• Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.

Pluses:
• Experience with TR-069, TR-369/USP, OpenSync, or EasyMesh.
• Experience with ByteBlower, OctoScope, Candela, or LANforge.
• Experience testing routers, access points, extenders, or gateways.
• Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field.
• Experience with Pytest fixtures, test parameterization, logging, and subprocess management.

job.title: Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist for our healthcare client. In this role, you will be responsible for resolving complex billing and reimbursement issues while maximizing revenue recovery through expert claims analysis, denial management, and payment resolution. The Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist will collaborate with insurance carriers, patients, leadership, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely reimbursement, identify process improvements, and support overall revenue cycle performanc. Experience in Anatomic Pathology or Diagnostic Laboratory billing is required.

Industry:Diagnostics
Location: Onsite / Hybrid (Based on Client Need)

Job Functions
  • Investigate, resolve, and collect payment on complex healthcare billing and reimbursement transactions.
  • Research and resolve unpaid claims, billing discrepancies, denials, and customer complaints to ensure timely and accurate reimbursement.
  • Contact insurance carriers, patients, and other stakeholders to resolve account issues and maximize payment.
  • Review insurance and patient account correspondence to identify outstanding issues and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Analyze billing trends and identify recurring reimbursement issues, recommending process improvements to reduce denials and improve collections.
  • Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional teams to develop solutions that improve revenue cycle performance and operational efficiency.
  • Review billing documentation to ensure compliance with payer requirements and regulatory guidelines.
  • Communicate effectively with insurance companies, patients, and internal leadership regarding account status, payment issues, and resolution strategies.
  • Develop and maintain expertise in payer fee schedules, reimbursement methodologies, and denial management.
  • Apply advanced knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer policies to maximize reimbursement opportunities.
  • Monitor and work aging reports to resolve outstanding accounts receivable and reduce claim aging.
  • Support complex revenue cycle projects and initiatives requiring advanced reimbursement knowledge.
  • Assist with special projects and perform additional duties as assigned.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience in a complex healthcare billing and reimbursement environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance reimbursement processes.
  • Experience with insurance accounts receivable, denial management, and claims resolution.
  • Experience in Anatomic Pathology or Diagnostic Laboratory billing is required.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare billing regulations, payer policies, and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex billing issues independently.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with patients, insurance carriers, clients, leadership, and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify trends, recommend process improvements, and contribute to operational efficiencies.
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, accountability, and commitment to delivering exceptional customer service.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Senior Speech and Language Specialist
job.description:
Yoh Heathcare has a direct hire opportunity for a Senior Speech and Language Specialist to joint our client in New Brunswick, NJ

Overview
As a Senior Speech and Language Specialist, you'll play a vital role in assessing and supporting students with diverse communication, feeding, and social needs. Working directly with children, adolescents, and young adults, you'll develop and implement tailored interventions that promote independence and social engagement. This position offers an enriching environment where your expertise can inspire growth and transform lives, all within a supportive academic community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive evaluations of students' speech, language, feeding, and social skills.
  • Analyze diagnostic tests, observations, and input from families and educators to inform personalized treatment plans.
  • Develop, implement, and adjust therapeutic interventions, providing both direct and indirect therapy in individual and small group settings.
  • Monitor student progress meticulously, ensuring interventions are effective and aligned with their educational goals.
  • Participate proactively in IEP meetings and parent conferences, fostering strong collaboration among families, teachers, and Child Study Teams.
  • Train and consult with staff and families to ensure consistency and integration of goals across settings.
  • Support behavioral programs and engage in physically active activities, including crisis management when necessary.
Must-Have Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Speech-Language Pathology or an equivalent field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, especially with students with autism.
  • Current New Jersey Speech-Language Specialist certification or eligibility.
  • NJ Department of Education Speech Language Specialist Standard Certificate.
  • Valid NJ State Licensure in Speech Pathology.
  • Comfort working fully on-site in a busy, active educational environment.
Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) and Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC).
  • Strong school-based clinical background.
  • ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) or Clinical Fellow (CF).
What's In it for you?
  • Medical, prescription drug, and dental coverage
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and various leave programs
  • Competitive retirement benefits, including defined contribution plans and voluntary tax-deferred savings options
  • Employee and dependent educational benefits (when applicable)
  • Life insurance coverage
  • Employee discount programs

job.title: Human Resources - Sourcer / Recruiter
job.description:
Human Resources- Sourcer/Recruiter ( Corporate Recruiter/Professional Recruiter) 

We are seeking an experienced Contract Sourcer / Recruiter to support hiring needs across multiple business groups.

Job Description: 

Duration: 6 months contract 
Location: Hybrid in NY preferred, Open to  Remote EST 
Pay Rate: $40-$45 hourly W2 


Key Responsibilities:

Recruiting & Sourcing
• Develop and execute sourcing strategies using direct outreach, referrals, social platforms, and talent search tools.
• Screen and assess candidates, moving them through the process with strong communication and follow through.
• Provide market insights on talent availability, competition, and sourcing challenges.

Candidate & Stakeholder Engagement
• Partner closely with TA and hiring managers to align on search strategy and progress.
• Deliver an engaging, high quality candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
• Collaborate with Talent Partners and Compensation teams to support competitive offer development.

Tools, Data & Process
• Maintain accurate and compliant candidate data within Workday Recruiting (preferred) or other ATS systems.
• Use recruiting metrics to track pipeline health and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
• Support consistent recruiting processes and adherence to standards.

Pipeline & Network Development
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
• Develop strong external networks within relevant functional and industry markets.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent experience.
• 7+ years of professional level recruiting experience; financial services or insurance industry experience strongly preferred.
• Strong sourcing skills, including advanced search, passive candidate outreach, and talent market research.
• Proven experience recruiting across multiple functions and geographies in fast paced corporate or search firm environments.
• Excellent communication and relationship building skills with the ability to influence and guide hiring leaders.
• Strong assessment capabilities with sound judgment around candidate fit and hiring recommendations.
• Highly organized, able to manage multiple requisitions, shifting priorities, and tight timelines.
• Proficient with ATS platforms; Workday Recruiting strongly preferred.
• Comfortable using analytics, dashboards, and reporting to monitor pipelines and inform decisions.
• Self- driven, adaptable, and able to operate independently with minimal guidance.

job.title: UAS Hardware Integration Technician
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, 12-month contract opportunity for a UAS Hardware Integration Technician to join our Autonomous Technology client in San Diego, CA. This position is ideal for an experienced, hands-on technician who enjoys building, integrating, testing, and troubleshooting electrical and electromechanical systems supporting unmanned and autonomous aircraft.

This is a fully onsite position, and candidates must be within a commutable distance of the San Diego facility.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: UAS Hardware Integration Technician
Compensation: $50.00–$60.00/hour, depending on experience
Type: 12-Month Contract; potential to extend or convert 
Location: San Diego, CA; Onsite
Eligibility: Due to the nature of the work and applicable export-control requirements, candidates must qualify as a U.S. Person under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).

Responsibilities
  • Build, install, test, and maintain electrical and electromechanical hardware used across unmanned aircraft, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments, and ground-based test equipment.
  • Integrate aircraft computing hardware, flight controllers, sensors, actuators, communications equipment, payloads, and electrical power components into functional test and flight configurations.
  • Assemble and support low-voltage DC electrical systems, including power distribution, circuit protection, grounding, shielding, load management, and power verification.
  • Fabricate and inspect electrical cables and wire harnesses, including connector assembly, pinning, crimping, soldering, termination, labeling, routing, strain relief, and continuity checks.
  • Interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, connector pinouts, interface documentation, and equipment specifications to support system assembly and troubleshooting.
  • Diagnose electrical, communications, and electromechanical issues through signal tracing, point-to-point testing, fault isolation, and component-level evaluation.
  • Utilize oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, electronic loads, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment to validate system performance.
  • Configure and troubleshoot common aircraft and test-system communications interfaces, which may include CAN, Ethernet, RS-232/422/485, and MIL-STD-1553.
  • Maintain test and aircraft hardware through inspections, repairs, preventive maintenance, calibration coordination, configuration management, and technical documentation.
  • Evaluate and source hardware components and test equipment based on performance, environmental, cost, and availability requirements.
  • Maintain bills of materials, hardware records, approved component alternatives, inventory information, and as-built system documentation.
  • Provide hands-on technical support during laboratory testing, ground testing, and flight-test activities.
Qualifications
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building, integrating, troubleshooting, or repairing UAS platforms, HIL systems, robotics, aerospace hardware, or similar electromechanical systems.
  • Strong understanding of UAS or robotic hardware, including flight controllers, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, payloads, communications hardware, and ground systems.
  • Experience working with low-voltage DC electrical systems, power distribution, circuit protection, grounding, bonding, shielding, and load management.
  • Proficiency with cable and wire-harness fabrication techniques, including crimping, soldering, connector assembly, termination, routing, labeling, and continuity testing.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, connector pinouts, interface drawings, and technical specifications.
  • Hands-on troubleshooting experience using electrical and electronic test equipment such as DMMs, oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, and logic analyzers.
  • Strong documentation, organization, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering and testing teams.
  • Must meet applicable ITAR U.S. Person requirements for access to export-controlled technical information.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting autonomous aircraft, robotics, or other integrated electromechanical platforms.
  • Knowledge of analog, digital, PWM, discrete, CAN, serial, and Ethernet interfaces.
  • Familiarity with UAS and embedded-computing technologies such as PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, NVIDIA Jetson, Linux, or ROS/ROS 2.
  • Experience building or maintaining HIL systems, test fixtures, breakout boxes, simulation hardware, or automated test equipment.

job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
Staff Structural Engineer  

Join our dynamic team as a Staff Structural Engineer and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of transmission tower infrastructure! In this engaging position, you will lead multiple phases of structural design, analysis, and project documentation for a diverse portfolio of transmission tower projects. Your expertise will directly influence innovative solutions in the energy sector, working on everything from conceptual design to detailed construction drawings. If you’re passionate about structural engineering and eager to work on impactful infrastructure projects, this opportunity offers a perfect blend of challenge and growth.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Structural Engineering or related from an ABET-accredited program, with 3+ years of experience; or successful FE exam completion with 3+ years’ experience; or Master’s Degree with 2+ years’ experience
  • Proficiency in structural analysis and modeling software such as RISA-3D, ETABS, SAFE, and BIM tools like Revit and Tekla
  • Strong knowledge of design codes, specifications, and engineering techniques
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and organizational abilities
  • Ability to work methodically, analyze complex data, and collaborate effectively with teams
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Engineers in Training (EIT) certification
  • Experience with PLS-Tower modeling, FEM structure modeling, and reinforcement design
  • Knowledge of retrofit or new construction projects for transmission towers
  • Familiarity with project management and proposal development processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited institution
  • 2-3 years of relevant structural engineering experience, particularly in transmission towers or similar structures
  • Existing EIT certification is advantageous
Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to travel up to 10% for project site visits and meetings
  • Ability to obtain and maintain necessary certifications and work authorization
Ready to make an impact in a challenging and rewarding environment? Apply now to become a key contributor to innovative infrastructure projects that power our communities!

job.title: Music Industry, Solutions Coordinator - Hybrid in NYC
job.description:
Solutions Coordinator within the music industry! 

- Hybrid onsite in NYC
- 6 month contract 
- $25/hr on W2

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponorship. No C2C!

Our company is seeking a Coordinator, Solutions to join our dynamic Enterprise team. In this role, you will work closely with various businesses across Sony Music supporting them and their artists and labels within The Orchard’s supply chain and systems, overseeing key elements of the client experience, and synthesizing interactions across departments. You will be responsible for providing a centralized, solutions-based voice in support of these businesses as they work within The Orchard ecosystem and will supervise the comprehensive client onboarding process, focusing on a positive first experience and ongoing operational questions and concerns. This is a highly responsible role that requires proactive problem-solving skills, a keen eye for detail, and a love for all types of music.
 
What You’ll Do:
  • Serve as a representative of The Orchard’s administrative teams (including legal, finance, and operations) to both Sony Music business units and their artists and labels, addressing issues, gathering feedback, and advocating for Sony Music business unit needs within the organization.
  • Act as point of contact for questions pertaining to operational functions across the organization, serving as a focal point of information and defining internal processes and procedures.
  • Understand how to troubleshoot problems effectively and identify the right teams to interact with in order to get reliable solutions and answers.
  • Advise on digital product supply chain and operations, and manage complex digital release set-ups in accordance with client and campaign specified needs (QC, timed releases, rights management, etc.)
  • Assist with the setup and day-to-day management of distribution and publishing agreements across business units, incl. advance payments, tracking of new deliveries and terminations.
  • Focus on clear, solution-based responses to internal and external queries regarding client questions.
  • Ability to handle high volume inbound needs from clients and ensure they are being addressed in a timely manner.
  • Assist in the training and continued education of Sony Music team members working within the Orchard systems, across all applications.
 
Who You Are:
  • Multi-tasker with supreme attention to detail, follow-through and effective prioritization.
  • Patient and empathetic.
  • Effective communicator on phone, email, and in person.
  • Resourceful, problem solver, and takes initiative - an expert and motivated troubleshooter.
  • Spanish language skills preferred, but not required.

job.title: Systems Integration Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Systems Integration Engineer in Houston or Austin, TX. The Systems Integration Engineer will lead the mechanical, electrical, optical, and fluidic packaging of our proprietary analytical technologies into ruggedized, field-deployable products. major near-term focus for this position will be leading the systems integration for a new project measuring water quality parameters (produced water, flowback, and injection water) in harsh hydraulic fracturing environments, alongside our existing gas and liquid hydrocarbon applications. This role requires an interdisciplinary engineer who thrives on 3D CAD design, custom sampling systems, and hands-on field deployment.
 
Title: Systems Integration Engineer
Duration: DH
Location: Houston or Austin, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm

The Systems Integration Engineer will have direct responsibility for the following:
• Act as the technical lead for evaluating, sourcing, and integrating diverse third-party sensors (e.g., pH, conductivity, turbidity, pressure) into our core platform to fulfill unique customer measurement requests.
Design and specify custom sample conditioning systems (SCS) for both liquid and gas hydrocarbon/water streams. This includes integrating pressure regulation, active temperature control (heating/cooling), filtration loops, flow control, and automated grab-sampling systems.
• Own the layout, wiring, and thermal management of industrial, optional air-conditioned enclosures. Safely package complex internal hardware stacks, including spectrometers, fiber-optic routing, power supplies, embedded computers, ethernet switches, cellular modems, and PLCs.
• Evaluate and select appropriate wetted materials (e.g., 316SS, Hastelloy, Monel, PTFE) to ensure long-term system reliability when handling highly corrosive process streams or high-salinity oilfield water.
• Create, manage, and maintain complete engineering documentation packages using 3D and 2D CAD (SolidWorks). Deliverables include detailed mechanical manufacturing drawings, sheet metal design, piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), electrical schematics, bill of materials (BOMs), and custom installation/user/service manuals.
• Travel to customer sites to support installation, commissioning, site-acceptance testing (SAT), and hands-on troubleshooting of integrated systems in the field.
• Interface with fabrication partners, machine shops, and enclosure vendors. Supervise prototyping phases, conduct design reviews, and establish quality control/testing protocols for production-ready units.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following competencies:
• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience in product design, systems integration, or custom panel design – ideally within the process analytical, oil and gas, or water treatment industries.
• Proficient in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks preferred) with deep knowledge of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) and standard drafting practices.
• Familiarity with industrial hardware integration, including DC power distribution, PLCs, ethernet switches, cell modems, and industrial PCs.
• Proven experience designing NEMA 4X/IP66 industrial enclosures, including active thermal management calculations (heat load, solar gain, cooling sizing).
• Solid understanding of designing for Class I, Division 2 (C1D2) environments, including explosion-proof wiring and purge/pressurization systems.
• Willingness and capability to work in industrial field environments for deployment, commissioning, and technical troubleshooting.

Preferred Qualifications
• Direct experience with water chemistry or water management systems in hydraulic fracturing (fracking) operations.
• Familiarity with spectroscopy, laser safety protocols, or optoelectronic sub-systems.
• Hands-on prototyping skills (building test fixtures, light assembly, or fluidic plumbing).
• Experience of product design to meet strict regulatory and safety standards, ensuring compliance with Class I, Division 2 (C1D2) or Zone 2 requirements using methods such as physical isolation, explosion-proof components, or purge and pressurization systems.
Position Requirements
This is a full-time position based out of Houston, Austin, or Remote with standard business hours of 8:00am – 5:00pm, Monday through Friday. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required based on business needs.

job.title: Cosmetic R&D Chemist
job.description:
Our client, a Cosmetic Manufacturer that specializes in personal care products located in Southern California, a hub for the beauty industry, is actively looking to add a Cosmetic R&D Chemist to their team:

Industry: Cosmetics
Location: Los Angeles, CA
Type: Direct Hire
Shift: Monday-Friday: 8:00am-5:00pm

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 
  • Develop new formulas and reverse engineered formula based on customer’s briefs and price target.
  • Reformulate and improve existing formulas.
  • Follow new trends closely with new products launches, ingredients and new concept such as “free from” claims.
  • Be familiar with the formulation restrictions using these claims.
  • Be familiar with cosmetic ingredient especially their function, delivery system, interaction depending of media/base.
  • Meet with suppliers and keep product files (clinical and regulatory).
  • Work on Innovation, create new textures, concepts, actives to keep our R&D with cutting edge formulation.
  • Help creating marketing sheet to present to our customers in innovation seminars.
  • Request raw material pricing and input in our pricing matrix.
  • Evaluation/Selection/Advice regarding testing; Claims, Safety, Microbiology.
  • Assist Regulatory department requesting all the necessary ingredient information.
  • Be flexible with project priorities as they vary from time to time and manage a large workload under tight timeline.

job.title: Mid-Level Vehicle Systems Technician – Car-on-Bench Support
job.description:
Mid-Level Systems Technician
Seeking a technician to support a vehicle systems program focused on documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general system support. This role emphasizes electrical systems, wire harnesses, and system-level software rather than traditional mechanical repair. Candidates from automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields are encouraged to apply, and automotive experience is not required.

Scope:
• Perform hands-on inspection, testing, and troubleshooting of electrical and electromechanical systems.
• Read, interpret, and troubleshoot wire harnesses, wiring diagrams, schematics, and pinouts.
• Use OEM or system-level tools to read diagnostics, logs, and system status and support root cause analysis.
• Navigate documentation and database systems to locate procedures and record results.
• Support system validation activities and assist with issue resolution in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Required:
• Technician experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields (automotive experience not required).
• Experience working in a lab or shop environment, including tool and inventory management.
• Comfortable working in a team environment; this is not a solo position.
• Proficiency with hand tools and electrical test equipment (multimeters, continuity testers, oscilloscopes, power supplies, etc.).
• Experience using diagnostic, logging, flashing, or network analysis tools to troubleshoot hardware and software systems.
• Ability to read and follow schematics, wiring diagrams, manuals, and technical procedures.
• Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Pluses:
• Experience troubleshooting vehicle or embedded system software.
• Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet.
• Experience with sensors, calibration, or system validation testing.

job.title: Commercial Operations Analyst
job.description:
Commercial Lending Operations Specialist

About the Opportunity:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Commercial Lending Operations Specialist to support a financial services organization’s loan operations team. This position is ideal for someone with an accounting, finance, legal, or lending-related background who enjoys working with documentation, data, and multiple stakeholders.
The ideal candidate is organized, highly accurate, comfortable working with loan-related documentation, and willing to take on hands-on administrative and data entry responsibilities. Candidates with commercial lending, construction lending, captive finance, or dealership finance exposure are especially encouraged to apply, although this experience is not required.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Support the preparation, review, and processing of commercial loan documentation.
  • Assist with loan boarding, system updates, and accurate data entry into lending platforms
  • Coordinate with borrowers, legal counsel, commercial loan officers, operations, and other internal teams to support loan closings and funding
  • Verify insurance requirements and ensure necessary documentation is received and maintained
  • Assist with updating loan risk ratings, system flags, and other required loan information
  • Support construction lending activities, including reviewing reports and documentation from third-party construction monitors, contractors, and title companies
  • Assist with the review and processing of construction loan draws, disbursements, and revolving credit activity
  • Help monitor service levels and follow up with internal and external parties to keep transactions moving
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation while ensuring work is completed in accordance with established procedures.
  • Take on additional operational and administrative responsibilities as business needs require.
What We're Looking For

Required:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent college education
  • Background in Accounting, Finance, Legal, Lending, or a related field
  • Approximately 1–3+ years of relevant professional experience; more experienced candidates are also welcome
  • Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy and follow-through
  • Comfortable performing data entry and working with detailed documentation
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with different teams and stakeholders
  • Willingness to learn new systems, processes, and lending procedures
Nice to Have
  • Experience with commercial lending or commercial real estate lending
  • Exposure to construction loans or construction lending operations
  • Captive finance or dealership finance experience
  • Familiarity with loan servicing or loan origination systems
  • Experience working with legal, compliance, risk, treasury, or finance teams
Work Environment

This is a highly collaborative, onsite position requiring approximately 4 days in the office, with additional onsite time as business needs dictate. Candidates should be local and comfortable commuting to the office when required.
The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in producing thorough, accurate, high-quality work and is comfortable balancing detailed administrative responsibilities with coordination across multiple teams.

job.title: Senior Manager, Solutions Sales – IT & Engineering
job.description:
Senior Manager, Solutions Sales – IT & Engineering

Location: Fully Remote; preference for candidates in or around Los Angeles, California
Department: Sales / Business Development
Job Type: Full-Time
Compensation: $120,000–$140,000 base salary; $300,000+ total target compensation

About the Opportunity
Yoh is seeking a Senior Manager, Solutions Sales to drive growth across our IT and Engineering consulting, professional services, project delivery, and workforce solutions portfolio.

This is a senior, consultative sales role focused on expanding relationships with existing clients, developing new business opportunities beyond traditional staff augmentation, and acquiring net-new clients nationally and globally. Los Angeles will be the primary market focus, but the role will not be limited to a defined geographic territory.

The successful candidate will serve as a strategic advisor to clients, helping them address complex technology, engineering, transformation, and workforce challenges through Yoh’s portfolio of solutions.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own and execute a strategic business development plan for Yoh’s IT and Engineering solutions portfolio.
  • Expand existing client relationships by introducing consulting, professional services, project delivery, managed solutions, and workforce solutions.
  • Develop and close net-new client relationships across Los Angeles, nationally, and globally.
  • Identify complex business challenges and translate them into customized, value-based solutions.
  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, senior technology and engineering leaders, procurement stakeholders, and other decision-makers.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales pursuits from initial discovery through solution design, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner with Yoh’s recruiting, consulting, delivery, PCS, and executive leadership teams to develop and present client solutions.
  • Build account strategies that expand Yoh’s relationships across departments, business units, and locations.
  • Maintain a healthy, qualified pipeline and consistently achieve revenue, margin, new-client, and activity objectives.
  • Serve as a senior representative of Yoh at client meetings, industry events, executive forums, and networking activities.
  • Provide market insight and sales leadership that supports the continued growth of Yoh’s solutions business.
  • Maintain accurate account, opportunity, forecasting, and activity information in the CRM.
Ideal Candidate Profile
  • Senior-level consultative seller with a proven record of selling IT, engineering, consulting, professional services, project delivery, or workforce solutions.
  • Demonstrated success selling solutions beyond traditional staff augmentation, including project-based services, managed solutions, consulting engagements, or strategic workforce programs.
  • Strong track record of developing net-new business while expanding and growing existing accounts.
  • Established relationships with senior executives and decision-makers across technology, engineering, operations, HR, procurement, or business leadership.
  • Ability to lead strategic conversations and demonstrate how solutions can improve business outcomes, reduce risk, increase flexibility, or accelerate delivery.
  • Strong understanding of the Los Angeles business market, with the ability to leverage relationships nationally and globally.
  • Entrepreneurial, commercially minded, and comfortable creating new markets and revenue streams.
  • Executive presence with excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Highly self-directed and capable of operating effectively in a fully remote environment.
  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting, business planning, and CRM discipline.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 6+ years of successful experience in IT, engineering, consulting, professional services, project delivery, or workforce solutions sales.
  • Demonstrated success consistently achieving or exceeding significant sales and revenue targets.
  • Experience selling complex solutions to senior and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage long sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers and internal delivery teams.

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer -LI-ion Battery Management
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer - LI-ion Battery Management

Are you passionate about advancing battery technology and driving innovation in aerospace applications? Join our dynamic team as an Electrical Design Engineer specializing in Lithium-ion Battery Management Systems (BMS). In this critical role, you'll be at the forefront of designing cutting-edge digital control, analog, and mixed-signal solutions for aviation batteries, impacting the future of sustainable flight and aerospace safety.

Role Overview:
As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will develop and refine BMS hardware from concept through certification, working on everything from voltage sensing to cell balancing and system integration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring complex hardware and embedded software solutions to life, ensuring performance, reliability, and compliance in a high-stakes environment. Your expertise will contribute directly to safer, more efficient aerospace energy storage solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years experience designing lithium-ion battery management systems (BMS)
  • Proven experience in analog and mixed-signal circuit design and PCB schematic creation
  • Strong knowledge of cell sensing, protection, isolation, and balancing circuits for lithium batteries
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and results-driven focus
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to troubleshoot and validate hardware prototypes effectively
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience designing to environmental and EMI standards such as RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810/461, or RTCA DO-311
  • Familiarity with LiFePO4 chemistry and battery safety standards
  • Knowledge of DFM & DFT principles
  • Experience supporting embedded microcontroller software and certification processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (Master's preferred)
  • 5+ years designing BMS for aviation or similar high-reliability industries
  • Demonstrated success in product lifecycle management, from initial design to field application
Other Requirements:

  • On-site work in Wichita, KS
  • Willingness to work in a collaborative environment involving hardware, software, and mechanical teams
  • Good communication skills essential for team coordination
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any necessary security or certification clearances
Take your career to the next level by innovating in the rapidly evolving field of aviation battery technology. Apply now to become a vital part of our pioneering team—your expertise will shape the future of electric flight!

Enterprise Marketing Specialist
12 month contract
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Support the planning, creation, and execution of demand generation campaigns across multiple marketing channels.
  • Develop and deploy email nurture campaigns that support lead generation and advisor engagement goals.
  • Coordinate campaign assets, timelines, approvals, and launch activities.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to support demand generation initiatives, pilot programs, and marketing campaigns.
  • Ensure campaigns are executed accurately and on schedule.
  • Assist with audience segmentation and campaign targeting efforts.
  • Monitor campaign execution to ensure consistency with brand standards and business objectives.
 
Content Development
  • Create and adapt marketing assets, including: Social media posts, Carousel posts, Infographics, Short-form videos and video reels, Checklists, Guides, E-books, Lead magnets, Landing page content, Email communication
  • Repurpose existing content into multiple formats to maximize reach and engagement
  • Support content customization and personalization initiatives for advisor audiences
  • Assist in maintaining content calendars and campaign schedules
  • Apply best practices for demand generation, lead capture, and audience engagement.
 
Compliance Review & Approval Management
  • Prepare and submit marketing materials for compliance review and approval.
  • Coordinate revisions resulting from compliance feedback.
  • Maintain records and documentation related to marketing approvals.
  • Ensure all materials adhere to brand standards, regulatory requirements, and compliance guidelines.
  • Manage timelines and communications throughout the review process to support timely campaign execution.
 
AI Content Enablement
  • Utilize AI tools to improve content development efficiency and campaign execution.
  • Develop, test, and refine prompts for content creation, personalization, and campaign support.
  • Build and maintain a centralized prompt library that can be leveraged across the marketing team.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows through AI-assisted processes.
  • Document repeatable AI-enabled workflows and best practices.
  • Serve as an advocate for responsible AI adoption and continuous improvement within the marketing team.
 
Campaign Measurement & Optimization
  • Tracking campaign performance and engagement metrics.
  • Monitoring lead generation results and conversion trends.
  • Supporting reporting on marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
  • Analyzing performance across email campaigns, lead magnets, content initiatives, and demand generation programs.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve campaign performance.

  • Supporting the development of reporting and dashboards for leadership.

  • 3+ years of experience supporting demand generation, content marketing, digital marketing, campaign management, or marketing operations.
  • Experience developing and executing email marketing campaigns, nurture programs, and lead generation initiatives.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, WriterAI, or similar tools to support content creation, research, or workflow efficiency.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing data and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.

  • Experience creating campaign performance reports and presenting insights to stakeholders.

  • Experience developing prompt libraries, AI workflows, or AI-assisted marketing processes.
  • Experience supporting marketing efforts within regulated industries that require formal approval and compliance review processes.
  • Experience leveraging campaign performance data to recommend business improvements.

job.description:
Remote-Clinical Appeals Coordinator (RN) needed for a contract  opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Philadelphia or surrounding PA area. (Candidates must reside in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or Delaware)

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:30 AM-4:00 PM or 8:00 AM-4:30 PM, with occasional rotating Saturday and holiday coverage.

Position Summary
We are seeking experienced Registered Nurses to join our Clinical Appeals team. In this role, you will support the review and resolution of clinical appeals by applying clinical judgment, utilization management knowledge, benefit interpretation, and evidence-based review criteria. This position plays a key role in ensuring appeals are processed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with regulatory standards.

Top Skills Should You Possess:
  • RN
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Review and manage clinical appeals from intake through final resolution.
  • Evaluate medical records, benefit information, prior authorizations, denial rationale, and supporting clinical documentation.
  • Apply clinical nursing knowledge and utilization management principles to support appeal determinations.
  • Coordinate with Medical Directors, physician reviewers, and cross-functional teams on complex cases.
  • Prepare case summaries and ensure all appeal documentation is complete and audit-ready.
  • Support member and provider communications related to appeal outcomes.
  • Monitor appeal timelines to ensure compliance with state, federal, and accreditation requirements.
  • Identify trends, process improvements, and quality enhancement opportunities.
  • Participate in training, audits, calibration sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Active Registered Nurse (RN) license; Pennsylvania RN license (or compact license that includes PA eligibility) required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of clinical nursing experience.
  • Experience in one or more of the following:
    • Utilization Management
    • Prior Authorization
    • Concurrent or Retrospective Review
    • Case Management
    • Appeals and Grievances
    • Managed Care Operations
  • Strong knowledge of medical necessity review, benefit interpretation, and clinical documentation.
  • Ability to review medical records and apply evidence-based criteria.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and healthcare management systems.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN).
  • Health plan or managed care experience.
  • Experience with NCQA standards and accreditation requirements.
  • Familiarity with InterQual, MCG, CMS guidelines, and medical policy review.
  • Experience supporting Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, or ACA appeals.
  • Audit, quality review, or regulatory compliance experience.
