job.title: VP - Business Operations & Strategy
job.description:
VP - Business Operations & Strategy

Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming complex business operations and driving strategic growth? Join our client as the Vice President of Business Operations & Strategy and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our dynamic, rapidly scaling vacation rental platform. You will lead enterprise transformation initiatives, oversee high-impact M&A integrations, and deliver measurable results that fuel our mission to build the world’s best vacation rental company.

About the Role
As a key member of our executive team you will spearhead strategic initiatives across markets, brands, and functions. Your expertise will enable seamless integrations, operational improvements, and innovative solutions, all while collaborating with senior stakeholders to unlock value and accelerate growth. This is your chance to influence a company backed by seasoned investors and led by leaders with deep roots in hospitality, travel, and technology.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • 5-8+ years in management consulting, strategy & transformation, or high-intensity business environments
  • Proven ability to structure complex problems, influence senior stakeholders, and lead initiatives end-to-end
  • Experience with M&A integration, multi-unit operations, or platform environments is advantageous
  • Exceptional analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling capabilities
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous settings
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools for strategic work is a plus
Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Prior exposure to hospitality, travel, or private equity sectors
  • Fluency in deploying innovative operating models and process improvements
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with disciplined execution
Preferred Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; an MBA or similar qualification is highly preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years in strategy, management consulting, or operational leadership roles
  • Experience driving enterprise-wide transformation initiatives
Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to travel approximately 25-35% to support integration and strategic initiatives
  • Passion for building and scaling innovative platforms with high ownership and impact mindset
If you’re ready to lead transformative change at an exciting, fast-growing company and want to make a meaningful impact in the travel and hospitality industry, we invite you to apply now. Embark on a career journey that combines strategic vision with operational excellence—your next big opportunity awaits!

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Engineer for our client. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting product and manufacturing quality through inspection and testing strategies, defect analysis, statistical analysis, documentation control, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Quality Engineer will work closely with Development, Product, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to ensure products and processes meet company, customer, and industry quality standards. This position requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify quality issues, develop effective solutions, and drive improvements in a regulated environment.

Industry: Medical Device 
Location: Redondo Beach, CA
Compensation: $99k-104k/yr


Job Functions
  • Review and thoroughly understand product functional and design specifications.
  • Develop and implement methods and procedures for inspecting, testing, and evaluating the precision and accuracy of products and production equipment.
  • Design or specify inspection and testing mechanisms and equipment.
  • Conduct Quality Assurance testing to ensure products meet established requirements.
  • Perform statistical analysis to evaluate products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications.
  • Conduct defect analysis utilizing statistical quality and process analytical methods.
  • Prepare and maintain Quality reports and support documentation control systems.
  • Review returned materials and verify customer complaints, developing action plans to address identified discrepancies.
  • Communicate with customers regarding Quality issues and resolutions as required.
  • Partner with operators and technicians to identify and resolve day-to-day Quality Assurance issues.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple projects while working within design specifications and budget requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of evolving Quality Assurance codes, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Document test cases and interpret technical and business objectives.
  • Work closely with Development and Product teams to support Quality initiatives.
  • Identify software bugs and support appropriate testing and resolution activities.
  • Recommend changes and improvements to enhance overall product quality.
  • Ensure products comply with company and applicable industry Quality standards.
  • Develop and implement systems that promote conformity and accuracy throughout the production process.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions for identified Quality and product issues.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required; Master's degree in Engineering preferred.
  • Professional certifications or 10+ years of equivalent work experience may be considered.
  • Previous experience working in a Quality Assurance environment required.
  • Knowledge of ISO 13485 and applicable EU standards.
  • MDR experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Quality Assurance and testing tools.
  • Knowledge of SQL and scripting.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify issues and develop effective solutions.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Full-time, onsite work environment.
  • Regular use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office and technical equipment.
  • Ability to work within manufacturing, Quality, and product development environments as required.
  • Must be able to review detailed technical documentation, specifications, test results, and Quality records for extended periods.

job.title: Appeals Specialists-Hybrid
job.description:
Hybrid-Appeals Specialist needed for a contract  opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Philadelphia, PA.

Schedule: Tuesday-Wednesday-Thursday onsite 7:30 AM-4:00 PM or 8:00 AM-4:30 PM

Overview
We’re hiring multiple Appeals Specialists to independently investigate, document, and process member and provider appeals across assigned lines of business in accordance with applicable federal/state requirements, accreditation standards, and internal policies. This role is responsible for building complete, audit-ready case files, rendering administrative determinations within delegated authority, preparing compliant correspondence, and driving timely effectuations.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage assigned appeals from receipt through investigation, determination, notification, effectuation, and closure while meeting all turnaround times.
  • Validate appeal details (request, classification, authority, timeframe, eligibility/benefits, claim/authorization history, denial rationale, and documentation).
  • Research and reconcile discrepancies across denial letters, claims, authorizations, and case-system information; escalate misrouted/unclear cases.
  • Interpret applicable benefits and governing documentation (EOC/SPD/benefit booklets), claims/EOBs, policies, and regulatory guidance.
  • Build complete case files and write clear case notes, narratives, and decision rationales.
  • Prepare external review packages when required and track outcomes.
  • Draft and validate acknowledgment/RFI/dismissal/determination letters using approved templates and required language.
  • Initiate and monitor effectuations/claim adjustments; track and escalate delays.
  • Communicate with members, authorized representatives, providers, vendors, and internal partners by phone and in writing.
  • Manage daily inventory, prioritize expedited/aging cases, and meet quality/timeliness expectations.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, population health, or related field.
  • 3+ years of healthcare operations experience required.
  • Medicare experience
  • Utilization Management or Appeals/Grievances experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of plan products, benefits, and claims procedures.
  • Strong research, documentation, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to handle complex issues and collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Must have your own laptop and monitor

job.description:
Fiber Field Technician

Join a dynamic team and play a vital role in the installation, maintenance, and monitoring of cutting-edge fiber optic networks in the IL Rockford, Dekalb, Rochelle, Peru and Lasalle areas. As a Fiber Field Technician, you will be the frontline hero ensuring seamless connectivity, supporting both wholesale and enterprise customers. This role offers competitive pay, shift premiums, on-call pay, company vehicle, and the opportunity to make a tangible impact in the telecommunications industry.

Required Skills:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in a telecommunications environment or equivalent technical training
  • Expertise in DS3/DS1, SONET/DWDM installation and maintenance
  • Strong understanding of IP/MPLS fundamentals
  • Proficiency with test equipment such as OTDR, OSA, DS1/3, and Ethernet testing tools
  • Ability to analyze, monitor, and resolve network issues promptly
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record
  • Self-motivated with strong decision-making skills
  • Excellent PC skills and strong oral and written communication
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Cisco or Alcatel Lucent IP certifications
  • Experience with VOIP switching and maintenance
  • Fiber optics splicing and maintenance knowledge
  • SS7/STP support experience
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • College or technical degree in related field or equivalent experience
Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to work day, evening, night shifts, overtime, call-ins, weekends, and holidays as needed
  • Ability to work in demanding environments and multi-task effectively
Ready to be a key contributor in a fast-paced telecommunications setting? If you’re driven, skilled, and eager to advance your career, we want to hear from you—apply today and help us keep the world connected!


Preferred Locations:  Rockford, Dekalb, Rochelle, Dixon area

job.description:
Onsite Intermediate Financial Analyst needed for a 12-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Santa Clara, California.


Shifts Available: Mon-Fri Day shift


Pay Rate:$40-$45 per hour


The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change

What You Will Be Doing:
  • Must have skills : FP&A, Budgeting and Forecast, Reporting, Experience with tools like Tableau, Anaplan, SAP, SAP BPC, Experience with building financial models in Excel.

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field with 2-5 years’ experience.

Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator (RN or LVN) needed for a temp 6+ month, remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s managed care health plan client based out of Redding or Fairfield, CA. Anticipating to be temporary for at least 6 months with potential for temp-to-hire. Multiple openings available!

Training will be onsite (in either Fairfield or Redding) for the first 3 weeks and then will transition to fully remote. 
--> Monday-Friday 8am to 5pm with one weekend per month.

Utilize your clinical expertise to support quality, cost-effective healthcare in a fully remote managed care setting. The UM RN Nurse Coordinator reviews outpatient authorization requests, assesses medical necessity, collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, and helps ensure members receive the right care at the right time while maintaining compliance with regulatory and health plan guidelines.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse or Licensed Vocational Nurse license in California
  • Experience in Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Case Management, or Managed Care
  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plan guidelines
  • High degree of independence, flexibility, initiative, and commitment
  • Solid critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, member-service oriented environment

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and audit activities

  • Must be able to work Monday - Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm with one weekend per month
  • At least 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience
  • Experience reviewing outpatient authorizations and medical necessity determinations.
  • Strong understanding of CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plan regulations.

  • Great work-life balance with this being 100% remote and primarily Mon-Fri
  • Work at a company that focuses on mission-driven work with real community impact

job.title: Senior Identity Access Management Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Senior IAM Engineer
Location: Holmdel, NJ- Hybrid( 3 days onsite)
Type: Full time 
Salary: $140000- $160000/yr 


The Senior IAM Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and handling identity and access management (IAM) solutions to ensure the security and efficiency of the organization's IT infrastructure. This role involves working closely with various groups to understand their IAM needs and providing expert guidance on standard methodologies and solutions.
 
You Will:

  • Design and implement IAM solutions, including identity governance, access management, and privileged access management.
  • Develop and maintain IAM policies, procedures, and standards to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with IT and security teams to integrate IAM solutions with existing systems and applications.
  • Conduct regular audits and assessments of IAM systems to identify and mitigate potential security risks.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for IAM-related issues.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in IAM and recommend improvements to existing systems and processes.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior IAM engineers and other team members.

You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in IAM engineering or a related field.
  • Strong knowledge of IAM concepts, technologies, and standard processes.
  • Experience with IAM platforms, including Okta, PingFederate, SailPoint, CyberArk, and Microsoft Azure AD/Entra ID.
  • Experience with reverse proxy solutions, including Okta Access Gateway and Microsoft App Proxy.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or similar are a plus.
  • Passion for problem-solving and continuous curiosity to learn.
  • Understanding of security control concepts and their application in IAM.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

You Are:
  • Experience with cloud-based IAM solutions and integrations.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and standards related to IAM, such as GDPR, HIPAA, and SOX.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and AWS.
  • Experience with scripting and automation tools to streamline IAM processes.

job.title: Senior Software Test and Automation Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Senior Software Test & Automation Engineer to join our Autonomous Technology client. This opportunity is ideal for candidates within commutable distance of San Diego, CA or Dallas, TX who are comfortable working in an onsite environment.

This engineer will support the testing and validation of advanced autonomous systems by developing automated test frameworks, building validation tools, and executing system-level verification across simulated and hardware-based environments. The role will partner closely with software, systems, integration, and test teams to improve test coverage, identify system issues, and ensure software is ready for deployment.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Senior Software Test & Automation Engineer
Location: San Diego, CA or Dallas, TX (Onsite)
Compensation: $65.00–$85.00/hour depending on experience
Type: Contract
Eligibility: Must be authorized to work in the United States. Additional U.S. Person eligibility requirements may apply based on access to export-controlled technology.

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks, validation tools, and supporting infrastructure for complex autonomous software systems.
  • Develop and execute verification strategies across simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Vehicle-in-the-Loop (VIL), and other representative test environments.
  • Create automated regression, integration, functional, and performance testing to improve software reliability and release confidence.
  • Build Python-based automation, test harnesses, and data analysis tools to increase testing efficiency and repeatability.
  • Review test results, troubleshoot software and system integration issues, and participate in root-cause investigations.
  • Develop metrics, reporting tools, and dashboards that provide visibility into software quality, performance, and deployment readiness.
  • Incorporate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to provide continuous validation and timely feedback to engineering teams.
  • Partner with software, systems, integration, and test engineering teams to establish validation strategies, test requirements, and readiness criteria.
  • Continuously improve automation coverage, test infrastructure, and verification processes for advanced autonomous platforms.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 4+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, verification and validation, or related engineering work involving robotics, autonomous systems, aerospace, or similarly complex systems.
  • Strong Python programming skills with experience developing automation, testing, or data analysis solutions.
  • Hands-on experience creating automated test frameworks, test harnesses, or validation infrastructure.
  • Experience working within Linux-based development environments.
  • Experience testing software using simulation, SIL, HIL, VIL, or comparable hardware-integrated environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex software and system-level integration problems.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated or continuous testing practices.
  • Solid understanding of software verification, regression testing, integration testing, and quality methodologies.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional engineering environments.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with autonomous vehicles, robotics, unmanned aircraft, or other safety-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with flight-control platforms such as ArduPilot or PX4.
  • Experience supporting fixed-wing or multirotor unmanned aerial systems.
  • Knowledge of flight controllers, radios, communications equipment, or related embedded hardware.
  • Previous experience within aerospace, defense, aviation, or autonomous technology environments.

job.title: Per-Diem Occupational Health Nurse (RN)
job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurse needed for a per-diem contract opportunity with Yoh’s well-known client located in Chula Vista, CA.


This clinic offers occupational and preventative care only for employees onsite. You will typically be the only medical professional onsite. Primarily there for first-aid, basic walk-in care (minor acute care like colds, rashes, pink eye, etc.) and in case of an emergency.
--> Shifts needed so far, 7am to 3:30pm: Thursday November 5th and Friday November 6th with three shifts sometime prior to starting, for orientation/training.
 

Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in state of California 
  • Minimum (3) years' experience as a Registered Nurse
  • Preferred experience in: Occupational Health, Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, School Nursing, or Corrections type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Nursing assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Provide wellness materials/information
  • Provide medical testing such as pulmonary function, blood glucose, blood pressure, cholesterol, vision and hearing screening and perform limited interpretation of tests
  • Charting/assessments
  • First-aid and minor acute care (ie triage - cold sores, rashes, pink eye, eye flushes, etc)
  • Respond to emergencies and provide emergency medical care for employees onsite (assist First Responders in medical emergencies)

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • Flexibility to work on an as-needed basis between Monday and Friday from 7:00am-3:30pm
    • *Shifts are very infrequent, covering when their full-time nurse needs time off of work (PTO and sick time call outs)
  • BLS certified (hands on courses only - no online accepted)
  • Yearly TB test or QuantiFERON Gold
  • Proof of U.S. Citizenship (ie U.S. Passport or original U.S. Birth Certificate) for security badging/clearance

What’s In It For You?

  • Great work-life balance (predictable hours - no nights, holidays, or weekends!)
  • Expand your experience alongside a trusted and well-respected organization
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and we place health care professionals on jobs nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest Medical Assistant, Nurse, Nurse Practitioner, and Physician Assistant openings!

job.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Autonomy Behaviors
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Staff Engineer, Autonomy Behaviors to join our advanced technology client supporting the development and deployment of next-generation autonomous systems. This senior-level engineering role will focus on designing sophisticated autonomy capabilities for unmanned platforms operating in complex, real-world environments.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in robotics, autonomous systems, motion planning, decision-making, and high-performance software development, with the ability to translate advanced algorithms into deployable capabilities. This is a highly technical, hands-on position that will work across software, simulation, hardware, and flight-test teams.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other engineering opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Senior Staff Engineer, Autonomy Behaviors
Location: Washington, D.C.; Boston, MA; San Diego, CA; or San Mateo, CA
Work Environment: Onsite
Type: Contract
Compensation: $120-170/hr DOE 
Clearance: Must be eligible to obtain a U.S. Government Secret security clearance

Responsibilities
  • Design and develop advanced autonomy algorithms that enable unmanned aircraft and other robotic platforms to execute complex missions with limited human intervention.
  • Build high-performance software supporting autonomous planning, decision-making, mission behaviors, and execution in dynamic operating environments.
  • Develop and validate behavior architectures supporting capabilities such as multi-agent coordination, reconnaissance, tactical decision-making, survivability, and mission execution.
  • Combine traditional autonomy and controls techniques with modern machine learning approaches to develop robust and adaptable autonomous behaviors.
  • Apply concepts including motion planning, optimization, aircraft dynamics, trajectory generation, information fusion, and decision-making to operational autonomy challenges.
  • Partner closely with perception, planning, simulation, systems, hardware, and flight-test engineering teams to integrate autonomy software onto real-world platforms.
  • Use simulation environments and mission-level testing to evaluate algorithms prior to deployment and identify opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Analyze system telemetry, mission logs, and test results to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and improve autonomy performance.
  • Support integration activities, flight demonstrations, field testing, and other operational validation events.
  • Research and prototype emerging autonomy technologies while contributing technical direction to future capabilities and product roadmaps.
  • Adapt autonomy solutions to meet evolving program requirements, customer needs, and operational environments.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance across complex autonomy initiatives while promoting sound engineering practices and reusable technical approaches.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
  • Typically 10+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree, 9+ years with a Master's degree, or 7+ years with a PhD.
  • Advanced programming skills in C++ and Python.
  • Experience developing software for real-time or performance-sensitive systems, including familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Significant hands-on experience with robotics or autonomous systems, particularly in areas such as motion planning, behavior modeling, autonomous decision-making, controls, or mission autonomy.
  • Strong experience developing algorithms for unmanned systems, with particular emphasis on aerial platforms.
  • Experience using modeling and simulation environments for autonomy development, testing, and validation; familiarity with tools such as AFSIM or NGTS is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of software integration concepts, interfaces, system architecture, and testing within complex multidisciplinary systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and optimize system-level performance.
  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10–15% for integration activities, customer engagements, testing, and demonstrations.
  • Must meet applicable U.S. Government requirements to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience incorporating machine learning or reinforcement learning into autonomous systems.
  • Background developing collaborative autonomy, swarm behaviors, multi-agent coordination, or distributed decision-making systems.
  • Experience developing tactical autonomy capabilities for U.S. Government or defense-related programs.
  • Exposure to autonomous behaviors spanning multiple operational domains, including air, ground, or maritime platforms.
  • Hands-on participation in flight testing, live demonstrations, field exercises, or operational system integration.
  • Familiarity with UCI and OMS standards.

job.title: Microsoft 365/Exchange Engineer
job.description:
Job Title:Microsoft 365/Exchange Engineer 
Location: Charlotte, NC
Type: Hybrid- 3 days onsite
Terms: Full Time


Position summary:
Our client is seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Microsoft 365 Communication Systems Engineer to join our Corporate Platform Engineering team. This role emphasizes Exchange administration (on-prem and cloud), Microsoft Teams management, and M365 governance, with strong knowledge of Purview retention policies and Defender for Cloud. The ideal candidate will be a well-rounded M365/Entra/Azure engineer who can troubleshoot complex issues, drive adoption of integrated SaaS solutions (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow in Teams), and maintain a secure, compliant environment.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Exchange Administration
  • Manage and maintain Exchange Online and on-prem Exchange environments, including mail flow, hybrid configurations, and security hardening.
  • Implement and maintain Exchange Online Protection (EOP) and Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing, Safe Links, and Safe Attachments.
  • Troubleshoot mail delivery, transport rules, and compliance issues.
  • Manage mail routing, transport rules, connectors, accepted domains, DKIM, DMARC, SPF, and hybrid mail flow configurations.
  • Administer shared mailboxes, resource mailboxes, distribution groups, Microsoft 365 Groups, and mail-enabled security groups.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting of mail flow, hybrid connectivity, directory synchronization, transport services, message trace analysis, and client connectivity issues.
 
Microsoft Teams Management
  • Configure and maintain Teams governance, policies, lifecycle management, external access, guest access, and collaboration settings.
  • Drive adoption of Teams integrations with SaaS platforms like Jira and ServiceNow.
  • Support Teams Phone, Auto Attendants, and Call Queues where applicable.
  • Support Teams Rooms and meeting experience enhancements.
 
Compliance & Security
  • Partner with Information Security teams to support Microsoft Purview retention, compliance, and information governance initiatives across Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint Online.

job.title: Lab Operations Associate, Sample Management - Onsite, Cambridge, MA
job.description:
Lab Operations Associate, Sample Management, Onsite, Cambridge, MA
  Overview We are seeking a Lab Operations Associate to support Sample Management activities involving the receipt, storage, tracking, inventory, and shipment of clinical and nonclinical samples.

This individual will work in a fast-paced laboratory environment and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure samples are accurately processed, documented, stored, and transferred within required timelines. The role includes maintaining sample inventory within a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and coordinating domestic and international shipments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support end-to-end tracking and logistics for clinical and nonclinical samples.
  • Perform sample management and archive activities including labeling, receipt, transfer, tracking, inventory, storage, shipping, and disposal.
  • Process and maintain sample information within LIMS.
  • Reconcile samples and shipments, identify discrepancies, and coordinate resolution of inventory or documentation issues.
  • Investigate and correct sample or inventory discrepancies within LIMS.
  • Collaborate with laboratory and operations teams to ensure samples are available for transfer and analysis.
  • Maintain accurate inventory of clinical and nonclinical samples, test materials, and reference materials.
  • Maintain SOPs, working procedures, and forms related to sample receipt, storage, and disposition.
  • Maintain inventory of laboratory consumables used by the Sample Management team.
  • Coordinate domestic and international shipments to external research partners.
  • Prepare required shipping documentation, including customs information, tariff requests, and declared values.
  • Coordinate with shipping vendors to maintain required temperatures and ensure safe delivery.
  • Track and monitor shipments from sample collection through receipt.
  • Complete assignments accurately and within established timelines while maintaining detailed documentation.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline required.
  • 3–5 years of relevant industry experience.
  • 3+ years of laboratory experience preferred.
  • Experience with LIMS applications and/or implementation preferred.
  • Experience with sample management, laboratory inventory, sample logistics, or similar laboratory operations strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, team-based environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word; Smartsheet experience helpful.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal procedures accurately.
  • Ability to lift approximately 50 lbs. and remain on your feet for extended periods.

job.title: Quality Inspector
job.description:
Quality Inspector 

Planet is seeking a disciplined Contract Quality Inspector to support our satellite manufacturing programs. This role is focused on the tactical execution of inspections across all stages of production, ensuring that every component and subassembly meets our rigorous aerospace standards. This is a high-volume, execution-oriented position for a technician who excels at identifying mechanical and electrical anomalies in a fast-paced environment. 

Impact You’ll Own 

  • Production Inspection: Perform detailed physical inspections of incoming parts and in-process subassemblies to ensure 100% compliance with drawings and specifications. This includes inspecting a wide variety of hardware, from batches of 100+ cable assemblies to complex solar panels and sensors. 

  • Mechanical and Electrical Verification: Utilize precision measurement tools (calipers, micrometers, drop gauges) to verify mechanical tolerances and perform visual inspections of electrical assemblies for solder and cabling defects. You will be responsible for ensuring threads are correct and fitment is exact for all metal parts and housings. 

  • Microscopic Inspection: Conduct high-detail inspections of PCBAs under a microscope to identify solder defects, component misalignment, or contamination. This requires a high level of focus and attention to detail. 

  • Non-Conformance Reporting: Meticulously record and report all quality anomalies using in-house software and Jira. You will be responsible for identifying non-conforming material and ensuring it is correctly tagged and moved to the MRB (Material Review Board) area. 

  • Laboratory Standards: Maintain an organized, ESD-safe, and FOD-free inspection area, adhering strictly to cleanroom protocols. 

  • Adaptability: Maintain extreme attention to detail while shifting between different types of hardware daily based on production priorities. 

What You Bring 

  • 5+ Years of Quality Inspection Experience: Proven background in a high-precision manufacturing environment, such as Aerospace, Medical Devices, or Defense. 

  • Technical Interpretation: Proficiency in reading and interpreting complex mechanical drawings, GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing), and electrical schematics. 

  • Precision Measurement Mastery: Expert-level experience with manual and digital measurement tools to verify sub-millimeter tolerances and thread specifications. 

  • Microscope Proficiency: Significant experience performing prolonged, detailed inspections under a microscope for fine-pitch electronics and delicate assemblies. 

  • Build-Cycle Familiarity: Experience working within a production line where your role is to inspect and move hardware forward efficiently. 

  • Software Proficiency: Comfort using Google Sheets, Jira, and proprietary tracking software to log high volumes of inspection data daily. 

  • Attention to Detail: An uncompromising eye for detail and the ability to communicate technical issues clearly and concisely to engineering teams. 

What Makes You Stand Out (Nice to have) 

  • IPC-A-610 or J-STD-001 Certification: Specific experience inspecting high-reliability solder joints and electronic assemblies. 

  • Experience with AS9100 or ISO 9001: Familiarity with the documentation rigor required for aerospace-grade quality management systems. 

  • Material Review Board (MRB) Experience: Practical experience with the physical and digital handling of non-conforming materials. 

  • Collaborative Mindset: The ability to act as a firm but professional gatekeeper of quality while maintaining strong working relationships with the assembly teams.

Location: Hybrid - 3 days onsite in Hudson Yards, New York City

This role is ideal for a seasoned IT professional who thrives in high-visibility environments, enjoys solving complex technical challenges, and delivers exceptional white-glove support to senior executives.
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted technology partner to executive stakeholders while helping drive modern workplace initiatives across endpoint management, collaboration technologies, AV support, security, and automation.

End User Computing & Device Management
  • Troubleshoot and support Windows endpoints and virtual desktop environments.
  • Manage and support Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, AWS WorkSpaces, and traditional VDI platforms.
  • Administer and support Microsoft Intune, SCCM, and Windows Autopilot.
  • Oversee executive device lifecycle management including provisioning, upgrades, refreshes, maintenance, and retirement.
Audiovisual & Collaboration Support
  • Support executive conference rooms, meeting spaces, and hybrid work environments.
  • Manage Microsoft Teams Rooms and associated AV technologies including displays, cameras, microphones, room-control systems, and conferencing hardware.
  • Partner with facilities teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure successful meeting execution.
  • Provide both onsite and remote support for collaboration technologies.
Security & Compliance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience mentoring support staff or serving as a senior technical lead.

job.title: UM Nurse Coordinator (RN or LVN)
job.description:
Utilization Management Nurse Coordinator (RN or LVN) needed for a temp 6+ month, remote contract opportunity with Yoh’s managed care health plan client based out of Fairfield & Redding, CA. Anticipating to be temporary for at least 6 months with potential for temp-to-hire. Multiple openings available!

Training will be onsite (in either Fairfield or Redding) for the first 3 weeks and then will transition to fully remote. 
--> Monday-Friday 8am to 5pm with one weekend per month.

Utilize your clinical expertise to support quality, cost-effective healthcare in a fully remote managed care setting. The UM RN Nurse Coordinator reviews outpatient authorization requests, assesses medical necessity, collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, and helps ensure members receive the right care at the right time while maintaining compliance with regulatory and health plan guidelines.


Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse or Licensed Vocational Nurse license in California
  • Experience in Utilization Management, Prior Authorization, Case Management, or Managed Care
  • Familiarity with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial health plan guidelines
  • High degree of independence, flexibility, initiative, and commitment
  • Solid critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, member-service oriented environment

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Review outpatient authorization requests using InterQual and established clinical guidelines
  • Evaluate medical necessity, appropriateness of treatment, and benefit coverage requirements
  • Analyze clinical documentation submitted by providers and facilities
  • Approve services within designated RN authority levels and refer complex cases to Medical Directors as needed
  • Communicate with providers to obtain additional clinical information required for determinations
  • Ensure compliance with CMS, NCQA, DHCS, state, federal, and health plan regulations
  • Accurately document review findings in the utilization management system
  • Meet turnaround time requirements for authorization decisions
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and audit activities
  • Collaborate with Case Management, Care Coordination, Disease Management, and Provider Relations teams

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Must be able to work Monday - Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm with one weekend per month
  • At least 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience
  • Experience reviewing outpatient authorizations and medical necessity determinations.
  • Strong understanding of CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial health plan regulations.

What’s In It For You?
  • Great work-life balance with this being 100% remote and primarily Mon-Fri
  • Work at a company that focuses on mission-driven work with real community impact
  • Foot in the door at a company with strong name recognition in Bay Area healthcare
  • Competitive compensation with weekly direct deposit every Friday

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and case management services. We partner with well-known companies, hospitals, and managed care companies nationwide to place top healthcare professionals. To explore our current openings, visit www.yoh.com!

job.title: AWS Workspaces Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: AWS Workspaces Engineer
Location: Charlotte,NC
Terms: Full Time
Type: Hybrid - 3 days onsite

Position summary:
Our client is seeking a highly skilled Cloud Computing Engineer specializing in Amazon WorkSpaces to design, implement, optimize, and support our cloud-based virtual desktop environment. This role will serve as the primary technical owner for AWS WorkSpaces architecture, image management, automation, identity integration, security, monitoring, and platform operations.
 
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise across AWS WorkSpaces, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Windows endpoint management, cloud networking, automation, and authentication technologies. This individual will lead platform engineering efforts, establish operational standards, drive automation initiatives, support large-scale desktop deployments, and help evolve our virtual desktop strategy from traditional on-premises VDI solutions toward a modern cloud-based desktop platform.
This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical leadership, troubleshooting expertise, and the ability to independently own complex infrastructure initiatives from design through production support.

Key Responsibilities
AWS WorkSpaces Engineering & Architecture
  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale Amazon WorkSpaces environments.
  • Architect and manage AWS WorkSpaces deployments across multiple environments.
  • Develop long-term platform strategy, scalability planning, and operational standards.
  • Evaluate and implement new AWS EUC technologies and features.
  • Conduct capacity planning, performance analysis, and platform optimization.
  • Support disaster recovery planning, testing, and recovery validation procedures.
  • Perform root cause analysis for complex platform-wide issues.
  • undefined
Image Management & Desktop Engineering
  • Build, maintain, and optimize AWS WorkSpaces custom images and bundles.
  • Create standardized gold images aligned with security and operational requirements.
  • Validate Windows updates, application patching, and security configurations before promotion to production.
  • Manage image lifecycle processes, testing procedures, rollback strategies, and release documentation.
  • Implement automation for image creation, validation, and deployment.
  • Ensure image consistency across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Establish desktop hardening standards and compliance baselines.
 
Identity, Directory Services & Authentication
  • Design and support integrations between AWS WorkSpaces, Microsoft Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Manage AWS Directory Services and hybrid identity configurations.
  • Troubleshoot directory synchronization, computer object creation, OU placement, and authentication workflows.
  • Support hybrid identity solutions involving Active Directory, Entra Connect, and Intune.
  • Configure and maintain MFA integrations utilizing RADIUS authentication.
  • Lead initiatives to migrate legacy authentication methods toward SAML-based federation.
  • Support Single Sign-On solutions and modern authentication architectures.
 
Intune & Endpoint Management Integration
  • Partner with Endpoint Engineering teams to integrate AWS WorkSpaces with Microsoft Intune.
  • Ensure proper enrollment and management of hybrid-joined WorkSpaces devices.
  • Support application deployment, policy management, compliance enforcement, and reporting through Intune.
  • Troubleshoot device registration and management issues involving Entra ID and Intune.
  • Develop standards for cloud-hosted desktop management using Microsoft technologies.
  • Collaborate on endpoint security, patching, and configuration management initiatives.
 
Cloud Infrastructure & Networking
  • Administer AWS networking components supporting WorkSpaces environments.
  • Manage Route 53 DNS configurations and name resolution services.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity, routing, firewall, VPN, and DNS-related issues.
  • Work closely with network engineering teams to optimize cloud connectivity and user experience.
  • Understand VPC design, subnets, security groups, network ACLs, and routing principles as they relate to WorkSpaces deployments.
  • Support desktop access from Windows, macOS, thin clients, and mobile platforms.
 
Automation & Platform Engineering
  • Develop automation solutions utilizing AWS Lambda, PowerShell, Python, and AWS native services.
  • Automate provisioning, monitoring, remediation, reporting, and operational workflows.
  • Create self-healing mechanisms for common platform issues.
  • Maintain infrastructure-as-code standards where applicable.
  • Reduce operational overhead through orchestration and automation initiatives.
 
Monitoring & Operational Excellence
  • Configure and maintain CloudWatch dashboards, metrics, alarms, and logging.
  • Develop proactive monitoring and alerting capabilities.
  • Analyze performance trends and resource utilization.
  • Implement operational reporting and executive dashboards.
  • Participate in incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis activities.
  • Drive continuous service improvements and platform optimization efforts.
 
Security & Compliance
  • Ensure AWS WorkSpaces environments meet security, regulatory, and audit requirements.
  • Partner with cybersecurity teams to implement security controls and monitoring.
  • Support vulnerability remediation and platform hardening initiatives.
  • Participate in audits, risk assessments, and compliance reviews.
  • Maintain secure access standards, least privilege permissions, and identity governance controls.
  • Support logging, monitoring, and security event investigations.
 
Operational Requirements
  • Execute infrastructure changes under strict Change Management procedures.
  • Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and support guides.
  • Participate in after-hours maintenance activities as required.
  • Provide Level 3 engineering support and escalation assistance.
  • Collaborate across cloud, infrastructure, security, networking, and endpoint management teams.
  
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering experience.
  • 5+ years of AWS engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of Amazon WorkSpaces administration and architecture experience.
  • Deep understanding of AWS WorkSpaces Images, Bundles, Directories, and lifecycle management.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Active Directory and hybrid identity environments.
  • Experience integrating AWS WorkSpaces with Microsoft Entra ID and Intune.
  • Experience supporting RADIUS MFA authentication and SAML federation solutions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking concepts including Route 53, DNS, VPCs, subnets, routing, and security controls.
  • Experience with AWS CloudWatch monitoring and alerting.
  • Strong PowerShell and automation experience.
  • Experience utilizing AWS Lambda for operational automation.
  • Knowledge of endpoint deployment and application delivery practices.
  • Experience supporting Windows 11 enterprise desktop environments.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience with React and JavaScript
  • Solid full-stack development background

job.title: Quality Control Inspector
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Quality Control Inspector to join our medical device client in Lewisville, TX. This opportunity is ideal for candidates with hands-on quality inspection experience who are comfortable reading technical drawings, performing dimensional inspections, and working within a regulated manufacturing environment. This is an onsite position, requiring the completion of a background check and standard drug screen. 

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Quality Control Inspector
Location: Lewisville, TX – Onsite
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00am-7:00pm (some flexibility) 
Compensation: $26.00–$29.00/hour, depending on experience
Type: Contract
 

Responsibilities
  • Conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections of materials, components, subassemblies, and finished products.

  • Review engineering drawings, inspection instructions, sampling requirements, and workmanship standards to verify product conformance.

  • Perform dimensional and visual inspections using tools such as calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, and electronic test equipment.

  • Maintain accurate quality and receiving inspection records and enter inspection data into applicable systems.

  • Identify and document nonconforming materials and support discrepancy reporting and resolution activities.

  • Complete inventory and product transactions within Oracle, including product acceptance, delivery, and BOM-related activities.

  • Prepare or support quality documentation such as inspection procedures, engineering change documentation, and discrepancy reports.

  • Assist with training and providing guidance to less-experienced inspectors.

  • Prioritize inspection activities based on production and operational requirements.

  • Participate in problem-solving efforts and recommend opportunities to improve product quality and inspection processes.

  • Follow applicable FDA, ISO, safety, quality system, and company requirements.

Qualifications
  • 2+ years of Quality Control/Quality Inspection experience, preferably within medical device, manufacturing, or another regulated environment.

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

  • Working knowledge of GD&T and dimensional inspection principles.

  • Hands-on experience using calipers, micrometers, and other precision measuring equipment.

  • Ability to independently perform a variety of quality inspection activities and appropriately prioritize workload.

  • Strong attention to detail, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience supporting or training junior inspectors is preferred.

  • Experience with Oracle or a similar ERP/manufacturing system is a plus.

  • High school diploma or equivalent is preferred but not required.

  • Ability to regularly stand, walk, sit, bend, and reach throughout the workday and frequently lift, carry, or move items weighing up to 40 lbs., with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Visual acuity, with correction if needed, sufficient to perform required dimensional, cosmetic, and workmanship inspections.

job.title: Sr. Network Security Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Network Security Engineer to join our advanced technology client. This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on securing and scaling complex enterprise network environments, with a strong emphasis on Palo Alto Networks, firewall architecture, network segmentation, VPN/security connectivity, and network automation.

The team is primarily targeting candidates in the San Mateo, CA area, with Washington, D.C. also a strong preferred location. Candidates near Santa Clarita or San Diego, CA, and Frisco, TX may also be considered. The position offers some flexibility in work arrangement depending on location and business needs, with occasional travel potentially required.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other IT opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Senior Network Security Engineer
Location: San Mateo, CA preferred; Washington, D.C. also strongly considered; additional locations may include Santa Clarita, CA; San Diego, CA; and Frisco, TX
Type: Contract
Compensation: $70-105/hr DOE 
Eligibility: Must be a U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder (ITAR / CUI environment)
 

Responsibilities
  • Engineer and support secure network infrastructure across corporate offices, data centers, remote locations, and cloud-connected environments.

  • Configure, administer, and enhance Palo Alto Networks technologies, including PAN-OS, Panorama, GlobalProtect, threat protection, application controls, and related security capabilities.

  • Manage firewall rules, network segmentation, NAT, site-to-site and remote-access VPNs, and secure connectivity solutions.

  • Support network access controls, authentication technologies, and Zero Trust/SASE initiatives.

  • Investigate network traffic, security events, connectivity issues, and vulnerabilities while assisting with remediation and incident response.

  • Perform firewall upgrades, configuration hardening, lifecycle maintenance, and production changes.

  • Troubleshoot complex routing, switching, WAN, wireless, firewall, application-access, and performance issues.

  • Support secure network connectivity between enterprise infrastructure and cloud environments, including AWS and Azure.

  • Collaborate with network, cloud, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams on architecture and technical implementations.

  • Develop automation for network and security operations using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Python, or Bash.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, configuration standards, and operational runbooks.

  • Provide senior-level escalation support for critical network and security incidents.

  • Participate in planned maintenance, on-call support, and technical knowledge sharing with other engineers.

Qualifications
  • 6+ years of professional experience supporting network security within complex enterprise or production environments.

  • Advanced hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks, particularly PAN-OS and Panorama.

  • Strong understanding of firewalls, segmentation, NAT, VPN technologies, threat prevention, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting.

  • Experience working with enterprise networking platforms such as Juniper, Cisco, or Arista.

  • Hands-on experience with network automation or infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Python, or Bash.

  • Ability to independently lead technical initiatives and resolve complex, business-critical network and security problems.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Palo Alto GlobalProtect, Prisma Access, Cloud NGFW, SASE, and/or Zero Trust architectures.

  • Experience administering Juniper routing and switching technologies.

  • Familiarity with Network Access Control solutions such as Aruba ClearPass or Mist Access Assurance.

  • Knowledge of 802.1X, RADIUS, certificate-based authentication, and enterprise wireless environments.

  • Experience supporting AWS and/or Azure networking.

  • Relevant certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP Security, CCNP Enterprise, JNCIS/JNCIP, or comparable credentials.

  • Previous experience supporting regulated, mission-critical, aerospace, defense, or highly technical engineering environments.

job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Field Operations Technician in Austin/ Hutto, TX. The Field Operations Technician ensures the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of natural gas pressure reduction and distribution systems and associated equipment. In this vital role, you will maintain high-pressure equipment, deliver exceptional customer communication, and strictly prioritize safety and environmental compliance.

Title: Field Operations Technician
Duration: Direct Hire
Pay: $65,000 - 72,000 DOE
Locations: Austin or Hutto 
Travel: Up to 60% overnight travel required
Shift: M-F 8-5pm

Key Responsibilities:
• Operate, monitor, and maintain various natural gas field equipment and systems (e.g., pressure regulators, separators, control devices, distribution systems).
• Instruct third-party personnel on the proper operation of natural gas field equipment.
• Assist in repairing trailers and addressing customer requests.

job.title: Lending System Analyst
job.description:
As a Lending System Analyst, you’ll play a vital role in ensuring our clients new loan platform supports the seamless delivery of consumer loans, directly impacting millions of customers and supporting the future growth of their lending operations.

Overview
We’re seeking a knowledgeable and collaborative Lending System Analyst to serve as the business-side expert during the implementation of our new loan platform, This role is designed for someone with hands-on experience in consumer lending within banking or credit unions who understands the intricacies of the loan lifecycle—from origination to collections. Work remotely across time zones with a dynamic team dedicated to operational excellence and innovative financial solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the business-side technical project manager and platform steward for the new lending system, supporting configuration, workflow setup, testing, and launch.
  • Support and maintain loan product parameters, including loan terms, payment rules, and eligibility criteria to ensure regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—Product, Operations, IT, Legal & Compliance, Customer Care—to gather requirements, document processes, and translate needs into system capabilities.
  • Partner with external vendors to manage configuration, testing, defect resolution, and platform enhancements.
  • Manage user access, roles, permissions, and support processes to align with security and compliance standards.
  • Lead or assist in system testing, including user acceptance testing and defect triage, ensuring a smooth transition during platform go-live and post-launch stabilization.
  • Troubleshoot platform issues, research root causes, and coordinate resolutions across teams and vendors.
  • Maintain thorough documentation of system configurations, change history, and operational processes.
  • Support operational workflows such as payments, account updates, collections, and reporting, ensuring the platform supports audit and compliance needs.
  • Monitor platform performance, identify opportunities for improvements, and help implement automation or enhancements for scalable support.
Must-Have Requirements

  • Strong experience supporting consumer lending, loan servicing, or related financial services at banks or credit unions.
  • Deep knowledge of lending terminology, principles of principal and interest, and the loan lifecycle through collections.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of working effectively with cross-functional teams, vendors, and leadership.
  • Proven problem-solving skills with the ability to research issues and recommend practical solutions.
Bring your expertise in consumer lending and become a key contributor to  innovative lending initiatives. Apply now to be part of a forward-thinking team dedicated to delivering excellence in financial services!

job.title: General Counsel, Construction-Long Island City NY
job.description:
Job Title:  General Counsel, Construction
Location: Long Island City, NJ
Fulltime Perm position
Position Overview:
We are seeking a business leader that brings a legal focus to strategic planning for
the General Counsel role to join our team. This position provides comprehensive legal
guidance across all business areas, ensuring compliance, protecting the company’s
interests, and enabling informed decision-making at both the leadership and project levels.
Your expertise in construction law, labor matters, contracts, and corporate governance will
help drive operational efficiency, mitigate risk, and support client's continued success.
Key Responsibilities:
• Advise executive leadership and project teams on legal rights, responsibilities, and
potential risks across all business operations.
• Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of contracts, including owner agreements,
subcontractor agreements, vendor contracts, joint ventures, NDAs, and professional
services agreements.
• Assist with various claims (General Liability, Construction Defect, Subcontractor
Defaults, etc.) as necessary
• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including construction,
employment, safety (OSHA), environmental, procurement, and licensing
requirements.
• Oversee corporate governance, including board matters, entity management,
insurance, and risk assessment.
• Oversee and manage the company’s portfolio of legal matters handled by outside
counsel, including litigation, claims, employment matters, regulatory issues, and
specialized transactional work.
• Develop and implement legal policies, internal controls, risk-mitigation strategies,
and training programs for staff.
• Manage legal aspects related to union labor matters, including collective bargaining
agreements, grievance procedures, and compliance with labor laws affecting
electricians and field personnel.
• Lead or support legal aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and strategic
joint ventures, including target evaluation, due diligence, and legal risk assessment,
as well as negotiating key transaction documents
• Support HR on training, safety incidents, and compliance with apprenticeship and
licensing requirements for electrical workers.
• Manage relationships with external counsel, insurers, regulatory agencies, and other
stakeholders.
Qualifications:
• Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school; active bar admission in good
standing.
• 10+ years of relevant legal experience, preferably with significant exposure to the
construction or real estate development industries.
• Strong background in contract negotiation, risk management, construction law, and
dispute resolution.
• Prior involvement in M&A activities, including due diligence, risk assessment, and
negotiation of transaction documents.
• Familiarity with union labor (IBEW or similar), collective bargaining agreements, and
prevailing wage requirements.
• Experience managing and coordinating outside counsel across litigation, claims, and
specialized legal matters
• Exceptional analytical abilities, communication skills, and business judgment.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and business-partnering abilities.
• Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and support both field and corporate
teams.

job.description:
Join a dynamic team leading the evolution of enterprise HR technology as our  client's Workday Platform & Governance Owner — the go-to expert shaping how thousands of employees experience HR systems every day. If you thrive on aligning complex systems with strategic business goals, this role offers a unique opportunity to impact our global workforce while advancing your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment.

Job Details:

Duration: Direct Hire- Permanent W2
Location: 3x a week onsite New York,NY, Holmdel NJ or Stamford CT

job.title: Process Engineer – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Equipment
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Process Engineer – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Equipment for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in Noblesville, Indiana.

This is a hands-on manufacturing-floor engineering role supporting automated equipment and processes within a fast-paced cGMP sterile drug-product operation. The Process Engineer will own manufacturing-equipment troubleshooting, recurring-failure elimination, reliability and process improvements, performance monitoring, and implementation of new equipment, products, and manufacturing processes.

This position is best suited for an engineer who has personally supported production equipment, diagnosed equipment or process failures, implemented engineering changes, and demonstrated measurable improvements in reliability, quality, throughput, yield, or downtime. This is not a validation-only, quality-assurance, documentation, or continuous-improvement-only position.

What You Will Do
  • Provide hands-on engineering support for automated manufacturing equipment and production processes.
  • Troubleshoot recurring equipment and process failures, determine root causes, and implement sustainable corrective engineering solutions.
  • Lead equipment-reliability and process-improvement initiatives that improve uptime, throughput, yield, quality, scrap, cycle time, or other manufacturing KPIs.
  • Establish, monitor, and trend process and equipment performance metrics to identify reliability and performance opportunities.
  • Evaluate, design, modify, and implement manufacturing processes and equipment for existing and new products.
  • Support installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, and operational handoff of new or modified manufacturing equipment.
  • Support new-product introductions, technology transfers, and manufacturing-line implementation.
  • Lead structured root-cause investigations involving manufacturing processes and equipment.
  • Author and support deviations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, engineering protocols, technical reports, and other controlled documentation associated with equipment and process changes.
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Validation, Maintenance, Automation, Technical Services, R&D, and other functions to implement compliant engineering improvements.
  • Support troubleshooting and diagnostic activities involving automated equipment, PLC/HMI-controlled systems, sensors, machine controls, and associated mechanical systems.
  • Develop and maintain manufacturing procedures, equipment documentation, batch-record content, and training materials.
  • Provide hands-on manufacturing-floor support during equipment failures, process changes, startup activities, and project implementation.
  • Support project schedules, cost forecasts, and implementation milestones.
Education and Experience Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Manufacturing, Biochemical, Biotechnology, or another relevant Engineering discipline strongly preferred. Candidates with a closely related technical degree and substantial directly relevant manufacturing-equipment engineering experience may also be considered.
  • Approximately 5+ years of relevant engineering experience supporting manufacturing equipment and processes.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical-device, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated hands-on ownership of manufacturing equipment or processes, including troubleshooting equipment failures and implementing engineering improvements.
  • Ability to provide examples of identifying a manufacturing or equipment problem, determining root cause, implementing a corrective engineering change, and measuring the resulting improvement.
  • Experience improving equipment reliability, downtime, throughput, yield, reject rate, scrap, cycle time, OEE, or comparable manufacturing-performance metrics.
  • Experience with structured root-cause analysis and technical problem-solving.
  • Experience supporting equipment installation, commissioning, startup, qualification, or manufacturing-line implementation.
  • Working knowledge of cGMP requirements, validation, quality systems, document control, and the regulatory impact of equipment and process changes.
  • Experience with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, engineering protocols, technical reports, risk assessments, or comparable controlled documentation.
  • Strong project-management, organizational, technical-writing, and cross-functional communication skills.
Preferred Equipment Experience

Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
  • Automated visual inspection or machine-vision systems
  • Vial inspection equipment
  • Filling or fill-finish equipment
  • Vial labeling equipment
  • Pharmaceutical packaging or secondary-packaging lines
  • Cartoners, case packers, conveyors, or automated material-handling equipment
  • Serialization equipment
  • Robotics or automated assembly systems
  • Integrated automated manufacturing lines
  • PLC/HMI-controlled production equipment
  • Sensors, controls, or automation-related equipment troubleshooting
Preferred Industry Experience
  • Sterile injectable or aseptic pharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Fill-finish manufacturing
  • Pharmaceutical packaging
  • Radiopharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Medical-device manufacturing with strong automated-equipment, validation, and quality-system experience
  • New-product introduction, technology transfer, or manufacturing-line startup
Additional Requirements
  • Must be able to work fully onsite in Noblesville, Indiana, Monday through Friday, approximately 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
  • Candidates requiring relocation must be willing to relocate to the Noblesville area at their own expense.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States and must not require employer sponsorship for employment visa status now or in the future.

job.title: Staff Cloud Network Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Staff Cloud Network Engineer to join our advanced technology client. This role is ideal for a senior-level cloud networking professional who can provide hands-on technical leadership across complex AWS, Azure, hybrid cloud, and enterprise network environments.

The position will focus on designing secure and resilient cloud connectivity, implementing network automation and infrastructure as code, and providing technical direction across cloud and network initiatives. Candidates should be within a commutable distance of the greater San Diego or Los Angeles, CA area and comfortable with occasional travel as needed.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other IT opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Staff Cloud Network Engineer
Location: Greater San Diego or Los Angeles, CA area
Type: Contract
Compensation: $95.00–$130.00/hour, depending on experience level
Eligibility: Must be a U.S. Person as defined by ITAR due to access to export-controlled technical data and/or technology
 

Responsibilities
  • Lead the architecture, implementation, and ongoing improvement of highly available network environments spanning AWS, Azure, data centers, and enterprise locations.

  • Design scalable cloud connectivity across multiple regions, accounts, and subscriptions using technologies such as AWS Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Direct Connect, Azure Virtual WAN, Virtual Hub, and ExpressRoute.

  • Establish architecture standards for routing, segmentation, DNS, private connectivity, secure internet access, centralized inspection, and hybrid networking.

  • Design and deploy Palo Alto Networks security solutions within public cloud environments, including Cloud NGFW and VM-Series firewalls.

  • Integrate cloud environments with corporate sites, data centers, and other infrastructure using resilient routing, VPN, and private connectivity solutions.

  • Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules and infrastructure-as-code solutions for network deployment and configuration.

  • Develop network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar technologies to reduce manual processes and improve operational consistency.

  • Implement Git-based development and CI/CD practices for validating, reviewing, testing, and deploying network changes.

  • Partner with Cloud, Platform, Infrastructure, Security, and application engineering teams to develop standardized and reusable networking capabilities.

  • Lead advanced troubleshooting of routing, firewall, DNS, connectivity, application access, and network performance issues.

  • Develop monitoring and automated validation capabilities to proactively identify availability, capacity, configuration, performance, and security risks.

  • Lead complex production network changes while adhering to established security and change-management requirements.

  • Maintain network architecture diagrams, engineering standards, runbooks, configuration documentation, and troubleshooting procedures.

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to other engineers across cloud networking, automation, infrastructure as code, and troubleshooting.

  • Support network technology lifecycle management, including upgrades, vulnerability remediation, licensing, configuration improvements, and technical debt reduction.

  • Participate in scheduled maintenance, on-call rotations, vendor escalations, and emergency response as required.

Qualifications
  • 8+ years of experience designing and supporting complex enterprise or production networking environments, with significant experience in cloud networking.

  • Advanced hands-on networking experience across both AWS and Azure, with deep expertise in at least one platform.

  • Experience architecting multi-region, multi-account, and/or multi-subscription cloud networks.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of technologies such as Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Virtual WAN, and site-to-site VPNs.

  • Experience deploying and managing Palo Alto Networks firewalls in AWS and Azure, including Cloud NGFW and/or VM-Series and centralized management through Panorama.

  • Expert-level understanding of BGP, routing, segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, redundancy, and network failure scenarios.

  • Strong background in enterprise routing, switching, network security, and hybrid cloud/data-center connectivity.

  • Significant hands-on experience building production infrastructure using Terraform.

  • Experience automating network operations with Python, Ansible, or comparable technologies.

  • Experience with Git, peer-review workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex networking initiatives from architecture and design through implementation and production support.

  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and technical leadership skills.

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical discipline or equivalent professional experience.

  • Must qualify as a U.S. Person under applicable ITAR regulations due to the nature of the work and access to export-controlled information.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with cloud-native network security, private endpoints, centralized traffic inspection, DNS architecture, and secure egress patterns.

  • Experience deploying Palo Alto Cloud NGFW or VM-Series within AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government environments.

  • Experience designing high-availability firewall architectures, centralized inspection, load-balancer integrations, and symmetric traffic flows.

  • Experience developing reusable Terraform modules or standardized networking services for consumption by other engineering teams.

  • Familiarity with Juniper networking, enterprise wireless, Network Access Control, and Zero Trust Network Access technologies.

  • Experience partnering closely with Cloud, Platform, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity organizations.

  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, Azure Network Engineer Associate, CCNP, JNCIP, PCNSE, or equivalent.

  • Previous experience supporting regulated, classified, aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical technology environments.
