job.title: Advanced Semiconductor Materials Planner-Onsite
job.description:
Materials Planner (Advanced Level-Onsite Role)
Location: Austin, Texas
Shift:  (8-hour) Day Shift 8AM-5PM
Duration: 9-Month Contract
Environment: Manufacturing / Warehouse


Pay Rate: $50 to $56 per hour




What You’ll Do:
  • Planner II supports planning, forecasting, and analysis of service parts and product-related requirements to ensure material availability in the right location, in the right quantities, and at the right time.
  • You will operate within a defined planning scope, applying your foundational planning expertise while executing standard planning processes.
  • This role requires a quick learner with a genuine desire to improve, an eagerness to expand their capabilities, and a strong analytical curiosity and critical thinking.
  • As part of the team, you will deliver reliable planning outcomes while thriving in a product lifecycle-based planning organization that values growth, initiative, and a passion for learning.

 Responsibilities: 
  • Planning Execution: Support demand forecasting, inventory planning, and material planning activities within assigned product or lifecycle scope.
  • Execute planning activities using enterprise planning systems to align supply and demand.
  • Support planning deliverables related to NPI readiness, ECO planning, sustaining operations, and transitions.
  • Develop and maintain production, material, and supply schedules to support customer demand and business objectives.
  • Monitor schedule adherence, identify capacity constraints, material shortages, and supply chain risks, and drive timely resolution with cross-functional teams.
  • Coordinate schedule changes resulting from demand fluctuations, engineering changes (ECOs), NPI builds, and supply interruptions while balancing inventory, service, and operational goals. Ensure planning parameters and scheduling data are accurate to support execution, visibility, and on-time delivery performance.

Problem Solving:
  • Perform part shortage analysis, root cause analysis, and basic scenario evaluation.
  • Identify risks related to material availability, service levels, or transitions and escalate with supporting data.
  • Support corrective implementation under established processes and guidance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Business Units, Service Business Units, Operations, Logistics, and Regional Planning partners to resolve planning issues. Act as a planning point-of-contact within defined scope, communicating status and risks clearly and professionally.

 System Discipline:
  • Maintain accuracy of planning data and support adherence to standard planning processes.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to planning tools, processes, and data quality
  • Build understanding of product lifecycle planning concepts and business drivers.
  • Develop planning judgment by understanding downstream impacts of planning decisions.
  • Progress from executing defined plans to identifying risk and proposing improvements.



What You Bring:
  • Bachelor degree from an accredited university; emphasis in Supply Chain or Engineering, Industrial Engineering preferred.
  • 3-7 years of inventory management, supply planning, or demand planning experience (including KPI management).
  • Semiconductor background strongly preferred, especially in Parts, Warranty, or Service.
  • Proficient with ERP/supply chain systems (Oracle, SAP, SPP, or similar).
  • Self-motivated, accountable, strong project management and innovation skills.
  • Excellent analytical ability; proven use of data-driven analysis to develop solutions. Familiar with Tableau, Power BI, SQL. Skilled in interpreting complex data sets to identify trends and issues.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office.
  • Strong collaborator with internal teams and customers.
  • Sound business acumen and understanding of key business drivers.
  • Effective problem-solving, critical thinking, and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and structed learning.


Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, or other ERP systems- Background in warehouse, inventory, or manufacturing operations
  • Bachelor's Degree
Years of Experience:
  • 4 - 7 Years

Work Environment:
  • Standing/walking for extended periods
  • Lifting, bending, reaching, and working in tight or fast-paced environments
  • Exposure to noise and manufacturing conditions
  • Required use of PPE (safety shoes, glasses, gloves, etc.)

Benefits of Working with Yoh:
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) retirement savings plan
- Weekly pay with direct deposit

job.title: Wearable Test Technician
job.description:
Wearable Test Technician 
The Wearable Test Technician is responsible for supporting large-scale Android hardware validation environments by configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting automated test infrastructure. This role ensures reliable test execution through rack integration, host management, hardware diagnostics, and collaboration with cross-functional engineering and lab operations teams.
Scope:
• Configure, deploy, and maintain large-scale automated test racks for Android hardware validation.
• Perform host migrations, system re-imaging, and Automated Test Environment (ATE) transitions between CTS and Main testing pools.
• Execute structured rack cabling, network connectivity, and testbed verification to ensure reliable hardware operation.
• Collaborate with Lab Operations and Automation teams to maintain accurate hardware inventory and facility management records.
• Support ongoing hardware readiness and infrastructure improvements in high-density testing environments.
Required:
• Experience with Linux operating systems and shell command-line tools.
• Ability to troubleshoot Android device connectivity, ADB communication issues, and hardware communication failures.
• Hands-on experience with hardware installation, rack integration, networking, and cable management.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve hardware and system issues.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate across cross-functional technical teams.
Pluses:
• Experience supporting Android hardware validation, QA, or automated test environments.
• Familiarity with Automated Test Environments (ATE), CTS infrastructure, or similar validation platforms.
• Knowledge of asset tracking and lab management systems.
• Experience working in data center, lab, or high-density hardware testing environments.
• Understanding of hardware lifecycle management and infrastructure best practices.

job.title: Security Administration Analyst with Sailpoint and ServiceNow- NJ - RTH
job.description:
Security Admin with ServiceNow and Sailpoint
Contract to Hire
Jersey City, NJ

Must Haves:
-ServiceNow, Active Directory, RBAC, Least Privilege Access Principles
-Administer Applications
-SailPoint
-Be able to support IAM/Security Initiatives

Position Overview
The Security Administration Analyst is responsible for executing access management activities, resolving provisioning issues, and ensuring adherence to security policies and least privilege principles. This role requires effective collaboration with global peers, application owners, and security coordinators to deliver accurate and timely access provisioning while maintaining strong control standards.


Key Responsibilities Security Administration & Technical Support
  • Process user access and provisioning requests across multiple systems and applications, in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), ensuring high quality, accuracy and ensuring least privilege principles
  • Participate in onboarding activities (new hires, transfers, and terminations) while understanding the business purpose, risk, and impact of access requests (“the why behind the ask”)
  • Support both standard and more complex access provisioning activities
  • Investigate, resolve access-related incidents and provisioning issues, providing support through ISM support channels (e.g., hotline, service queues)
  • Coordinate with Security Coordinators and Application/Data Owners to validate and fulfill access requests
  • Perform ad hoc operational tasks such as knowledge base updates and documentation maintenance to ensure controls are current, documented, and aligned with best practices
  • Flexibility to support global operations, including periodic shift adjustments, on-call rotational coverage and alternate work schedules to ensure business continuity.
Collaboration & Process Improvement & Execution
  • Collaborate effectively with global teams to ensure consistent security practices and outcomes
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, enhance controls, and improve provisioning processes through automation initiatives using scripting or technical tools where applicable
  • Support continuous improvement by analyzing volume drivers and recurring issues
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across ISM, Technology, and business units
Risk Management
  • Maintain a strong focus on risk management, data protection, and security posture
  • Proactively identify potential risks, support mitigation efforts, escalate issues appropriately and in a timely manner
  • Contribute to a culture of accountability, control awareness, and continuous improvement


Qualifications & Experience Required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in Information Security, Identity & Access Management, or related field
  • Experience with security administration tools such as:
    • Active Directory
    • ServiceNow
    • RBAC models
    • Identity & Access Management platforms (e.g., SailPoint or similar)
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel/data analysis skills (Vlookup, pivot tables, VBA etc.)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a collaborative team environment
Preferred
  • Experience with scripting/programming (e.g., PowerShell, Python, SQL, Java) for automation
  • Experience in financial services or regulated environments
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes
  • Cybersecurity certifications (e.g., Security+, CISSP)

job.title: Executive Assistant- Long Island City, NY
job.description:
Our finance team is seeking an Executive Assistant (EA) to support the CFO with strategic calendar and schedule management, travel planning, email management, and communication as well as data tracking and reporting and project execution. The EA will maintain a highly organized, proactive scheduling system that keeps the CFO focused on high-value work. Success in this area means a well-structured calendar, clear priorities, and zero avoidable scheduling conflicts. As the EA, you will help ensure the CFO's inbox is organized, prioritized, and managed strategically. You are also responsible for ensuring that internal and external obligations and projects stay on track and you will handle recurring and ad hoc projects as directed by the CFO. The EA ensures that the CFO has visibility on all the deliverables of the Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Payroll and Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) departments and maintains project trackers and raid logs where necessary. In this key support role in finance, you will also maintain recurring reporting and dashboards, ensuring that leadership has clear visibility into key performance metrics.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):
  • Maintaining a structured calendar using block scheduling principles and ensuring meetings are scheduled appropriately with minimal conflicts
  • Reviewing the calendar 24 - 48 hours ahead and proactively adjusting as needed and coordinating travel arrangements and professional events well in advance
  • Reviewing and triaging incoming emails, drafting responses, and delegating communications when appropriate
  • Providing weekly summaries highlighting priorities, deadlines, and emerging issues
  • Tracking assignments and projects delegated by the CFO and maintaining a task dashboard with deadlines and priorities for the CFO and the Finance and Administration direct reports
  • Following up with team members to ensure progress and ensuring projects are completed accurately, on time, in full
  • Handle expense tracking and administrative financial tasks, and support in office management, including coordinating mail, department events and supplies
  • Liaise with Accounting and FP&A in maintaining dashboards and providing hard copies of key reports as requested
  • Prepare PowerPoint and Excel documents for executive, management and board meetings
  • Prepare weekly check-in reports for the CFO
  • Special projects as required
What We're Looking for:
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal Assistant, or Administrative Professional
  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • Experience in a multi-entity contractor, construction environment or manufacturing setting preferred
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to anticipate needs and prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment
  • Outstanding ability to navigate all aspects of Microsoft Office, including Copilot
  • Experience with scheduling platforms, task scheduling tools, dashboards, and AI agents

job.title: Thermal Test Technician
job.description:
Thermal Test Technician
We are seeking a hands-on Thermal Test Technician to support thermal testing of semiconductor equipment and hardware. This role focuses on test fixture setup, thermal instrumentation, data collection, and laboratory support.

Scope:
• Set up thermal tests using thermocouples, cold plates, fixtures, and dataloggers.
• Collect and organize test data using spreadsheets.
• Attach, inspect, and adjust thermal test hardware for consistent results.
• Maintain test documentation, equipment, and laboratory work areas.
• Support troubleshooting of thermal test setups and fixtures.

Required:
• Experience with thermal testing, thermocouples, dataloggers, or similar instrumentation.
• Experience collecting and analyzing data in spreadsheets.
• Strong hands-on skills with fixtures, sensors, cold plates, and test hardware.
• Methodical, consistent, and detail-oriented approach to testing.
• Ability to follow technical procedures and document results accurately.

Pluses:
• Experience supporting semiconductor, electronics, vacuum, or advanced hardware testing.
• Familiarity with thermal chambers, LabVIEW, Python, MATLAB, or other data-acquisition tools.
• Experience with thermal management, cooling systems, heat sinks, or thermal interface materials.

job.title: Technical Program Manager – Data Center PDI Program and Product Portfolio
job.description:
Technical Program Manager – Data Center PDI Program & Product Portfolio

Role Overview
The TPM specialist provides comprehensive program support, project controls, and technical product development administration for the PDI Program and Product Portfolio. Operating in lockstep with the Technical Product Manager (TPM) and the Document Control/Knowledge Management (DCKM) teams, this role ensures cross-functional alignment, rigorous change management, and the seamless execution of the Product Life Cycle (PLC).
The ideal candidate must have a technical background and possess a strong Project Management Office (PMO) skillset to effectively support deliverables, follow up on manage complex asset inventories, and maintain engineering documentation.

Core Program Support & Scope
The specialist will provide dedicated PMO and program support for three primary workstreams: Global Regions System Engineering Technical Meetings, Major Program Integration, and System Parameter Input Stakeholder Tracking. Scope descriptions for these programs include:
  • Meetings: Schedule, chair, and document technical meetings. Partner with the TPM to drive scope deliverables, ensuring discussions regarding engineering, design, and pilot testing remain structured, organized, and productive.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Support the Product Development & Insertion Project Management Team, collaborating closely with the Technology Innovation Engineering Team and the broader product development team on design-related discussions.
  • PLC Stage Gate Governance: Assist the manager in driving the Product Life Cycle (PLC) checklist. Support the scheduling, review, and note-taking of stage gate presentations to ensure successful sign-off for each phase.
  • Documentation & Tracker Upkeep: Manage documentation workflows, maintain trackers, and follow up with internal stakeholders to secure reviews and process sign-offs by committed timelines.
  • Engineering Bulletin Coordination: Coordinate Engineering Bulletins (EBs) with relevant parties to verify that technical content is accurate and all supporting documentation is properly linked.

Key Responsibilities
1. Inventory Quantity & Design Update Tracking
  • Device Count Management: Track, audit, and reconcile standard hardware device counts (including automatic transfer switches, network equipment, busducts, and infrastructure components) alongside mechanical drops as data center site layouts migrate from baseline to site-specific configurations.
  • Design Update Auditing: Continuously audit the inventory framework to accurately account for all new hardware releases and specific project configuration modifications.

2. Stakeholder Follow-Up & Data Integration
  • Internal Alignment Execution: Proactively follow up with internal engineering, design, and operations teams to accelerate design reviews, technical drawing releases, and spend approvals (such as data center design engineering approvals).
  • Supply Chain & Vendor Touchpoints: Interface with Equipment Supply Chain contacts and integration vendors to track hardware fabrication timelines, assembly starts, and transit schedules.
  • Major Program Integration: Assist the team in leading coordination efforts across supply chain, internal engineering, and data center services to ensure inventory counts accurately reflect upcoming configurations.

3. Dashboard, Tracker, & Tool Maintenance
  • Program Tracker Ownership: Retain  ownership of the program workflow tracker and roadmap updates (taking direction from lead engineering and portfolio TPM), updating task completions, milestone dates, approved configurations, and assignees weekly.
  • Inventory Dashboard Analytics: Maintain a clean, consolidated dashboard tracking equipment inventory, supplier lead times, allocation maps, and storage locations for spare or excess components.
  • Documentation Repositories: Manage documentation uploads, track stakeholder approvals, and coordinate the drafting/approval of technical bulletins while ensuring accurate technical links are preserved.
  • Status Reporting: Generate structured, periodic reports for leadership focusing on late-binding transition statuses, inventory holding risks, and critical path timeline updates.

4. Lifecycle Documentation Closeout
  • Ensure all project-related information is properly organized, validated for accuracy/quality, and archived within defined closeout periods agreed upon by the TPM and DCKM teams.
  • Incorporate metadata and indexing for optimized searchability, implement access controls, document lessons learned, and manage a seamless handover to operations.
  • Document Management & Collaboration: Proficiency in navigating and organizing data within AODocs, DCIP folder structures, PILs, and DDI platforms to maintain centralized, secure repositories.
  • Issue & Bug Tracking: Direct experience utilizing Buganizer (or equivalent enterprise tracking systems) to log, monitor, and resolve product/program defects.
  • Configuration & Change Control: Solid understanding of engineering change processes, including the administration of Change Control Boards (CCBs), Technical/Product Assessments (TAs/PAs), and Engineering Bulletins (EBs).
  • Data & System Analytics: Ability to manage inventory dashboards, track complex technical assets (ATS, network hardware, busducts), and align data fields across supply chain and engineering roadmaps.

job.description:
Materials Characterization Engineer - Electrochemical Corrosion Testing  

This position supports a group of Materials and Process Engineers in the electrochemical testing of next generation materials and products, with a focus on metal alloys and their coatings. The successful candidate must possess the ability to manage multiple work requests simultaneously with competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Electrolyte preparation and chemical management, including solution makeup to specification, pH control, inert gas deaeration, and proper chemical handling, storage, labeling, and waste disposal
  • Hands-on experience performing chemical laboratory testing following established procedures and test requests
  • Ability to calibrate and maintain electrochemical test equipment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills

Desired Experience:
  • B.S. in Materials Science, Chemistry, or related field
  • Experience operating potentiostats and three-electrode flat cells
  • Metallographic preparation of samples for electrochemical testing (cut, mount, polish, degrease, mask)
  • Familiarity with ASTM G5, G59, G61, and G106 or similar standards

job.title: Materials Program Manager (MPM) - Bay Area
job.description:
Materials Program Manager (MPM) - SF Bay Area

Looking for a solid Materials Program Manager to support an autonomous vehicle companies Supply Chain department. This person should have a background in materials planning and understand the key vendors involved in electronics components, mechanical components, automotive components, etc.

 

The key responsibility for this job will be manual demand planning (Manual MRP experience). There is no SAP, ERP, or SW suite that will be utilized, this is all manual production planning/Manual MRP’s through Excel/GSheets, so advanced Excel or GSheet’s experience is a must have.

 

Scope:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. This is the MPM's primary task which will be focused on. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Degree in Supply Chain or similar is ideal.

• Analyze manufacturing build plans against inventory/supply chain data in order to determine demand for materials replenishment.

• Retrieve quotes from suppliers & submit PO’s.

• Manage delivery schedules in order to ensure materials arrive ahead of required dates.

• Track/Mitigate Excess and Obsolescence.

 

Required:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Advanced spreadsheet / Excel skills; Ability to generate complex dashboards, tools, and reports. Experience with excel formulas like - VLOOKUP, SUMIF, COUNTIF, IFERROR, INDEX, MATCH, MIN, etc.

• Solid experience working as a Materials PM, Buyer/Planner, Materials Planners, or similar.

• Understand how to read and understand bill of materials (BOM’s) and manage inventory accuracy.

• Strong knowledge of MRP (Materials Requirements Planning) system functionality.

Estimated Max Rate: $45.00/hr. Depends on work experience

job.title: Senior Azure IT Integration Project Manager
job.description:
Senior IT Project Manager

We are looking for a seasoned Senior IT Project Manager to oversee complex technology initiatives involving enterprise integration, cloud transformation, and modernization. This position will manage projects that bring together applications, infrastructure, data, security, and business processes within a Microsoft Azure environment.
The successful candidate will be comfortable operating across both technical and business teams and will serve as the central point of coordination for architects, engineers, developers, security professionals, vendors, and organizational stakeholders. This individual will be responsible for maintaining project direction, managing dependencies and risks, and ensuring initiatives progress from planning through successful implementation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full project lifecycle for complex IT integration and modernization initiatives.
  • Establish project plans, schedules, budgets, resource requirements, milestones, and communication strategies.
  • Coordinate activities across application development, infrastructure, data, networking, cybersecurity, and business functions.
  • Lead initiatives involving Azure, cloud migration, APIs, application connectivity, middleware, and enterprise data integration.
  • Collaborate with technical architects, engineering teams, developers, business analysts, security teams, and external partners.
  • Establish appropriate project governance, decision-making structures, milestones, and reporting processes.
  • Track scope, schedule, budget, resource utilization, quality, and overall project health.
  • Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and potential delivery obstacles.
  • Lead project meetings, working sessions, executive updates, steering committee meetings, and status reviews.
  • Manage requirements, change control, scope adjustments, and stakeholder expectations throughout the project.
  • Coordinate system testing, data validation, deployment preparation, cutover planning, and post-production activities.
  • Ensure project execution aligns with organizational architecture, security, compliance, IT, and change management standards.
  • Facilitate issue resolution and escalate critical risks or decisions when appropriate.
  • Maintain project plans, documentation, status reports, and other governance materials.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • 8+ years of experience managing complex IT or technology projects.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise integration, modernization, cloud, or systems transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based technology environments.
  • Experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple applications, systems, technical teams, or business functions.
  • Working knowledge of SDLC and project delivery methodologies including Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches.
  • Experience managing project schedules, budgets, resources, vendors, risks, dependencies, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong technical understanding of enterprise applications, APIs, data movement, integrations, and cloud services.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage competing priorities within a complex, matrixed organization.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PMP or comparable project management certification.
  • Scrum, SAFe, or other Agile certification.
  • Experience with Azure integration technologies such as Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Data Factory, Event Grid, or Azure Integration Services.
  • Experience managing enterprise integrations involving ERP, CRM, data platforms, infrastructure, or other business-critical applications.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, or automated testing environments.
  • Experience leading cloud migration, application modernization, or hybrid-cloud programs.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, or comparable project management platforms.
  • Knowledge of ITIL, security controls, compliance requirements, and organizational change management.
Core Competencies
  • Enterprise technology project delivery
  • Project planning and governance
  • Cloud and systems integration
  • Executive and stakeholder management
  • Risk, issue, and dependency management
  • Vendor and resource coordination
  • Technical communication
  • Strategic planning and execution
  • Change and scope management
  • Problem solving and decision-making
  • Organization and attention to detail
  • Leadership through influence
Measures of Success
  • Technology initiatives are delivered within established timelines, budgets, and approved scope.
  • Integration and modernization efforts satisfy business, technical, security, and quality expectations.
  • Project risks, dependencies, issues, and decisions are identified and addressed proactively.
  • Technical and business stakeholders remain aligned throughout project execution.
  • Testing, deployment, and transition activities are completed effectively with limited operational disruption.
  • Project governance, documentation, reporting, and lessons learned are maintained consistently.

job.title: Occupational Health Registered Nurse
job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurse needed for a full-time, 9/80 contract opportunity with Yoh’s well-known client located in Redondo Beach, CA.
 

This onsite clinic offers occupational, primary, and preventative health services to support a large corporation. Interesting job getting to be a key part in keeping employees healthy, safe, and able to perform at their best through injury triage, wellness initiatives, and ongoing workplace health support.
-->SHIFTS: 9/80 schedule: Monday-Friday 6:30am to 4:00pm (30 minute lunch)
- One week Monday-Thursday 6:30am to 4:00pm and Friday 6:30am to 3:00pm and next week, Monday-Thursday 6:30am to 4:00pm.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in state of California
  • Previous experience highly preferred: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, School Nursing, or Corrections type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills
  • Strong presentation skills

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Nursing assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Case management for work-related and non-work related injuries and illnesses, while collaborating with EHS
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.

job.title: Business Protection Coordinator
job.description:
Business Protection Coordinator (Security Officer)  (Contract)

Location: Miami, Florida (Onsite)
Duration: 12-Month Contract (Subject to Extension)
Pay Rate: $25 hourly W2 

 We are seeking a Business Protection Coordinator to support corporate security operations  This role will be responsible for helping ensure the safety, security, and resilience of employees, offices, events, and business operations throughout the region. The successful candidate will partner closely with regional stakeholders, security vendors, and cross-functional teams to manage physical security programs, incident response, risk assessments, and office security initiatives.
This is a highly visible role that requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to work effectively across multiple countries and cultures. The position is based in Miami, Florida and reports to Business Protection leadership supporting both North and Latin American operations.

Former military, veterans, law enforcement, intelligence, and public safety professionals are strongly encouraged to apply. Experience gained through military service, law enforcement, emergency response, intelligence operations, executive protection, investigations, or related security disciplines is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities Security Operations & Risk Management
  • Support the safety and security of employees, offices, and business operations across Latin America.
  • Monitor and oversee the day-to-day performance of contracted security vendors and guarding teams.
  • Respond to and manage security incidents, investigations, and escalations throughout the region.
  • Conduct risk assessments for offices, events, executive travel, and operations in higher-risk locations.
  • Perform office security audits and recommend improvements to security programs and procedures.
  • Support business travelers and visiting staff with security guidance and risk mitigation measures.
Physical Security & Technology
  • Partner with technical security teams to administer and maintain access control systems, badging programs, alarms, and physical security technologies.
  • Support security planning and implementation for new office openings, renovations, and workplace enhancements.
  • Assist with physical security design reviews and recommend best practices for office environments.
Events & Employee Support
  • Lead or coordinate security operations for corporate events, activations, campaigns, and high-profile gatherings under the direction of Business Protection leadership.
  • Coordinate security planning with vendors, event organizers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Deliver security awareness programs and training initiatives that promote a security-conscious culture.
Collaboration & Strategic Support
  • Serve as a trusted security partner to regional leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Contribute to broader security, employee experience, and business resilience initiatives.
  • Provide weekly situational awareness updates and security reporting.
  • Assist with special projects supporting expanding regional operations and office growth initiatives.
Required Qualifications
  • Fluent in Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Bachelor's degree in Security Management, Risk Management, Political Science, International Relations, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in corporate security, physical security operations, intelligence, risk management, crisis management, law enforcement, military service, or related disciplines.
  • Experience conducting security assessments, managing incidents, and implementing risk mitigation strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with access control systems, security technologies, badging programs, and alarm systems.
  • Strong understanding of modern security practices and corporate security operations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently throughout Latin America.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Portuguese language proficiency or working comprehension.
  • Experience supporting operations across Latin America.
  • Familiarity with security platforms such as C•CURE (CCURE) or similar access control systems.
  • Experience supporting office construction, security design, or workplace security projects.
  • Knowledge of Apple Mac hardware and Google Workspace tools.
  • Background in military, intelligence, executive protection, emergency management, investigations, or law enforcement environments.

job.title: Technical Vehicle Services (Service Excellence Tech Writer)
job.description:
Mid-Level Vehicle Systems Technician (Service Excellence Tech Writer)
Seeking a technician to support a vehicle systems program focused on documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general system support. This role emphasizes electrical systems, wire harnesses, CAD navigation, and system-level software rather than traditional mechanical repair. Candidates with experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields are encouraged to apply.

Scope:
• Write and maintain service manuals, service SOPs, work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and technical reports.
• Convert engineering requirements and test results into clear, repeatable service procedures.
• Document test results, repairs, defects, system configurations, and corrective actions.
• Test, inspect, troubleshoot, and validate electrical and electromechanical vehicle systems.
• Read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, pinouts, and system documentation.
• Navigate and review existing CAD models, assemblies, drawings, and model trees.
• Locate components, dimensions, notes, features, and design information within CAD files.
• Use basic CAD functions such as view controls, section views, measurements, layers, and assembly navigation.
• Use diagnostic, logging, flashing, and network analysis tools to identify and resolve issues.
• Support root-cause analysis and collaborate with engineering, validation, service, and operations teams.
• Maintain organized lab, shop, vehicle, tool, and inventory areas.

Required:
• Automotive experience required.
• Technician experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields.
• Experience working in a lab or shop environment, including tool and inventory management.
• Comfortable working in a team environment; this is not a solo position.
• Proficiency with hand tools and electrical test equipment, including multimeters, continuity testers, oscilloscopes, and power supplies.
• Experience using diagnostic, logging, flashing, or network analysis tools to troubleshoot hardware and software systems.
• Ability to read and follow schematics, wiring diagrams, manuals, and technical procedures.
• Ability to navigate and interpret existing CAD files; CAD design or modeling experience is not required.
• Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Pluses:
• Experience troubleshooting vehicle or embedded system software.
• Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet.
• Experience with sensors, calibration, or system validation testing.
• Experience with CAD tools such as CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Creo, or similar platforms.

job.title: Senior Full Stack Developer React/JavaScript and C#/.NET Core
job.description:
Senior Full Stack .NET Developer (React, .NET Core, C#, SQL)
6 month contract to hire (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Irving, TX (Onsite 4 days a week)
 
Seeking a self-motivated and talented Software Development Engineer to join our team in delivering high quality software. The full-stack software engineer will work closely with program managers, product owners, and scrum teams to ensure that new features are prioritized and implemented properly. This position will be on-site 4 days a week at our Irving office.

65% front end/35% back end

Job Responsibilities
  • Work as part of a small, agile team to develop and maintain internal systems, ensuring high-quality code and adherence to best practices
  • Design and develop full-stack web applications, leveraging React for the front end and ASP.NET Core Web API for the back end.
  • Work collaboratively with scrum teams and product owners to identify new features and squash bugs
  • Coordinate with scrum teams to report progress, enhancements, and defects to key stakeholders
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
  • 10+ years in software development
  • Proficiency in developing single-page applications using modern front-end technologies, with a focus on React (Angular experience is a plus)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design principles
  • Solid experience with jQuery, JavaScript, HTML 5 and CSS
  • Proficiency in C# and .NET Core, with hands-on experience in the Visual Studio IDE and a strong foundation in object-oriented programming
  • Demonstrated ability to write well-structured, maintainable code, adhering to best practices for separation of concerns and application design
  • Experience building RESTful APIs
  • Strong experience with SQL Server, including data modeling, writing complex queries (joins, inserts, updates), query optimization, and stored procedure development
  • Proficiency in version control using Git, with a solid understanding of branching strategies
  • Highly organized, motivated and able to work with a sense of urgency
  • Experience working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, etc.)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills to collaborate effectively with various teams and stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving skills leveraging research, analysis and expertise to develop creative and innovative solutions

job.description:
Full Stack .NET Developer (React, .NET Core, C#, SQL)
6 month contract to hire (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Irving, TX (Onsite 4 days a week)
 
Seeking a self-motivated and talented Software Development Engineer to join our team in delivering high quality software. The full-stack software engineer will work closely with program managers, product owners, and scrum teams to ensure that new features are prioritized and implemented properly. This position will be on-site three days a week at our Irving office.

Job Responsibilities
  • Work as part of a small, agile team to develop and maintain internal systems, ensuring high-quality code and adherence to best practices
  • Design and develop full-stack web applications, leveraging React for the front end and ASP.NET Core Web API for the back end.
  • Work collaboratively with scrum teams and product owners to identify new features and squash bugs
  • Coordinate with scrum teams to report progress, enhancements, and defects to key stakeholders
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years in software development
  • Proficiency in developing single-page applications using modern front-end technologies, with a focus on React (Angular experience is a plus)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design principles
  • Solid experience with jQuery, JavaScript, HTML 5 and CSS
  • Proficiency in C# and .NET Core, with hands-on experience in the Visual Studio IDE and a strong foundation in object-oriented programming
  • Demonstrated ability to write well-structured, maintainable code, adhering to best practices for separation of concerns and application design
  • Experience building RESTful APIs
  • Strong experience with SQL Server, including data modeling, writing complex queries (joins, inserts, updates), query optimization, and stored procedure development
  • Proficiency in version control using Git, with a solid understanding of branching strategies
  • Highly organized, motivated and able to work with a sense of urgency
  • Experience working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, etc.)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills to collaborate effectively with various teams and stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving skills leveraging research, analysis and expertise to develop creative and innovative solutions

job.title: Director of Talent Acquisitions
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Director of Talent Acquisition for our diagnostics and life sciences client. In this leadership role, you will be responsible for developing and executing enterprise-wide talent acquisition strategies that support organizational growth, workforce planning, and hiring objectives. The Director of Talent Acquisition will lead and develop the recruiting team, oversee full-cycle recruitment across executive, technical, and specialized positions, and partner closely with executive leadership and hiring managers to build scalable, efficient, and data-driven recruiting programs. This position requires strong knowledge of publicly traded company compliance, Paycom HRIS, recruiting technologies, and talent acquisition analytics.

Industry: Diagnostics / Life Sciences
Location: Onsite
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive Talent Acquisition strategy aligned with short- and long-term organizational and workforce objectives.
  • Partner with executive leadership and senior HR leaders to forecast workforce needs, establish hiring priorities, and proactively develop talent pipelines.
  • Establish recruiting goals, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to measure performance, identify trends, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Develop and support employer branding initiatives designed to strengthen the organization's position within the life sciences talent market.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Talent Acquisition professionals while fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
  • Establish performance expectations, provide ongoing coaching, and support professional development of recruiting team members.
  • Manage recruiting workload, capacity planning, and prioritization across business units and hiring initiatives.
  • Oversee full-cycle recruiting activities across all organizational levels, including executive, technical, scientific, and specialized positions.
  • Ensure a consistent, positive, and equitable candidate experience throughout the recruiting and selection process.
  • Develop and maintain job description standards, structured interview frameworks, and candidate selection criteria in partnership with HR leadership and hiring managers.
  • Ensure recruiting practices comply with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.
  • Maintain compliance with publicly traded company requirements, including SOX-related controls, EEOC/OFCCP requirements, CCPA/CPRA, and internal audit standards.
  • Oversee recruiting documentation, recordkeeping, and reporting requirements to support regulatory audits and organizational transparency.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to remain current on evolving employment and labor law requirements.
  • Serve as the internal Talent Acquisition lead for Paycom HRIS, supporting data integrity, process consistency, reporting, and user adoption.
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize recruiting technologies, including applicant tracking systems, sourcing platforms, assessment tools, and analytics solutions.
  • Leverage recruiting data and workforce metrics to identify trends and provide actionable insights to HR and business leadership.
  • Manage relationships with external recruiting firms, staffing agencies, and sourcing vendors, including contract negotiations and performance management.
  • Develop strong partnerships with hiring managers and business leaders to provide consultative and responsive talent solutions.
  • Represent Talent Acquisition in cross-functional HR initiatives, organizational planning discussions, and leadership forums.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required.
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of progressive Talent Acquisition experience, including demonstrated ownership of end-to-end recruiting programs.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of supervisory or people management experience leading Talent Acquisition teams or functions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic recruiting and workforce planning initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of publicly traded company compliance requirements, including SOX controls, EEOC/OFCCP regulations, and related governance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Paycom HRIS, including Talent Acquisition, onboarding, and reporting modules.
  • Experience with Talent Acquisition technologies such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, HireVue, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience developing and utilizing recruiting KPIs, analytics, and reporting to support strategic business decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate recruiting data into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build effective relationships with executives, hiring managers, HR partners, and other stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results within a fast-paced, growth-oriented organization.
Preferred Qualifications
  • MBA, MA/MS in Human Resources, or another relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • Talent Acquisition experience within the life sciences industry, including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, diagnostics, or clinical research organizations preferred.
  • Familiarity with FDA, GxP, or other regulated environments that impact workforce and hiring practices.
  • PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, or equivalent HR certification preferred.
  • Experience supporting a publicly traded organization through an IPO, merger or acquisition, or significant headcount scaling initiative preferred.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Drug Safety & Pharmacovigilance Specialist - Onsite, Cambridge MA
job.description:
Drug Safety & Pharmacovigilance Specialist - Onsite, Cambridge MA

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Partner with aggregate report leads, pharmacovigilance science leads and safety physicians to manage and support the authoring of aggregate safety reports, including PSURs, DSURs and line listings.
  • Oversee scheduled and ad hoc line listings from generation through submission.
  • Work with affiliate management and regulatory teams to develop and edit safety management plans and related documentation.
  • Identify gaps in aggregate reporting processes and recommend or implement improvements.
  • Collaborate with study teams, cross-functional partners, external business partners and vendors across assigned therapeutic areas.
  • Support signal detection, signal evaluation and signal management activities.
  • Contribute to data mining and safety signal reviews using internal and external data sources, including clinical and safety outputs, medical literature and health authority requests.
  • Develop an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of various safety data sources.
  • Assist with the evaluation of potential safety issues and quality risk assessments.
  • Support safety committee activities, including preparing reports, meeting materials and minutes, tracking action items, and participating in discussions related to patient safety.
  • Communicate safety information, context and urgency to relevant team members.
  • Coordinate cross-functional meetings to support issue resolution and decision-making.
  • Support safety risk management team preparation and documentation with guidance from senior team members and safety physicians.
  • Provide training and support to new staff regarding department processes and therapeutic area knowledge.
Education:

A degree in a medical, healthcare or life sciences-related discipline is required. Examples may include nursing, pharmacy, physician assistant studies, medicine or a related field.

Qualifications:

  • Three to five years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with experience in drug safety or pharmacovigilance.
  • Experience supporting aggregate safety reporting, signal management, safety surveillance or risk management activities.
  • Knowledge of pharmacovigilance regulations and global safety reporting requirements.
  • Experience with safety databases such as Argus or Arisg.
  • Experience with signal detection or data analysis tools such as Empirica or Spotfire.
  • Experience developing or implementing dashboards and data displays for signaling, compliance, KPIs or quality metrics.
  • Understanding of the drug development process and pharmaceutical regulations.
  • Experience supporting process improvement initiatives and translating ideas into practical business solutions.
  • Ability to work independently in a cross-functional, matrixed environment.
  • Strong planning, organizational, analytical, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working across international teams or geographic regions is preferred.
  • Clinical patient care experience is a plus.
Special Skills:

  • Ability to represent the drug safety function in internal and external meetings.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional briefings, technical meetings and project discussions.
  • Strong problem-solving, reasoning and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work diplomatically with stakeholders and help drive issues toward resolution.
  • Strong analytical and scientific writing skills.
  • Ability to manage activities involving cross-functional teams, business partners and contract research organizations.
Job Complexity:

This role supports aggregate report management and risk management activities throughout the product lifecycle. The position requires coordination across multiple functions, external partners and contract research organizations. The individual will be responsible for helping ensure the successful execution of activities related to drug safety and risk management.

The individual is expected to work independently with support from management and senior colleagues.

job.description:
We have 18-month contract opportunities for Manufacturing Electronic Technicians.

Pay Rate: $23.00 to $25.00/Hr.
Second Shift and Weekend Shifts offer shift differential.
Available Shifts: 1st Shift, 2nd Shift, and Weekend Shift

Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in a Manufacturing Technician or Engineering Technician role
  • High School Diploma or Associate Degree
  • Electrical and electronic troubleshooting skills
  • Manufacturing and assembly experience

Job Responsibilities:
  • Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, parts lists, and verbal instructions to build, repair, and test electro-mechanical, vacuum, and pneumatic assemblies.
  • Perform electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, repair, and testing.
  • Identify, diagnose, and correct assembly or equipment issues.
  • Conduct inspections and quality checks on components and finished products.
  • Utilize testing equipment including:
  • Electronic Measurement Devices
  • Leak detectors, Vacuum pumps, and Test fixtures.
  • Maintain accurate production, labor, and work-order records in computer systems.

  • Follow Safety procedures and properly use required PPE, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • May assist with software-related tasks, or equipment repairs as needed.

Physical & Environmental Requirements:
  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Working in confined spaces
  • Bending, kneeling, squatting, twisting, and reaching
  • Climbing stairs and ladders and lifting and moving materials
  • Distinguishing between colors
  • Working in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels
  • Using hand tools and power tools
  • Operating forklifts and other industrial equipment

This role may involve work in a cleanroom environment and may require the use of:
Coveralls, Hoods, Booties, Safety glasses, Gloves, Respirators, and Chemical Aprons.

job.title: IAM Vault Administrator- Remote
job.description:
Identity & Access Management (IAM) Vault Analyst

The IAM Vault Analyst will work within the Identity and Access Management (IAM) department to support account management, privileged access management, and credential management lifecycle.  Each of these areas of support will include vault administration and compliance tasks.  The candidate will need to have an understanding of account vaulting, vault automation, and vault access control. The candidate will leverage a robust understanding of information systems’ access controls to discover and maintain a comprehensive and accurate inventory of accounts.

Job Details 

Duration: 24 months contract, with potential extension
Pay rate: $40.59-$47.63 hourly W2
Location: Remote within US, EST Schedule

Responsibilities
  • Applies knowledge, skills and abilities to implement process or procedure, timely and professionally
  • Provides end user support for all needs related to vault administration
  • Participate in the resolving of issues and resolving customer escalations
  • Utilizes and maintains vault admin desk-side procedures to ensure they are well maintained and accurate
  • Ensures daily tasks are completed with special focus on completing compliance requirements
  • Ensures understanding of governing policies, procedures and standards in order to perform functions with the security and compliance expectations
  • Provides support for the project initiatives as a Vault Admin
  • Managing Identity lifecycle events to ensure timely documentation of accounts within vault.
  • Attends training for staff on current and new system functions for performing duties.
  • Builds and develops strong relationships with business area clients by providing superior customer support as demonstrated by clearly owning, resolving and communicating issues and problems; being responsive to needs, requirements, and deadlines; and generally promoting goodwill in a professional and trust-building manner.
  • Monitoring and managing access maintenance workflows to ensure compliance requirements are met.
  • Supports and executes compliance control processes which include the evaluation and documentation of control evidence

Requirements
  • Proven at mastering attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a confidential and controlled environment
  • Strong analytic ability
  • Ability to manage concurrent and differentiated tasks
  • Excellent oral and written communications skills
  • Willingness to learn new technologies
  • Ability to work in a team environment
  • At least 2 years of IT experience
  • Familiarity with privileged access management concepts and vault technologies
  • Experience managing privileged accounts within a PAM system.
  • Experience with creating and managing credential management automation.
  • Familiarity with access controls for enterprise level information system platforms (e.g. Linux, Microsoft, Oracle)
  • Familiarity with access controls for enterprise level web applications
  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems or equivalent, related work experience

Preferred
  • 1-3 years of CyberArk administration and support
  • Experience with Installation, configuration and management of the following CyberArk components: PAM, CPM, PSM, PVWA, AIM, Connect, Auto-discovery
  • Familiarity with the energy regulatory environment and NERC-CIP standards.
  • Experience using Cherwell, IdentityIQ, and CyberArk EPV.
  • Experience in Cyber-Ark Implementation and Installation of Cyber-Ark 12.0+
  • Experience with Implementation of authentication of CyberArk using LDAP and RSA
  • Implementing & Managing Master Policy, Directory Mapping, LDAP integration, Platform and Safe via Private Ark client & PVWA.
  • Experience implementing and troubleshooting CyberArk Plugins for technology platforms such as Windows, NIX, Oracle, SQL
  • Experience managing and understanding Cyber-Ark Central Policy Manager (CPM) and (PSM).
  • Experience managing CyberArk in a High-Availability environment

job.description:
Hi,

We have a contract-to-Hire Leave Specialist position.

We are open to candidates based in our Philadelphia, Washington DC, Chicago, Houston, or Dallas offices.  The role will be hybrid, with two days per week in the office.

  • 3–5+ years of leave experience, full-cycle, in-house leave administration experience. We are looking for someone who has managed the leave process internally rather than working in a fully outsourced leave model.

  • The ability to communicate difficult information with empathy, professionalism, and confidence while ensuring employees understand their leave options and responsibilities.
  • This is a role that requires someone who is comfortable balancing the technical/compliance side of leave administration with a strong people-focused approach.

job.title: Chemometrician – Analytical Chemist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a Chemometrician – Analytical Chemist for a direct-hire opportunity in Houston or Austin, TX.

This is a unique opportunity for an analytical scientist who enjoys working at the intersection of spectroscopy, chemometrics, and scientific programming. The Chemometrician – Analytical Chemist will support the development of predictive chemometric models through hands-on laboratory experimentation, spectral data analysis, and software-enabled data workflows.

The successful candidate will work with NIR and Raman spectroscopy, design experiments to generate high-quality calibration and validation datasets, construct predictive models that translate spectral data into actionable information, and contribute to software tools used to evaluate and deploy chemometric models.

Title: Chemometrician – Analytical Chemist
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Location: Houston or Austin, TX
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Salary Range: $70,000–$100,000 annually
Travel: Approximately 20–25%

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute laboratory experiments specifically aimed at generating calibration and validation datasets for chemometric model development.
  • Operate and maintain analytical instrumentation, including NIR and Raman spectroscopy systems.
  • Apply sound sampling strategies, Design of Experiments (DoE), and quality control practices to ensure data quality and representativeness.
  • Construct predictive models that translate spectral data into usable information for customers.
  • Develop and improve scientific software supporting MATLAB and Python Software Development Kits (SDKs) used by the chemometrics team.
  • Develop applications and tools used to evaluate chemometric models prior to deployment to field analyzers.
  • Collaborate across scientific, technical, and software-focused teams to translate complex analytical concepts into practical solutions.
  • Apply software development best practices, including version control, testing, and documentation.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Familiarity with instrumental analysis and spectroscopic experimental methods, such as NIR and/or Raman spectroscopy.
  • Working knowledge of chemometric modeling concepts and data analysis techniques.
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or MATLAB for scientific or data analysis. Relevant experience may come from professional work, academic research, coursework, or personal projects.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to travel approximately 20–25%.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Undergraduate or graduate research, internship, or co-op experience involving spectral data analysis, analytical method development, chemometrics, or data pipeline development.
  • Experience developing calibration and validation datasets and/or predictive models from spectral data.
  • Experience with chemometrics platforms such as PLS_Toolbox, The Unscrambler, or Solo+MIA.
  • Experience with APIs, relational databases (RDBMS), NoSQL databases, Docker containers, or ReactJS.
  • Experience developing scientific software, analytical applications, or data-processing tools.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Equipment Calibration Technician -Weekend Shift
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for Calibration Technicians in Longmont, CO.  You will be responsible for day-to-day operation of all automation equipment in manufacturing. A Calibration Technician’s primary responsibility is to ensure all automation equipment used in production is both maintained and calibrated. This person is responsible for monitoring equipment to understand equipment issues as they relate to overall equipment efficiency and product quality for improvement. Additionally, a technician is in the unique position to step in and support production directly if needed.

Title: Equipment Calibration Tech
Duration: contract to permanent 
Shift: Friday - Sunday, 6am-6.30pm, training will be M-F 7-3:30pm
Pay: $30/hr-$33/hr  DOE 


Responsibilities:  
•Set up and breakdown automated equipment.
•Perform calibration and preventative maintenance on all automated equipment.
•Directly support production on automated equipment. This may require directing of production staff on equipment requiring multiple associates to operate.
•Create necessary documentation for all work performed and communicate as required.
•Maintenance of spare parts inventory for automated equipment.
•Ensure work is performed in a compliant manner and consistent with business policies and regulatory requirements.
•Develop and trouble-shoot mechanical assembly processes.
•Support microarray/fluid printing processes.
•Provide documentation of assembly and testing methods.
•Monitoring of equipment for continuous improvement. Ex. Observing pellet insertion stations during operation to understand failure mode of pellet insertion.
•Participates in cross-training and cross-functional activities in the manufacturing area.
•Work with engineering team to develop and implement equipment modifications.
•Create, review and follow Workflow, Work Instruction (WI), and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPS) documents within the operations area.
•Follow all safety rules and protocols.
•Other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience :
•Associates degree or higher in technical field (science, engineering), a certification in Maintenance or Mechanical Processing from an accredited Technical institute, or four years’ experience in manufacturing/production environment (medical, device, pharmaceuticals, regulated food, pilot plant or similar type industry).
•Experience in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO, etc.) preferred.
•Experience in the medical device field, specifically invitro diagnostics, preferred.

Qualifications:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical staff to ensure understanding.
•Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate in problem solving.
•Software use and knowledge: Windows, MS Office products, SolidWorks (or similar).
•Self-starter and self-directed individual, focused on tasks at hand; ability to organize, prioritize, and execute tasks to efficiently move projects forward.
•Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form; Ability to deal and resolve problems involving several variables in standardized situations.
•Highly organized and able to balance multiple demands and priorities.
•Excellent electro-mechanical troubleshooting skills.
•Knowledge of NetSuite, Grand Avenue, or other automated ERP systems, preferred.

job.description:
Test Engineer – Android/Linux Embedded System Performance and Stability

 Day-to-Day Responsibilities
  • Execute stability, endurance, and performance tests on embedded software systems.
  • Analyze logs, crash reports, performance metrics, and test results to identify software issues.

  • Work directly with software developers to drive bugs through resolution.
  • Develop and maintain Python scripts to improve automation and testing efficiency.
  • Enhance existing stability and performance testing frameworks.

  • 2-5+ years of experience in software testing, validation, integration, or embedded systems engineering.

  • Strong Linux and/or Android OS experience.
  • Experience performing stability, endurance, performance, or reliability testing.
  • Basic Android debugging experience.
  • Ability to analyze logs, trace failures, and identify crash signatures.

job.title: Entry Level Engineering Process Technician
job.description:
Entry Level Engineering Process Technician needed for an 18-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Santa Clara, California.


Pay Rate: $28 to $33 per hour



 Shifts Available:Mon-Thur 5am-3:30pm (10Hr Day)


The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change



What You Will Be Doing:
  • Prepare samples for experiments, including sample coating, wafer cleaving, mounting/unmounting samples, and preparing jobs for experimentation to evaluate the performance of the process system.
  • Prepare transmission electron microscope (TEM) lamella samples using focused ion beam (FIB), optimize sample preparation procedures and conditions, and identify cutting locations based on pattern instructions
  • Operate metrology tools in the FIB & TEM lab to understand cross-section or top-view critical dimensions (CD), identify patterns of interest, understand image quality requirements and sample/beam interactions to determine optimized conditions, and complete requested jobs under limited supervision after training
  • Understand the basic principles of scanning electron microscopy (SEM), focused ion beam (FIB), and transmission electron microscopy (TEM)
  • Perform SEM/FIB system and routine maintenance procedures such as flash, plasma cleaning, and image calibrations.
  • Perform routine troubleshoot procedures, identify problems, restart or standby the tool. Coordinate instrument repair and maintenance.
  • Interface with requestors, understand their detailed requirements, and communicate results. Coordinate with engineering on job request status.
  • Help monitor job queue and maintain lab throughput.
  • Document redo and lessons learned to lower redo rate.
  • Adhere to lab protocols and SOPs.
  • Operate supportive metrology equipment in a lab environment.
  • Operate supportive metrology equipment for FIB-TEM lamella samples.
  • Monitor data and track performance of metrology equipment and production activities per equipment requirements
  • Understand written instructions to perform assigned tasks.
  • Create and update procedures and documentation.
  • Perform basic operations of Microsoft Outlook and Office software.Follow safety protocols and processes.

Work shifts may include compressed work week schedules to meet production needs.



What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
 
  • Has a good understanding of how the team integrates with others to achieve objectives
  • May provide informal guidance and support to more junior team members
  • Has developed proficiency in a range of analytical processes or procedures to carry out assigned tasks
  • Provides solutions to problems in situations that are atypical or infrequently occurring based on existing precedents or procedures
  • Uses communication skills to regularly exchange information

Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:

job.title: Product Manager – Autonomous Mobility/ Commercial Auto Insurance
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Product Manager – Autonomous Mobility/ Commercial Auto Insurance to join our insurance and mobility client. This is a foundational role responsible for defining the organization’s commercial auto strategy and determining how it should participate in emerging mobility markets, including autonomous vehicles, connected fleets, rideshare, and delivery platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong commercial auto product expertise, a thoughtful perspective on the future of mobility, and the executive presence to develop and sell a new product vision from the ground up.

Title: Commercial Auto Product Manager, Emerging Mobility
Compensation: $194,300–$259,100 base salary, depending on experience, plus 20% target incentive
Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire
Location: Costa Mesa, CA or Dallas, TX
Industry: Insurance / Mobility Technology

This role is expected to be onsite most days in the Costa Mesa office. Relocation assistance may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Fully remote work is not currently planned, although limited flexibility may be explored for an outstanding candidate.

Position Overview The organization does not currently offer commercial auto insurance products and is beginning to define its strategy in this space. This person will serve as the initial product leader for the initiative, helping the business understand the opportunity, evaluate potential paths forward, and build the foundation for a future commercial auto and emerging mobility product organization.

The initial focus will be on light commercial auto and mobility segments that align with the organization’s existing operational and underwriting capabilities. This is not a heavy trucking role. The position will initially be heavily focused on strategy, market analysis, product vision, business cases, and executive alignment before transitioning into broader product development and team-building responsibilities.

Over time, the role is expected to transition from the emerging mobility strategy team into the broader insurance product management organization, potentially within 12 to 36 months as the product vision and operating model take shape.

Key Responsibilities Commercial Auto and Mobility Strategy
  • Define the organization’s long-term commercial auto and emerging mobility product strategy.

  • Evaluate opportunities across light commercial fleets, connected vehicles, autonomous vehicles, rideshare, delivery, and other evolving mobility models.

  • Explain the key differences between personal auto and commercial auto products, including risk, pricing, underwriting, coverage, claims, and operational considerations.

  • Develop a clear point of view on how autonomous and connected mobility will impact commercial insurance.

  • Monitor emerging mobility trends, competitors, OEM activity, insurance innovation, technology providers, and regulatory developments.

  • Identify where the organization can create a differentiated position in the market.

Business Case and Product Vision
  • Develop a practical roadmap for moving from the current state, with no commercial auto product, to a scalable product offering.

  • Evaluate potential paths, including building the capability internally, acquiring or partnering with an existing organization, or choosing not to enter specific market segments.

  • Analyze the investment, talent, technology, regulatory, operational, and risk requirements associated with each path.

  • Prepare recommendations and business cases for executive leadership.

  • Sell the product vision to senior executives and create alignment around the recommended strategy.

  • Define the capabilities, resources, partnerships, and organizational structure required to execute the strategy.

Product Design and Insurance Expertise
  • Provide expertise on commercial auto product structure, coverage design, underwriting, rating, pricing, and risk selection.

  • Partner with actuarial teams to evaluate pricing methodologies, risk models, exposure data, loss trends, and portfolio economics.

  • Help determine which commercial auto risks and vehicle types align with the organization’s existing capabilities.

  • Identify future coverage needs created by autonomous systems, connected vehicles, fleet operations, and changing liability models.

  • Establish the foundation for product governance, regulatory review, underwriting guidelines, and operational processes.

  • Support the development of product requirements and implementation plans as the strategy advances.

Team and Capability Development
  • Define the roles and capabilities needed to build a future commercial auto product team.

  • Recommend the organizational structure and talent profile required for execution.

  • Help recruit and build the team responsible for launching and managing the product.

  • Establish relationships across insurance product management, actuarial, underwriting, claims, legal, compliance, technology, operations, and marketing.

  • Transition from primarily strategic work into product development and execution as the initiative progresses.

Partnership and Market Development
  • Evaluate potential relationships with OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, mobility platforms, fleet operators, telematics providers, data companies, and insurance technology partners.

  • Assess embedded insurance and partnership-based distribution opportunities.

  • Represent the organization in relevant insurance, mobility, and technology discussions.

  • Develop external market perspective and bring new insights to internal stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, insurance, finance, economics, management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

  • Significant experience developing or managing commercial auto insurance products.

  • Strong understanding of the differences between personal auto and commercial auto insurance.

  • Experience with commercial auto pricing, underwriting, actuarial models, risk selection, coverage structures, or portfolio performance.

  • Experience developing product strategy, business cases, market-entry plans, or new insurance capabilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate in an environment where the product, process, and team are still being built.

  • Strong understanding of emerging mobility, autonomous vehicles, connected vehicles, telematics, rideshare, delivery, or commercial fleet trends.

  • Ability to clearly explain how changes in mobility and vehicle technology may affect insurance products, pricing, underwriting, liability, and claims.

  • Proven ability to present recommendations and influence senior executives.

  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution.

  • Ability to work onsite most days in Costa Mesa, California, or relocate to the area.

  • Willingness to travel periodically for executive meetings, industry events, and stakeholder discussions.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with autonomous vehicle companies, OEMs, commercial fleet operators, mobility platforms, telematics providers, or embedded insurance programs.

  • Experience with light commercial fleets, delivery vehicles, rideshare, or other emerging commercial mobility segments.

  • Experience working with an insurance carrier, insurtech, mobility company, or transportation technology organization.

  • Experience launching a new insurance product or building a new insurance capability from the ground up.

  • Experience evaluating build, buy, partner, or acquisition strategies.

  • Experience with E&S, specialty, non-standard, or other complex insurance products.

  • Experience with state insurance filings, regulatory approvals, product governance, or compliance.

  • CPCU, AINS, ARM, or another insurance designation.

  • Experience building and leading a product management or insurance strategy team.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Build the commercial auto strategy from the ground up.
